```
{"body":"## Problem Statement\n\nPeople who work with many contacts on a project or in a company keep them in spreadsheets, mailboxes or heavyweight CRM systems. Spreadsheets get copied around, nobody knows who changed what, the same person appears three times with slightly different data, and there is no way to give a colleague access to one project's contacts without giving them everything. CRM systems solve this but are too complex for a team that only wants to keep, find, label and hand on contacts.\n\n## Solution\n\nA multi-tenant contact management web application whose advantage over CRM systems is simplicity. A User signs in (Firebase Authentication: email and password, or Google) and creates a **Workspace** for each project or company; only its **Members** see it, each with a **Role** (Owner, Editor, Viewer). A Workspace holds **Contacts** with fixed **Predefined fields**, free key-value **Attributes** and free **Tags** used as categories. Every change writes an immutable **Revision**, so the full history is visible and any earlier state can be **Restored**. The application finds **Duplicate sets**, warns while saving, lets an Editor **Merge** them, and **Exports** the selected or filtered Contacts to Excel. hi # Contact Management

A deliberately simple CRM for one organization: it stores Contacts, labels them with Tags and custom Attributes, keeps a full history of every change, and exports them to Excel.

## People

**Contact**:
A person the organization keeps data about. Has predefined fields (first name, last name, one email, one phone, one address, country, company) plus any number of Attributes and Tags.
_Avoid_: User (for records), person, customer, entry, record

... (81 lines omitted) ...


**Unmerge**:
Turning a Merged Contact back into a normal Contact, exactly as it was just before the Merge. The survivor is not changed.
_Avoid_: Split, undo merge

## Output

**Export**:
An Excel file of the Contacts in the current filtered list, or only the selected ones if a selection exists.
_Avoid_: Download, report

**Export Log**:
The record of every Export: who, when, how many Contacts and with which filter. Visible to Admins.
_Avoid_: Download history
```

```
# Single-tenant: one deployment serves one organization

The product is meant to compete with other CRMs, which are usually multi-tenant SaaS. Even so, each deployment serves exactly one organization: all Users see the same Contacts, Tags and Attribute Keys, and duplicate detection covers the whole database. We chose this to keep the data model, authorization and queries simple for v1, in line with the product's main selling point of being easy to use. If another organization needs the system, it gets its own deployment and its own database. Moving to true multi-tenancy later would mean adding an organization boundary to every table, query and permission check.

Walking skeleton: sign in and see my Workspaces
## Parent

#1

## What to build

A User can open the application, sign up or sign in (email and password, or Google, through Firebase Authentication; the Auth emulator locally), see the list of Workspaces they belong to, create one and rename it as Owner, and sign out. The whole stack (frontend, backend, PostgreSQL, Auth emulator) starts with one Compose command. The backend verifies every token itself, keeps its own User record, and reaches Workspace data only through the Workspace-scoped access layer of ADR-0001, so a non-Member gets 404. Health and readiness, rate and size limits, security headers and the production start-up guard are in place from the first slice.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-001-01: requests without a valid token (none, malformed, expired, other project) get 401 and no data
```

# Tech stack

> Owner: Architect · Read in: phases 0, 2, 4, 6 · Agent: read-only

The single source of truth for every platform, dependency and tool version.
Build manifests and lock files in `02_output/` (e.g. `pom.xml`, `package.json`, `build.gradle`, `*.csproj`, `Podfile`) must match this file exactly; the phase 0 gate checks it. Resolvability and vulnerability results are recorded by the agent in `docs/00_preflight-report.md`.

## Rules

- Exact versions only: no ranges, wildcards, `latest` or floating tags.
- Changing any entry below is a blocking decision (`general/working-rules.md`). The human's approval in the decision record replaces the entry; nobody edits this file mid-run.
- A pin that resolves and runs but whose tool reports another version (for example an image tag) is a non-blocking decision; the listed pin stays authoritative. A pin that does not resolve or run is blocking.
- A dependency or tool not listed here may be added only with an exact version and a non-blocking decision record; it is scanned in phase 6 like any other.
- Every dependency's licence must be compatible with the project's licence.
- A `platforms` or `tooling` entry may carry `version_check` (a command whose output contains the version) and, for `tooling`, `options` (flags, analysers or rule sets to enable or disable, for example analysers that need credentials not listed in `secrets.env.example`). Preflight uses them.
- `tooling` must include at least one tool for each purpose required by `general/quality/` and `general/security/`: build, format, lint, type check (if the language has one), test, coverage, mutation, static analysis, dependency scan, secret scan.

Project licence: proprietary. Allowed dependency licences: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC, PostgreSQL; EPL-2.0 for test scope only; GPL-2.0-with-classpath-exception for the Java runtime image only.

# Test-Driven Development

TDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.

When exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.

## What a good test is

Tests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: "user can checkout with valid cart" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.

See [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.

## Seams: where tests go

A **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.

**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.

Ask: "What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.

When the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with "codebase-design" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.

## Anti-patterns

- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.
- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.
- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.

## Rules of the loop

- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.
- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.
- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.

```md
# Contact Management

A deliberately simple, multi-tenant contact manager: people keep the Contacts of one project or company in a Workspace, label them with Tags and Attributes, see every change as a Revision, find Duplicate sets, Merge them and Export to Excel.

## People and access

**User**:
Someone who signs in (Firebase Authentication) and is known to the application by their sign-in identity.
_Avoid_: account, member (for the person in general)

**Workspace**:
The container for the Contacts of one project or company. Only its Members see it; nothing in it is visible from another Workspace.
_Avoid_: group, project, tenant, organization

**Member**:

... (57 lines omitted) ...


**Merge**:
Combining 2–10 Contacts of a Duplicate set into one Survivor; the others become Deleted contacts pointing to it.
_Avoid_: combine, dedupe, join

**Survivor**:
The Contact that remains after a Merge.
_Avoid_: master, winner

## Output

**Export**:
An `.xlsx` workbook of the selected Contacts or of all Contacts matching the current search and filters.
_Avoid_: download, report
```

```bash
# ADR-0001: Workspaces in one shared schema, isolated by one access layer

Status: accepted (supersedes the earlier single-tenant draft, per spec #1)

Each project or company is a Workspace in one deployment. All Workspace-owned rows (Contacts, Attributes, Tags, Revisions, memberships, invitations) live in one shared PostgreSQL schema and carry the Workspace id.

Isolation lives in one Workspace-scoped access layer. `WorkspaceAccess` is the only code that turns a Workspace id and the caller into a `WorkspaceScope`, and it does so only after reading the caller's membership from PostgreSQL. Every store of Workspace-owned data takes a `WorkspaceScope` as its first parameter and filters by its Workspace id. A non-Member gets the same 404 as for a Workspace that does not exist. An ArchUnit rule (`ArchitectureTest`) enforces that only the store package touches JDBC, that every store method takes a `WorkspaceScope`, and that only `WorkspaceAccess` creates one.

Rejected: row-level security and schema per Workspace. They are stronger, but they make migrations, connection handling and tests heavier than this simple product needs.
EOF
```

```md
# API contract

All endpoints live under `/api`, take and return JSON (except the Export workbook), and need `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>` (except `/api/health*`).

## Ports (Docker Compose)

| Service | Host port | Notes |
|---|---|---|

| db (PostgreSQL 16) | not published | volume `db-data` |

## Errors


... (113 lines omitted) ...

## Export

`POST /api/workspaces/{wid}/export` (Member) with exactly one of:

- `{ "contactIds": ["uuid", ...] }`: those Contacts, in list default order (last name, first name); a Deleted, foreign or unknown id → 400 `contactIds`;
- `{ "filter": { q, tag, tagMode, attr, country, company, sort, dir } }`: every active Contact matching, in the filter's order.

Both or neither → 400. More than 10,000 Contacts → 400. Response 200 `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet`, `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<workspace-name>-<yyyy-MM-dd>.xlsx"` (name reduced to letters, digits, `-` and `_`).

Columns, in order: `Ime`, `Priimek`, `E-pošta`, `Telefon`, `Podjetje`, `Delovno mesto`, `Ulica`, `Poštna številka`, `Kraj`, `Država`, `Opomba`, `Oznake` (Tags joined by `, `), then one column per Attribute key (lower case, sorted). Every cell is a text cell; values are never formulas.

## Health

`GET /api/health` (liveness) and `GET /api/health/ready` (readiness, checks the database), no token needed.
```

```bash
package si.contacts.support;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Builds ID tokens in exactly the shape the Firebase Auth Emulator issues: unsigned ({@code
 * alg: none}), audience = project id, issuer = securetoken.google.com/project.
 */
public final class Tokens {
  public static final String PROJECT = "demo-contacts-test";

  private Tokens() {}

  public static String emulator(String uid, String email, boolean verified, String name) {
    return emulator(PROJECT, uid, email, verified, name, Instant.now().plusSeconds(3600));
  }

  public static String emulator(
      String project, String uid, String email, boolean verified, String name, Instant exp) {
    long now = Instant.now().getEpochSecond();
    String header = "{\"alg\":\"none\",\"typ\":\"JWT\"}";
    String payload =
        "{\"iss\":\"https://securetoken.google.com/"
            + project
            + "\",\"aud\":\""
            + project
            + "\",\"auth_time\":"
            + (now - 10)
            + ",\"user_id\":\""
            + uid
            + "\",\"sub\":\""
            + uid
            + "\",\"iat\":"
            + (now - 10)
            + ",\"exp\":"
            + exp.getEpochSecond()
            + (email == null ? "" : ",\"email\":\"" + email + "\"")
            + ",\"email_verified\":"
            + verified
            + (name == null ? "" : ",\"name\":\"" + name + "\"")
            + ",\"firebase\":{\"sign_in_provider\":\"password\"}}";
    return b64(header) + "." + b64(payload) + ".";
  }

  public static String randomUid() {
    return UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "").substring(0, 28);
  }

  static String b64(String s) {
    return Base64.getUrlEncoder()
        .withoutPadding()
        .encodeToString(s.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
  }
}
EOF

package si.contacts.support;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.util.Map;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;

/** Thin HTTP client for the REST seam: real requests against the running backend. */
public final class Api {
  static final ObjectMapper JSON = JsonMapper.builder().build();
  private static final HttpClient HTTP = HttpClient.newHttpClient();
  private final String base;

  public Api(int port) {
    this.base = "http://localhost:" + port;
  }

  public Res get(String token, String path) {
    return send(token, "GET", path, null);
  }

  public Res post(String token, String path, Object body) {
    return send(token, "POST", path, body);
  }

  public Res put(String token, String path, Object body) {
    return send(token, "PUT", path, body);
  }

  public Res patch(String token, String path, Object body) {
    return send(token, "PATCH", path, body);
  }

  public Res delete(String token, String path) {
    return send(token, "DELETE", path, null);
  }

  public Res delete(String token, String path, Object body) {
    return send(token, "DELETE", path, body);
  }

  public Res send(String token, String method, String path, Object body) {
    try {
      String raw = body == null ? null : body instanceof String s ? s : JSON.writeValueAsString(body);
      return sendRaw(token, method, path, raw, Map.of());
    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
      throw e;
    }
  }

  public Res sendRaw(String token, String method, String path, String raw, Map<String, String> headers) {
    try {
      HttpRequest.Builder b = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(base + path));
      if (token != null) b.header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token);
      headers.forEach(b::header);
      if (raw != null) {
        b.header("Content-Type", "application/json");
        b.method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(raw));
      } else {
        b.method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody());
      }
      HttpResponse<byte[]> r = HTTP.send(b.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofByteArray());
      return new Res(r.statusCode(), r.body(), r.headers().map());
    } catch (Exception e) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(e);
    }
  }

  public record Res(int status, byte[] bytes, Map<String, java.util.List<String>> headers) {
    public JsonNode json() {
      return bytes.length == 0 ? JSON.missingNode() : JSON.readTree(bytes);
    }

    public String body() {
      return new String(bytes, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    public String header(String name) {
      return headers.entrySet().stream()
          .filter(e -> e.getKey().equalsIgnoreCase(name))
          .map(e -> e.getValue().get(0))
          .findFirst()
          .orElse(null);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
      return status + " " + body();
    }
  }
}
EOF

package si.contacts.support;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.web.server.LocalServerPort;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;
import org.testcontainers.postgresql.PostgreSQLContainer;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;

/** Base for acceptance tests through the REST API against a real PostgreSQL. */
@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
public abstract class ApiTestBase {
  static final PostgreSQLContainer DB = new PostgreSQLContainer("postgres:16.15-alpine");

  static {
    DB.start();
  }

  @DynamicPropertySource
  static void props(DynamicPropertyRegistry r) {
    r.add("spring.datasource.url", DB::getJdbcUrl);
    r.add("spring.datasource.username", DB::getUsername);
    r.add("spring.datasource.password", DB::getPassword);
    r.add("app.auth.project-id", () -> Tokens.PROJECT);
    r.add("app.auth.emulator", () -> "true");
  }

  @LocalServerPort protected int port;
  protected Api api;

  @BeforeEach
  void setUpApi() {
    api = new Api(port);
  }

  /** A signed-in, verified User with a fresh identity. */
  protected TestUser user(String name) {
    String uid = Tokens.randomUid();
    String email = name.toLowerCase().replaceAll("[^a-z0-9]", "") + "." + uid.substring(0, 8) + "@example.si";
    TestUser u = new TestUser(uid, email, Tokens.emulator(uid, email, true, name));
    api.get(u.token(), "/api/me");
    return u;
  }

  protected String createWorkspace(TestUser owner, String name) {
    Api.Res r = api.post(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces", Map.of("name", name));
    if (r.status() != 201) throw new AssertionError(r.toString());
    return r.json().get("id").asText();
  }

  /** Adds an existing verified User to a Workspace with the Role. */
  protected void addMember(TestUser owner, String wid, TestUser member, String role) {
    Api.Res r =
        api.post(
            owner.token(),
            "/api/workspaces/" + wid + "/members",
            Map.of("email", member.email(), "role", role));
    if (r.status() != 201) throw new AssertionError(r.toString());
  }

  protected JsonNode createContact(TestUser editor, String wid, Map<String, Object> body) {
    Api.Res r = api.post(editor.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + wid + "/contacts", body);
    if (r.status() != 201) throw new AssertionError(r.toString());
    return r.json();
  }

  protected static Map<String, Object> contact(Object... kv) {
    Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 2) m.put((String) kv[i], kv[i + 1]);
    return m;
  }

  protected static List<String> errorFields(Api.Res r) {
    return r.json().get("errors").valueStream().map(e -> e.get("field").asText(null)).toList();
  }

  public record TestUser(String uid, String email, String token) {}
}
```

```bash
  void AC_002_01_creatingAWorkspaceMakesTheCreatorOwner() {

    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(201);
    assertThat(r.json().get("name").asText()).isEqualTo("Projekt Škofja Loka");
    assertThat(r.json().get("role").asText()).isEqualTo("OWNER");
    String id = r.json().get("id").asText();
    Api.Res one = api.get(u.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + id);
    assertThat(one.status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(one.json().get("role").asText()).isEqualTo("OWNER");
  }

  @Test
  void AC_002_02_emptyWhitespaceOrOverlongNamesAreRejected() {
    TestUser u = user("Ana");
    for (Object name : new Object[] {"", "   ", "x".repeat(101)}) {
      Api.Res r = api.post(u.token(), "/api/workspaces", Map.of("name", name));
      assertThat(r.status()).as("name '%s'", name).isEqualTo(400);
      assertThat(errorFields(r)).containsExactly("name");
    }
    Api.Res missing = api.post(u.token(), "/api/workspaces", Map.of());
    assertThat(missing.status()).isEqualTo(400);
    assertThat(errorFields(missing)).containsExactly("name");
    assertThat(api.post(u.token(), "/api/workspaces", "{not json").status()).isEqualTo(400);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_002_03_theListShowsOnlyTheCallersWorkspacesWithTheirRole() {
    TestUser a = user("Ana");
    TestUser b = user("Bor");
    String wa = createWorkspace(a, "B projekt");
    String wa2 = createWorkspace(a, "A projekt");
    createWorkspace(b, "Borov");
    Api.Res r = api.get(a.token(), "/api/workspaces");
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(r.json().valueStream().map(n -> n.get("id").asText())).containsExactly(wa2, wa);
    assertThat(r.json().valueStream().map(n -> n.get("role").asText())).containsOnly("OWNER");
  }

  @Test
  void ownerRenamesTheWorkspace() {
    TestUser a = user("Ana");
    String w = createWorkspace(a, "Staro");
    Api.Res r = api.patch(a.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w, Map.of("name", "Novo ime"));
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(api.get(a.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w).json().get("name").asText()).isEqualTo("Novo ime");
    assertThat(api.patch(a.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w, Map.of("name", " ")).status()).isEqualTo(400);
  }

  @Test
  void aNonMemberGets404IdenticalToAMissingWorkspace() {
    TestUser a = user("Ana");
    TestUser stranger = user("Tujec");
    String w = createWorkspace(a, "Zasebno");
    Api.Res foreign = api.get(stranger.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w);
    Api.Res missing = api.get(stranger.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + UUID.randomUUID());
    Api.Res garbage = api.get(stranger.token(), "/api/workspaces/not-a-uuid");
    assertThat(foreign.status()).isEqualTo(404);
    assertThat(missing.status()).isEqualTo(404);
    assertThat(garbage.status()).isEqualTo(404);
    assertThat(foreign.body()).isEqualTo(missing.body()).isEqualTo(garbage.body());
    assertThat(api.patch(stranger.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w, Map.of("name", "x")).body())
        .isEqualTo(missing.body());
  }
```

```bash
package si.contacts.acceptance;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import com.nimbusds.jose.JWSAlgorithm;
import com.nimbusds.jose.JWSHeader;
import com.nimbusds.jose.crypto.RSASSASigner;
import com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.JWKSet;
import com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.RSAKey;
import com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.gen.RSAKeyGenerator;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.JWTClaimsSet;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.SignedJWT;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Date;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;
import si.contacts.support.ApiTestBase;
import si.contacts.support.Tokens;

/** DoD-P05: token verification with real signatures (production mode, test key endpoint). */
class ProductionTokenApiTest extends ApiTestBase {
  static final String PROJECT = "contacts-prod-test";
  static final RSAKey KEY;
  static final RSAKey OTHER_KEY;
  static final HttpServer JWKS;

  static {
    try {
      KEY = new RSAKeyGenerator(2048).keyID("k1").generate();
      OTHER_KEY = new RSAKeyGenerator(2048).keyID("k1").generate();
      JWKS = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("localhost", 0), 0);
      byte[] body = new JWKSet(KEY.toPublicJWK()).toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
      JWKS.createContext(
          "/jwks",
          ex -> {
            ex.sendResponseHeaders(200, body.length);
            ex.getResponseBody().write(body);
            ex.close();
          });
      JWKS.start();
    } catch (Exception e) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(e);
    }
  }

  @DynamicPropertySource
  static void prodAuth(DynamicPropertyRegistry r) {
    r.add("app.auth.emulator", () -> "false");
    r.add("app.auth.project-id", () -> PROJECT);
    r.add("app.auth.jwks-uri", () -> "http://localhost:" + JWKS.getAddress().getPort() + "/jwks");
  }

  static String sign(RSAKey key, String aud, String iss, long expOffsetSeconds) throws Exception {
    long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
    JWTClaimsSet claims =
        new JWTClaimsSet.Builder()
            .subject(Tokens.randomUid())
            .audience(aud)
            .issuer(iss)
            .issueTime(new Date(now - 10_000))
            .claim("auth_time", (now - 10_000) / 1000)
            .expirationTime(new Date(now + expOffsetSeconds * 1000))
            .claim("email", "prod@example.si")
            .claim("email_verified", true)
            .build();
    SignedJWT jwt = new SignedJWT(new JWSHeader.Builder(JWSAlgorithm.RS256).keyID(key.getKeyID()).build(), claims);
    jwt.sign(new RSASSASigner(key));
    return jwt.serialize();
  }

  static final String ISS = "https://securetoken.google.com/" + PROJECT;

  @Test
  void aCorrectlySignedTokenIsAccepted() throws Exception {
    assertThat(api.get(sign(KEY, PROJECT, ISS, 600), "/api/me").status()).isEqualTo(200);
  }

  @Test
  void wrongAudienceIssuerExpiryOrSignatureAndUnsignedTokensAreRefused() throws Exception {
    assertThat(api.get(sign(KEY, "other", ISS, 600), "/api/me").status()).isEqualTo(401);
    assertThat(api.get(sign(KEY, PROJECT, "https://securetoken.google.com/other", 600), "/api/me").status())
        .isEqualTo(401);
    assertThat(api.get(sign(KEY, PROJECT, ISS, -60), "/api/me").status()).isEqualTo(401);
    assertThat(api.get(sign(OTHER_KEY, PROJECT, ISS, 600), "/api/me").status()).isEqualTo(401);
    String unsigned =
        Tokens.emulator(PROJECT, Tokens.randomUid(), "x@example.si", true, "X", java.time.Instant.now().plusSeconds(600));
    assertThat(api.get(unsigned, "/api/me").status()).isEqualTo(401);
  }
}
```

```bash
package si.contacts.web;

import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;

/** Any refusal of the API: a status and the field errors of its body. */
public class ApiException extends RuntimeException {
  private final HttpStatus status;
  private final transient List<FieldError> errors;

  public ApiException(HttpStatus status, List<FieldError> errors) {
    super(status + " " + errors.size() + " error(s)", null, false, false);
    this.status = status;
    this.errors = List.copyOf(errors);
  }

  public HttpStatus status() {
    return status;
  }

  public List<FieldError> errors() {
    return errors;
  }

  public static ApiException notFound() {
    return new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, List.of(new FieldError(null, "not found")));
  }

  public static ApiException forbidden() {
    return new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, List.of(new FieldError(null, "forbidden")));
  }

  public static ApiException conflict(String field, String message) {
    return new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, List.of(new FieldError(field, message)));
  }

  public static ApiException badRequest(String field, String message) {
    return new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, List.of(new FieldError(field, message)));
  }

  public static ApiException badRequest(List<FieldError> errors) {
    return new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, errors);
  }

  public static ApiException outdatedVersion() {
    return conflict("version", "outdated version");
  }
}

cat > ErrorHandler.java <<'EOF'
package si.contacts.web;

import java.util.List;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.http.converter.HttpMessageNotReadableException;
import org.springframework.web.HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException;
import org.springframework.web.HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.MissingServletRequestParameterException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.method.annotation.MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.resource.NoResourceFoundException;

/** Maps every failure to the one error shape. Never logs request data (SR: no personal data). */
@RestControllerAdvice
public class ErrorHandler {
  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ErrorHandler.class);

  @ExceptionHandler(ApiException.class)
  ResponseEntity<ErrorBody> api(ApiException e) {
    return ResponseEntity.status(e.status()).body(new ErrorBody(e.errors()));
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(HttpMessageNotReadableException.class)
  ResponseEntity<ErrorBody> unreadable() {
    return of(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, null, "malformed request body");
  }

  @ExceptionHandler({MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException.class, NoResourceFoundException.class})
  ResponseEntity<ErrorBody> notFound() {
    return of(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, null, "not found");
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(MissingServletRequestParameterException.class)
  ResponseEntity<ErrorBody> missingParam(MissingServletRequestParameterException e) {
    return of(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, e.getParameterName(), "required");
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException.class)
  ResponseEntity<ErrorBody> method() {
    return of(HttpStatus.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, null, "method not allowed");
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException.class)
  ResponseEntity<ErrorBody> mediaType() {
    return of(HttpStatus.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, null, "unsupported media type");
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(PayloadTooLargeException.class)
  ResponseEntity<ErrorBody> tooLarge() {
    return of(HttpStatus.CONTENT_TOO_LARGE, null, "request body too large");
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
  ResponseEntity<ErrorBody> unexpected(Exception e) {
    LOG.error("Unexpected error: {}", e.getClass().getName());
    return of(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, null, "internal error");
  }

  private static ResponseEntity<ErrorBody> of(HttpStatus s, String field, String message) {
    return ResponseEntity.status(s).body(new ErrorBody(List.of(new FieldError(field, message))));
  }
}
EOF

package si.contacts.web;

import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ReadListener;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletInputStream;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequestWrapper;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;

/** Small servlet filters shared by the API: security headers and the body size limit. */
public final class Filters {
  private Filters() {}

  public static void writeError(HttpServletResponse res, int status, String json) throws IOException {
    res.setStatus(status);
    res.setContentType("application/json");
    res.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
    res.getOutputStream().write(json.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
  }

  public static boolean isPublic(HttpServletRequest req) {
    String p = req.getRequestURI();
    return !p.startsWith("/api/") || p.equals("/api/health") || p.equals("/api/health/ready");
  }

  /** Security headers on every response (ASVS V3/V14). */
  public static class SecurityHeaders extends OncePerRequestFilter {
    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res, FilterChain chain)
        throws ServletException, IOException {
      res.setHeader("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
      res.setHeader("X-Frame-Options", "DENY");
      res.setHeader("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer");
      res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
      res.setHeader("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'");
      res.setHeader("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", "same-origin");
      chain.doFilter(req, res);
    }
  }

  /** Refuses request bodies over the limit with 413 (SR-05). */
  public static class BodySize extends OncePerRequestFilter {
    private final long max;

    public BodySize(long max) {
      this.max = max;
    }

    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res, FilterChain chain)
        throws ServletException, IOException {
      if (req.getContentLengthLong() > max) {
        writeError(res, 413, ErrorBody.json("request body too large"));
        return;
      }
      chain.doFilter(new Limited(req, max), res);
    }
  }

  static final class Limited extends HttpServletRequestWrapper {
    private final long max;

    Limited(HttpServletRequest req, long max) {
      super(req);
      this.max = max;
    }

    @Override
    public ServletInputStream getInputStream() throws IOException {
      ServletInputStream in = super.getInputStream();
      return new ServletInputStream() {
        long read;

        @Override
        public int read() throws IOException {
          int b = in.read();
          if (b >= 0 && ++read > max) throw new PayloadTooLargeException();
          return b;
        }

        @Override
        public int read(byte[] buf, int off, int len) throws IOException {
          int n = in.read(buf, off, len);
          if (n > 0 && (read += n) > max) throw new PayloadTooLargeException();
          return n;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isFinished() {
          return in.isFinished();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isReady() {
          return in.isReady();
        }

        @Override
        public void setReadListener(ReadListener l) {
          in.setReadListener(l);
        }
      };
    }
  }
}

package si.contacts.web;

import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
import si.contacts.auth.AuthFilter;

/** Fixed one-minute window per signed-in User, or per client address before sign-in (SR-05). */
public class RateLimiter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
  private final int perMinute;
  private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Window> windows = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

  public RateLimiter(int perMinute) {
    this.perMinute = perMinute;
  }

  private record Window(long minute, AtomicInteger count) {}

  @Override
  protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res, FilterChain chain)
      throws ServletException, IOException {
    if (Filters.isPublic(req)) {
      chain.doFilter(req, res);
      return;
    }
    Object uid = req.getAttribute(AuthFilter.UID_ATTRIBUTE);
    String key = uid != null ? "u:" + uid : "a:" + req.getRemoteAddr();
    long minute = System.currentTimeMillis() / 60_000;
    Window w =
        windows.compute(
            key, (k, old) -> old == null || old.minute != minute ? new Window(minute, new AtomicInteger()) : old);
    if (w.count.incrementAndGet() > perMinute) {
      res.setHeader("Retry-After", "60");
      Filters.writeError(res, 429, ErrorBody.json("too many requests"));
      return;
    }
    if (windows.size() > 100_000) windows.entrySet().removeIf(e -> e.getValue().minute != minute);
    chain.doFilter(req, res);
  }
}

package si.contacts.web;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.FilterRegistrationBean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.web.method.support.HandlerMethodArgumentResolver;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.CorsRegistry;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurer;
import si.contacts.auth.AuthFilter;
import si.contacts.auth.CurrentUserResolver;
import si.contacts.auth.TokenVerifier;
import si.contacts.user.UserService;

@Configuration
public class WebConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {
  private final String[] allowedOrigins;

  public WebConfig(@Value("${app.cors.allowed-origins:}") String origins) {
    this.allowedOrigins = Arrays.stream(origins.split(",")).map(String::trim).filter(s -> !s.isEmpty()).toArray(String[]::new);
  }

  @Override
  public void addCorsMappings(CorsRegistry registry) {
    if (allowedOrigins.length > 0) {
      registry
          .addMapping("/api/**")
          .allowedOrigins(allowedOrigins)
          .allowedMethods("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE")
          .allowedHeaders("Authorization", "Content-Type")
          .exposedHeaders("Content-Disposition");
    }
  }

  @Override
  public void addArgumentResolvers(List<HandlerMethodArgumentResolver> resolvers) {
    resolvers.add(new CurrentUserResolver());
  }

  @Bean
  FilterRegistrationBean<Filters.SecurityHeaders> securityHeadersFilter() {
    var b = new FilterRegistrationBean<>(new Filters.SecurityHeaders());
    b.setOrder(1);
    return b;
  }

  @Bean
  FilterRegistrationBean<Filters.BodySize> bodySizeFilter(@Value("${app.max-body-bytes}") long max) {
    var b = new FilterRegistrationBean<>(new Filters.BodySize(max));
    b.setOrder(2);
    return b;
  }

  @Bean
  FilterRegistrationBean<AuthFilter> authFilter(TokenVerifier verifier, UserService users) {
    var b = new FilterRegistrationBean<>(new AuthFilter(verifier, users));
    b.setOrder(3);
    return b;
  }

  @Bean
  FilterRegistrationBean<RateLimiter> rateLimitFilter(@Value("${app.rate-limit.requests-per-minute}") int perMinute) {
    var b = new FilterRegistrationBean<>(new RateLimiter(perMinute));
    b.setOrder(4);
    return b;
  }
}
```

```bash
package si.contacts.auth;

import com.nimbusds.jose.JOSEException;
import com.nimbusds.jose.JWSAlgorithm;
import com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.source.JWKSource;
import com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.source.JWKSourceBuilder;
import com.nimbusds.jose.proc.BadJOSEException;
import com.nimbusds.jose.proc.JWSVerificationKeySelector;
import com.nimbusds.jose.proc.SecurityContext;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.JWT;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.JWTClaimsSet;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.JWTParser;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.PlainJWT;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.SignedJWT;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.proc.DefaultJWTProcessor;
import java.net.MalformedURLException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.text.ParseException;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Date;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * The one authentication adapter: verifies a Firebase ID token (signature, audience, issuer,
 * expiry) and yields the identity. No other code depends on Firebase.
 */
@Component
public class TokenVerifier {
  private static final long SKEW_SECONDS = 60;
  private final AuthProperties props;
  private final DefaultJWTProcessor<SecurityContext> processor;

  public TokenVerifier(AuthProperties props) throws MalformedURLException {
    this.props = props;
    this.processor = new DefaultJWTProcessor<>();
    if (!props.emulator()) {
      JWKSource<SecurityContext> keys = JWKSourceBuilder.create(URI.create(props.jwksUri()).toURL()).build();
      processor.setJWSKeySelector(new JWSVerificationKeySelector<>(JWSAlgorithm.RS256, keys));
      processor.setJWTClaimsSetVerifier((claims, ctx) -> {});
    }
  }

  public VerifiedIdentity verify(String token) throws InvalidTokenException {
    JWTClaimsSet claims;
    try {
      JWT jwt = JWTParser.parse(token);
      if (jwt instanceof PlainJWT plain) {
        if (!props.emulator()) throw new InvalidTokenException("unsigned token");
        claims = plain.getJWTClaimsSet();
      } else if (jwt instanceof SignedJWT signed) {
        if (props.emulator()) throw new InvalidTokenException("signed token in emulator mode");
        claims = processor.process(signed, null);
      } else {
        throw new InvalidTokenException("unsupported token");
      }
    } catch (ParseException | BadJOSEException | JOSEException e) {
      throw new InvalidTokenException("invalid token");
    }
    return check(claims);
  }

  private VerifiedIdentity check(JWTClaimsSet c) throws InvalidTokenException {
    String project = props.projectId();
    Instant now = Instant.now();
    if (project == null || project.isBlank()) throw new InvalidTokenException("no project");
    if (c.getAudience() == null || !c.getAudience().equals(java.util.List.of(project)))
      throw new InvalidTokenException("audience");
    if (!("https://securetoken.google.com/" + project).equals(c.getIssuer()))
      throw new InvalidTokenException("issuer");
    Date exp = c.getExpirationTime();
    if (exp == null || exp.toInstant().isBefore(now.minusSeconds(SKEW_SECONDS)))
      throw new InvalidTokenException("expired");
    Date iat = c.getIssueTime();
    if (iat == null || iat.toInstant().isAfter(now.plusSeconds(SKEW_SECONDS)))
      throw new InvalidTokenException("issued in the future");
    String sub = c.getSubject();
    if (sub == null || sub.isEmpty() || sub.length() > 128) throw new InvalidTokenException("subject");
    try {
      String email = c.getStringClaim("email");
      Boolean verified = c.getBooleanClaim("email_verified");
      String name = c.getStringClaim("name");
      return new VerifiedIdentity(
          sub, email, Boolean.TRUE.equals(verified), name == null ? null : truncate(name, 200));
    } catch (ParseException e) {
      throw new InvalidTokenException("claims");
    }
  }

  private static String truncate(String s, int max) {
    return s.length() <= max ? s : s.substring(0, max);
  }
}

cat > AuthFilter.java <<'EOF'
package si.contacts.auth;

import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
import si.contacts.user.User;
import si.contacts.user.UserService;
import si.contacts.web.ErrorBody;
import si.contacts.web.Filters;

/** Requires a valid token on every API request except health; resolves the caller's User. */
public class AuthFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
  public static final String USER_ATTRIBUTE = "si.contacts.user";
  public static final String UID_ATTRIBUTE = "si.contacts.uid";
  private final TokenVerifier verifier;
  private final UserService users;

  public AuthFilter(TokenVerifier verifier, UserService users) {
    this.verifier = verifier;
    this.users = users;
  }

  @Override
  protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res, FilterChain chain)
      throws ServletException, IOException {
    if (Filters.isPublic(req) || "OPTIONS".equals(req.getMethod())) {
      chain.doFilter(req, res);
      return;
    }
    String header = req.getHeader("Authorization");
    if (header == null || !header.startsWith("Bearer ") || header.length() > 8192) {
      unauthorized(res);
      return;
    }
    VerifiedIdentity identity;
    try {
      identity = verifier.verify(header.substring(7).trim());
    } catch (InvalidTokenException e) {
      unauthorized(res);
      return;
    }
    req.setAttribute(UID_ATTRIBUTE, identity.uid());
    User user = users.signIn(identity);
    req.setAttribute(USER_ATTRIBUTE, user);
    chain.doFilter(req, res);
  }

  private static void unauthorized(HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException {
    res.setHeader("WWW-Authenticate", "Bearer");
    Filters.writeError(res, 401, ErrorBody.json("unauthorized"));
  }
}

package si.contacts.auth;

import org.springframework.core.MethodParameter;
import org.springframework.web.bind.support.WebDataBinderFactory;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.NativeWebRequest;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.RequestAttributes;
import org.springframework.web.method.support.HandlerMethodArgumentResolver;
import org.springframework.web.method.support.ModelAndViewContainer;
import si.contacts.user.User;

/** Injects the signed-in {@link User} into controller methods. */
public class CurrentUserResolver implements HandlerMethodArgumentResolver {
  @Override
  public boolean supportsParameter(MethodParameter p) {
    return p.getParameterType() == User.class;
  }

  @Override
  public Object resolveArgument(
      MethodParameter p, ModelAndViewContainer m, NativeWebRequest req, WebDataBinderFactory f) {
    Object u = req.getAttribute(AuthFilter.USER_ATTRIBUTE, RequestAttributes.SCOPE_REQUEST);
    if (u == null) throw new IllegalStateException("no signed-in user");
    return u;
  }
}

package si.contacts.auth;

import java.util.Arrays;
import org.springframework.context.ApplicationContextInitializer;
import org.springframework.context.ConfigurableApplicationContext;
import org.springframework.core.env.ConfigurableEnvironment;

/**
 * SR-02: in the {@code prod} profile the application refuses to start with the Auth emulator, a
 * {@code demo-} project id or no project id, before any bean is created.
 */
public class ProductionGuard implements ApplicationContextInitializer<ConfigurableApplicationContext> {
  @Override
  public void initialize(ConfigurableApplicationContext ctx) {
    ConfigurableEnvironment env = ctx.getEnvironment();
    if (!Arrays.asList(env.getActiveProfiles()).contains("prod")) return;
    String project = env.getProperty("app.auth.project-id", "").trim();
    boolean emulator = env.getProperty("app.auth.emulator", Boolean.class, false);
    boolean emulatorHost = !env.getProperty("FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST", "").isBlank();
    if (emulator || emulatorHost) fail("the Auth emulator is configured");
    if (project.isEmpty()) fail("no Firebase project id is configured");
    if (project.startsWith("demo-")) fail("a demo- project id is configured");
  }

  private static void fail(String why) {
    throw new IllegalStateException("Refusing to start in production: " + why);
  }
}
```

```bash
package si.contacts.user;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import si.contacts.auth.VerifiedIdentity;
import si.contacts.store.UserStore;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceAccess;

@Service
public class UserService {
  private final UserStore users;
  private final WorkspaceAccess access;

  public UserService(UserStore users, WorkspaceAccess access) {
    this.users = users;
    this.access = access;
  }

  /**
   * Creates the User on first sign-in, keeps email, verified flag and display name current, and
   * turns pending invitations for a verified email into memberships.
   */
  @Transactional
  public User signIn(VerifiedIdentity id) {
    User user = users.upsert(id.uid(), id.email(), id.emailVerified(), id.displayName());
    if (user.emailVerified() && user.email() != null) access.activateInvitations(user);
    return user;
  }
}

package si.contacts.workspace;

import java.util.UUID;
import si.contacts.user.User;
import si.contacts.web.ApiException;

/**
 * Proof that the caller is a Member of one Workspace, with their Role. Only {@link
 * WorkspaceAccess} creates it (ADR-0001), and every store of Workspace-owned data requires it.
 */
public final class WorkspaceScope {
  private final UUID workspaceId;
  private final User user;
  private final Role role;

  WorkspaceScope(UUID workspaceId, User user, Role role) {
    this.workspaceId = workspaceId;
    this.user = user;
    this.role = role;
  }

  public UUID workspaceId() {
    return workspaceId;
  }

  public User user() {
    return user;
  }

  public Role role() {
    return role;
  }

  /** 403 unless the caller has at least the Role. */
  public WorkspaceScope require(Role min) {
    if (!role.atLeast(min)) throw ApiException.forbidden();
    return this;
  }
}

package si.contacts.workspace;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import si.contacts.store.AccessStore;
import si.contacts.user.User;
import si.contacts.web.ApiException;

/**
 * The Workspace-scoped access layer (ADR-0001): the only way from a Workspace id and a caller to
 * a {@link WorkspaceScope}, decided by the membership stored in PostgreSQL.
 */
@Component
public class WorkspaceAccess {
  private final AccessStore store;

  public WorkspaceAccess(AccessStore store) {
    this.store = store;
  }

  /** The caller's scope in the Workspace; 404 for a non-Member exactly as for a missing one. */
  public WorkspaceScope open(UUID workspaceId, User caller) {
    return find(workspaceId, caller).orElseThrow(ApiException::notFound);
  }

  /** The same as {@link #open} but locks the Workspace row for membership changes. */
  public WorkspaceScope openForUpdate(UUID workspaceId, User caller) {
    store.lockWorkspace(workspaceId);
    return open(workspaceId, caller);
  }

  public Optional<WorkspaceScope> find(UUID workspaceId, User caller) {
    return store.roleOf(workspaceId, caller.id()).map(r -> new WorkspaceScope(workspaceId, caller, Role.valueOf(r)));
  }

  /** Creates a Workspace with the caller as Owner. */
  public WorkspaceScope create(User caller, String name) {
    UUID id = store.createWorkspace(name, caller.id());
    return new WorkspaceScope(id, caller, Role.OWNER);
  }

  public List<AccessStore.Membership> workspacesOf(User caller) {
    return store.workspacesOf(caller.id());
  }

  public void activateInvitations(User user) {
    store.activateInvitations(user.id(), user.email().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT));
  }
}

package si.contacts.store;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

/** Membership facts needed before a WorkspaceScope exists. Used only by WorkspaceAccess. */
@Repository
public class AccessStore {
  private final JdbcClient db;

  public AccessStore(JdbcClient db) {
    this.db = db;
  }

  public record Membership(UUID id, String name, String role) {}

  public Optional<String> roleOf(UUID workspaceId, UUID userId) {
    return db.sql("SELECT role FROM memberships WHERE workspace_id = ? AND user_id = ?")
        .params(workspaceId, userId)
        .query(String.class)
        .optional();
  }

  public void lockWorkspace(UUID workspaceId) {
    db.sql("SELECT id FROM workspaces WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE").param(workspaceId).query(UUID.class).optional();
  }

  public UUID createWorkspace(String name, UUID ownerId) {
    UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
    db.sql("INSERT INTO workspaces (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)").params(id, name).update();
    db.sql("INSERT INTO memberships (workspace_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'OWNER')").params(id, ownerId).update();
    return id;
  }

  public List<Membership> workspacesOf(UUID userId) {
    return db.sql(
            "SELECT w.id, w.name, m.role FROM memberships m JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = m.workspace_id"
                + " WHERE m.user_id = ? ORDER BY lower(w.name), w.id")
        .param(userId)
        .query((rs, i) -> new Membership(rs.getObject(1, UUID.class), rs.getString(2), rs.getString(3)))
        .list();
  }

  /** Turns pending invitations for the verified email into memberships, then removes them. */
  public void activateInvitations(UUID userId, String emailLower) {
    db.sql(
            "WITH taken AS (DELETE FROM invitations WHERE email_lower = ? RETURNING workspace_id, role)"
                + " INSERT INTO memberships (workspace_id, user_id, role)"
                + " SELECT workspace_id, ?, role FROM taken ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING")
        .params(emailLower, userId)
        .update();
  }
}

import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import si.contacts.user.User;

/** Users are not Workspace-owned; they are known by their sign-in identity. */
@Repository
public class UserStore {
  private final JdbcClient db;

  public UserStore(JdbcClient db) {
    this.db = db;
  }

  public User upsert(String uid, String email, boolean verified, String name) {
    return db.sql(
            "INSERT INTO users (id, firebase_uid, email, email_lower, email_verified, display_name)"
                + " VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)"
                + " ON CONFLICT (firebase_uid) DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email,"
                + " email_lower = EXCLUDED.email_lower, email_verified = EXCLUDED.email_verified,"
                + " display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name"
                + " RETURNING id, firebase_uid, email, email_verified, display_name")
        .params(UUID.randomUUID(), uid, email, email == null ? null : email.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), verified, name)
        .query(UserStore::map)
        .single();
  }

  public Optional<User> findVerifiedByEmail(String emailLower) {
    return db.sql(
            "SELECT id, firebase_uid, email, email_verified, display_name FROM users"
                + " WHERE email_lower = ? AND email_verified ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1")
        .param(emailLower)
        .query(UserStore::map)
        .optional();
  }

  static User map(ResultSet rs, int i) throws SQLException {
    return new User(
        rs.getObject("id", UUID.class),
        rs.getString("firebase_uid"),
        rs.getString("email"),
        rs.getBoolean("email_verified"),
        rs.getString("display_name"));
  }
}

package si.contacts.store;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/** The Workspace row itself, reached only through a WorkspaceScope. */
@Repository
public class WorkspaceStore {
  private final JdbcClient db;

  public WorkspaceStore(JdbcClient db) {
    this.db = db;
  }

  public String name(WorkspaceScope scope) {
    return db.sql("SELECT name FROM workspaces WHERE id = ?").param(scope.workspaceId()).query(String.class).single();
  }

  public void rename(WorkspaceScope scope, String name) {
    db.sql("UPDATE workspaces SET name = ? WHERE id = ?").params(name, scope.workspaceId()).update();
  }

  /** Removes the Workspace and, by cascade, everything it owns. */
  public void delete(WorkspaceScope scope) {
    db.sql("DELETE FROM workspaces WHERE id = ?").param(scope.workspaceId()).update();
  }
}
EOF

package si.contacts.web;

/** Input clean-up shared by all validations. */
public final class Text {
  private Text() {}

  /** Trims; a value of only whitespace becomes {@code null}. */
  public static String clean(Object value) {
    if (value == null) return null;
    String s = value.toString().strip();
    return s.isEmpty() ? null : s;
  }
}

package si.contacts.workspace;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PatchMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ResponseStatus;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import si.contacts.store.WorkspaceStore;
import si.contacts.user.User;
import si.contacts.web.ApiException;
import si.contacts.web.Text;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/workspaces")
public class WorkspaceController {
  static final int MAX_NAME = 100;
  private final WorkspaceAccess access;
  private final WorkspaceStore workspaces;

  public WorkspaceController(WorkspaceAccess access, WorkspaceStore workspaces) {
    this.access = access;
    this.workspaces = workspaces;
  }

  @GetMapping
  List<Map<String, Object>> list(User user) {
    return access.workspacesOf(user).stream().map(m -> view(m.id(), m.name(), m.role())).toList();
  }

  @PostMapping
  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  @Transactional
  Map<String, Object> create(User user, @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
    String name = name(body.get("name"));
    WorkspaceScope scope = access.create(user, name);
    return view(scope.workspaceId(), name, Role.OWNER.name());
  }

  @GetMapping("/{wid}")
  Map<String, Object> get(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user);
    return view(wid, workspaces.name(s), s.role().name());
  }

  @PatchMapping("/{wid}")
  @Transactional
  Map<String, Object> rename(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user).require(Role.OWNER);
    String name = name(body.get("name"));
    workspaces.rename(s, name);
    return view(wid, name, s.role().name());
  }

  @DeleteMapping("/{wid}")
  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  @Transactional
  void delete(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @RequestBody(required = false) Map<String, Object> body) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.openForUpdate(wid, user).require(Role.OWNER);
    Object confirm = body == null ? null : body.get("confirmName");
    if (!(confirm instanceof String c) || !c.equals(workspaces.name(s)))
      throw ApiException.badRequest("confirmName", "must equal the Workspace name exactly");
    workspaces.delete(s);
  }

  static String name(Object raw) {
    if (raw != null && !(raw instanceof String)) throw ApiException.badRequest("name", "must be text");
    String name = Text.clean(raw);
    if (name == null) throw ApiException.badRequest("name", "required");
    if (name.length() > MAX_NAME) throw ApiException.badRequest("name", "at most " + MAX_NAME + " characters");
    return name;
  }

  static Map<String, Object> view(UUID id, String name, String role) {
    Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    m.put("id", id);
    m.put("name", name);
    m.put("role", role);
    return m;
  }
}
```

```bash
package si.contacts;

import static com.tngtech.archunit.lang.syntax.ArchRuleDefinition.classes;
import static com.tngtech.archunit.lang.syntax.ArchRuleDefinition.methods;
import static com.tngtech.archunit.lang.syntax.ArchRuleDefinition.noClasses;

import com.tngtech.archunit.core.domain.JavaClasses;
import com.tngtech.archunit.core.domain.JavaMethod;
import com.tngtech.archunit.core.domain.JavaModifier;
import com.tngtech.archunit.core.importer.ClassFileImporter;
import com.tngtech.archunit.core.importer.ImportOption;
import com.tngtech.archunit.lang.ArchCondition;
import com.tngtech.archunit.lang.ConditionEvents;
import com.tngtech.archunit.lang.SimpleConditionEvent;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/** AR-04 / ADR-0001: Workspace-owned data is reached only through the Workspace-scoped access layer. */
class ArchitectureTest {
  static final JavaClasses PROD =
      new ClassFileImporter().withImportOption(ImportOption.Predefined.DO_NOT_INCLUDE_TESTS).importPackages("si.contacts");

  static final String[] UNSCOPED_STORES = {
    "si.contacts.store.UserStore", "si.contacts.store.AccessStore", "si.contacts.store.HealthStore"
  };

  @Test
  void onlyTheStorePackageTouchesTheDatabase() {
    noClasses()
        .that()
        .resideOutsideOfPackage("si.contacts.store..")
        .should()
        .dependOnClassesThat()
        .resideInAnyPackage("org.springframework.jdbc..", "java.sql..", "javax.sql..")
        .check(PROD);
  }

  @Test
  void everyStoreOfWorkspaceOwnedDataRequiresAWorkspaceScope() {
    methods()
        .that()
        .areDeclaredInClassesThat()
        .resideInAPackage("si.contacts.store..")
        .and()
        .areDeclaredInClassesThat()
        .haveSimpleNameEndingWith("Store")
        .and()
        .areDeclaredInClassesThat()
        .doNotHaveFullyQualifiedName(UNSCOPED_STORES[0])
        .and()
        .areDeclaredInClassesThat()
        .doNotHaveFullyQualifiedName(UNSCOPED_STORES[1])
        .and()
        .areDeclaredInClassesThat()
        .doNotHaveFullyQualifiedName(UNSCOPED_STORES[2])
        .and()
        .haveModifier(JavaModifier.PUBLIC)
        .should(takeAWorkspaceScopeFirst())
        .check(PROD);
  }

  @Test
  void onlyWorkspaceAccessUsesTheAccessStore() {
    classes()
        .that()
        .haveFullyQualifiedName("si.contacts.store.AccessStore")
        .should()
        .onlyBeAccessed()
        .byClassesThat()
        .haveFullyQualifiedName("si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceAccess")
        .check(PROD);
  }

  @Test
  void onlyWorkspaceAccessCreatesAWorkspaceScope() {
    noClasses()
        .that()
        .doNotHaveFullyQualifiedName("si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceAccess")
        .should()
        .callConstructor(WorkspaceScope.class, java.util.UUID.class, si.contacts.user.User.class, si.contacts.workspace.Role.class)
        .check(PROD);
  }

  static ArchCondition<JavaMethod> takeAWorkspaceScopeFirst() {
    return new ArchCondition<>("take a WorkspaceScope as first parameter") {
      @Override
      public void check(JavaMethod m, ConditionEvents events) {
        boolean ok =
            !m.getRawParameterTypes().isEmpty()
                && m.getRawParameterTypes().get(0).isEquivalentTo(WorkspaceScope.class);
        if (!ok) events.add(SimpleConditionEvent.violated(m, m.getFullName() + " does not take a WorkspaceScope first"));
      }
    };
  }
}
EOF
```

```bash
import { initializeApp } from 'firebase/app';
import {
  GoogleAuthProvider,
  connectAuthEmulator,
  createUserWithEmailAndPassword,
  getAuth,
  onAuthStateChanged,
  sendEmailVerification,
  signInWithEmailAndPassword,
  signInWithPopup,
  signOut,
  updateProfile,
} from 'firebase/auth';
import type { AuthService } from './auth';

export interface RuntimeConfig {
  apiKey: string;
  authDomain: string;
  projectId: string;
  authEmulatorUrl?: string;
}

/** Loads the Firebase configuration served next to the app (never built in, no secrets). */
export async function loadConfig(): Promise<RuntimeConfig> {
  const res = await fetch('/config.json', { cache: 'no-store' });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Missing /config.json');
  return (await res.json()) as RuntimeConfig;
}

export function firebaseAuth(config: RuntimeConfig): AuthService {
  const app = initializeApp({ apiKey: config.apiKey, authDomain: config.authDomain, projectId: config.projectId });
  const auth = getAuth(app);
  if (config.authEmulatorUrl) connectAuthEmulator(auth, config.authEmulatorUrl, { disableWarnings: true });
  return {
    onChange: (listener) =>
      onAuthStateChanged(auth, (u) =>
        listener(
          u
            ? { uid: u.uid, email: u.email, displayName: u.displayName, emailVerified: u.emailVerified }
            : null,
        ),
      ),
    signIn: async (email, password) => {
      await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
    },
    signUp: async (email, password, displayName) => {
      const cred = await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
      if (displayName) await updateProfile(cred.user, { displayName });
      await sendEmailVerification(cred.user);
      await cred.user.getIdToken(true);
    },
    signInWithGoogle: async () => {
      await signInWithPopup(auth, new GoogleAuthProvider());
    },
    signOut: () => signOut(auth),
    token: async () => (auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.getIdToken() : null),
  };
}

import { createContext, useContext } from 'react';
import type { Api } from './api';
import type { AuthService, AuthUser } from './auth';

export const ApiContext = createContext<Api | null>(null);
export const AuthContext = createContext<AuthService | null>(null);
export const UserContext = createContext<AuthUser | null>(null);

export function useApi(): Api {
  const api = useContext(ApiContext);
  if (!api) throw new Error('ApiContext missing');
  return api;
}

export function useAuth(): AuthService {
  const auth = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!auth) throw new Error('AuthContext missing');
  return auth;
}

export function useUser(): AuthUser | null {
  return useContext(UserContext);
}

const MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  required: 'Polje je obvezno.',
  'must be text': 'Vrednost mora biti besedilo.',
  'must be a valid email': 'Vnesite veljaven e-poštni naslov.',
  'must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code': 'Vnesite veljavno dvočrkovno kodo države (npr. SI).',
  'first name, last name or email is required': 'Vnesite vsaj ime, priimek ali e-pošto.',
  'must equal the Workspace name exactly': 'Ime se ne ujema natančno z imenom delovnega prostora.',
  'invalid key': 'Ključ mora se začeti s črko in vsebovati le črke, števke, _, . ali -.',
  'duplicate key': 'Ključ se ponavlja.',
  'reserved key': 'Ključ je enak imenu vnaprej določenega polja.',
  'too many attributes': 'Največ 100 atributov.',
  'invalid tag': 'Oznaka ne sme vsebovati presledkov in je dolga največ 50 znakov.',
  'duplicate tag': 'Oznaka se ponavlja.',
  'too many tags': 'Največ 50 oznak.',
  'outdated version': 'Kontakt je medtem spremenil nekdo drug. Osvežite stran.',
  'already a member or invited': 'Ta oseba je že član ali je že povabljena.',
  'a workspace needs an owner': 'Delovni prostor mora imeti vsaj enega lastnika.',
  'tag name taken': 'Oznaka s tem imenom že obstaja.',
  'contact is not deleted': 'Kontakt ni izbrisan.',
  'contact is deleted': 'Kontakt je izbrisan.',
  'not found': 'Ni najdeno.',
  forbidden: 'Za to dejanje nimate pravic.',
  'too many requests': 'Preveč zahtev. Poskusite znova čez minuto.',
  'request body too large': 'Zahteva je prevelika.',
  'invalid role': 'Neveljavna vloga.',
  'invalid selection': 'Neveljaven izbor kontaktov.',
  'too many contacts': 'Izvoz je omejen na 10.000 kontaktov.',
  'exactly one of contactIds and filter': 'Izberite kontakte ali uporabite filter.',
};

export function slMessage(message: string): string {
  if (MESSAGES[message]) return MESSAGES[message];
  const max = /^at most (\d+) characters$/.exec(message);
  if (max) return `Največ ${max[1]} znakov.`;
  const range = /^between (\d+) and (\d+)/.exec(message);
  if (range) return `Dovoljeno je od ${range[1]} do ${range[2]}.`;
  return 'Neveljavna vrednost.';
}

/** Field errors of a failed call, keyed by field, in Slovenian. */
export function fieldErrors(e: unknown): Record<string, string> {
  if (!(e instanceof ApiError)) return {};
  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  e.errors.forEach((err: FieldError) => {
    if (err.field && !out[err.field]) out[err.field] = slMessage(err.message);
  });
  return out;
}

/** One sentence for a failed call, in Slovenian. */
export function errorText(e: unknown): string {
  if (e instanceof ApiError) {
    if (e.status === 404) return 'Ni najdeno.';
    if (e.status === 403) return MESSAGES.forbidden;
    if (e.status === 429) return MESSAGES['too many requests'];
    const first = e.errors[0];
    if (first) return slMessage(first.message);
    return 'Prišlo je do napake.';
  }
  return 'Povezava s strežnikom ni uspela.';
}

cat > lib/useLoad.ts <<'EOF'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

/** Loads data on mount and whenever `deps` change; exposes reload. */
export function useLoad<T>(load: () => Promise<T>, deps: unknown[]) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const run = useCallback(load, deps);
  const reload = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      setData(await run());
      setError(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [run]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setLoading(true);
    run().then(
      (d) => {
        if (active) {
          setData(d);
          setError(null);
          setLoading(false);
        }
      },
      (e: unknown) => {
        if (active) {
          setError(e);
          setLoading(false);
        }
      },
    );
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [run]);
  return { data, error, loading, reload, setData };
}
```

```bash
import { useId, type InputHTMLAttributes } from 'react';

interface Props extends InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> {
  label: string;
  error?: string;
  multiline?: boolean;
}

/** A labelled input whose error is shown next to it and announced to screen readers. */
export function FormField({ label, error, multiline, id, ...rest }: Props) {
  const generated = useId();
  const fieldId = id ?? generated;
  const errorId = `${fieldId}-error`;
  const common = {
    id: fieldId,
    'aria-invalid': error ? true : undefined,
    'aria-describedby': error ? errorId : undefined,
  };
  return (
    <div className={`field${error ? ' has-error' : ''}`}>
      <label htmlFor={fieldId}>{label}</label>
      {multiline ? (
        <textarea
          {...common}
          name={rest.name}
          value={rest.value as string}
          onChange={rest.onChange as unknown as React.ChangeEventHandler<HTMLTextAreaElement>}
          rows={4}
        />
      ) : (
        <input {...common} {...rest} />
      )}
      {error && (
        <span className="error" id={errorId}>
          {error}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../lib/context';
import { FormField } from '../components/FormField';
import { Alert } from '../components/Alert';

export function SignInPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'signIn' | 'signUp'>('signIn');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function submit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (!email.trim() || password.length < 6) {
      setError('Vnesite e-pošto in geslo z vsaj 6 znaki.');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (mode === 'signIn') await auth.signIn(email.trim(), password);
      else await auth.signUp(email.trim(), password, name.trim());
    } catch {
      setError(mode === 'signIn' ? 'Prijava ni uspela. Preverite e-pošto in geslo.' : 'Registracija ni uspela.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function google() {
    setError(null);
    try {
      await auth.signInWithGoogle();
    } catch {
      setError('Prijava z Googlom ni uspela.');
    }
  }

  return (
    <main id="main" className="signin">
      <h1>{mode === 'signIn' ? 'Prijava' : 'Registracija'}</h1>
      <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
        {mode === 'signUp' && (
          <FormField label="Ime in priimek" name="name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
        )}
        <FormField
          label="E-pošta"
          name="email"
          type="email"
          autoComplete="email"
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
        />
        <FormField
          label="Geslo"
          name="password"
          type="password"
          autoComplete={mode === 'signIn' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password'}
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
        />
        {error && <Alert>{error}</Alert>}
        <button type="submit" className="primary" disabled={busy}>
          {mode === 'signIn' ? 'Prijava' : 'Registracija'}
        </button>
      </form>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => void google()}>
        Prijava z Googlom
      </button>
      <p>
        {mode === 'signIn' ? 'Še nimate računa? ' : 'Že imate račun? '}
        <button type="button" className="link" onClick={() => setMode(mode === 'signIn' ? 'signUp' : 'signIn')}>
          {mode === 'signIn' ? 'Registracija' : 'Prijava'}
        </button>
      </p>
    </main>
  );
}

interface WorkspaceCtx {

}

const Ctx = createContext<WorkspaceCtx | null>(null);

export function useWorkspace(): WorkspaceCtx {
  const w = useContext(Ctx);
  if (!w) throw new Error('outside workspace');
  return w;
}

export function WorkspaceLayout() {
  const { wid = '' } = useParams();
  const api = useApi();
  const ws = useLoad(() => api.getWorkspace(wid), [api, wid]);

  const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState<string>();

  if (!can(workspace.role, 'OWNER')) return <Alert>Za to stran nimate pravic.</Alert>;

  async function rename(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaved(false);
    if (!name.trim()) return setNameError('Polje je obvezno.');
    try {
      await api.renameWorkspace(workspace.id, name.trim());
      setNameError(undefined);
      setSaved(true);
      await reload();
    } catch (err) {
      setNameError(fieldErrors(err).name ?? errorText(err));
    }
  }

  async function remove(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (confirm !== workspace.name) return setDeleteError('Ime se ne ujema natančno z imenom delovnega prostora.');
    try {
      await api.deleteWorkspace(workspace.id, confirm);
      navigate('/');
    } catch (err) {
      setDeleteError(fieldErrors(err).confirmName ?? errorText(err));
    }
  }

  return (
    <section>
      <h1>Nastavitve</h1>
      <form onSubmit={rename} noValidate>
        <h2>Preimenuj</h2>
        <FormField label="Ime delovnega prostora" name="name" value={name} error={nameError} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
        {saved && <Alert kind="info">Shranjeno.</Alert>}
        <button type="submit" className="primary">
          Shrani
        </button>
      </form>
      <form onSubmit={remove} noValidate className="danger-zone">
        <h2>Izbriši delovni prostor</h2>
        <p>
          Izbris je trajen: odstrani vse kontakte, njihove revizije, oznake, člane in povabila. Za potrditev vpišite
          natančno ime <strong>{workspace.name}</strong>.
        </p>
        <FormField label="Ime za potrditev" name="confirmName" value={confirm} error={deleteError} onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)} />
        <button type="submit" className="danger">
          Trajno izbriši
        </button>
      </form>
    </section>
  );
}
EOF
```

```bash
import { render } from '@testing-library/react';
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import { App } from '../src/App';
import type { Api, Contact, Workspace } from '../src/lib/api';
import type { AuthService, AuthUser } from '../src/lib/auth';

export const USER: AuthUser = { uid: 'u1', email: 'ana@example.si', displayName: 'Ana', emailVerified: true };

export function fakeAuth(initial: AuthUser | null = USER) {
  let listener: (u: AuthUser | null) => void = () => {};
  const auth: AuthService & { emit: (u: AuthUser | null) => void } = {
    onChange: (l) => {
      listener = l;
      l(initial);
      return () => {};
    },
    signIn: vi.fn(async () => {}),
    signUp: vi.fn(async () => {}),
    signInWithGoogle: vi.fn(async () => {}),
    signOut: vi.fn(async () => listener(null)),
    token: async () => 'token',
    emit: (u) => listener(u),
  };
  return auth;
}

const reject = () => vi.fn(async () => Promise.reject(new Error('not faked')));

export function fakeApi(overrides: Partial<Api> = {}): Api {
  const base: Api = {
    me: vi.fn(async () => ({ id: 'u1', email: USER.email, emailVerified: true, displayName: 'Ana' })),
    listWorkspaces: vi.fn(async () => []),
    createWorkspace: reject(),
    getWorkspace: reject(),
    renameWorkspace: reject(),
    deleteWorkspace: reject(),
    listMembers: vi.fn(async () => ({ members: [], invitations: [] })),
    addMember: reject(),
    changeRole: reject(),
    removeMember: reject(),
    cancelInvitation: reject(),
    listContacts: vi.fn(async () => ({ items: [], total: 0, page: 0, size: 20 })),
    getContact: reject(),
    createContact: reject(),
    updateContact: reject(),
    deleteContact: reject(),
    restoreContact: reject(),
    purgeContact: reject(),
    listRevisions: vi.fn(async () => []),
    restoreRevision: reject(),
    listTags: vi.fn(async () => []),
    renameTag: reject(),
    deleteTag: reject(),
    listDuplicateSets: vi.fn(async () => []),
    merge: reject(),
    exportContacts: reject(),
  };
  return { ...base, ...overrides };
}

export function workspace(role: Workspace['role'] = 'OWNER', name = 'Projekt'): Workspace {
  return { id: 'w1', name, role };
}

export function contact(over: Partial<Contact> = {}): Contact {
  return {
    id: 'c1',
    version: 1,
    deleted: false,
    mergedInto: null,
    firstName: 'Saša',
    lastName: 'Novak',
    email: 'sasa@example.si',
    phone: null,
    company: null,
    jobTitle: null,
    street: null,
    postalCode: null,
    city: null,
    country: null,
    note: null,
    attributes: [],
    tags: [],
    createdAt: '2026-01-01T10:00:00Z',
    updatedAt: '2026-01-01T10:00:00Z',
    ...over,
  };
}

export function renderApp(path: string, api: Api, auth = fakeAuth()) {
  return {
    auth,
    ...render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[path]}>
        <App api={api} auth={auth} />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    ),
  };
}
```
