import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { ApiError } from '../src/lib/api';
import { fakeApi, fakeAuth, renderApp, workspace } from './helpers';

describe('AC-001-04 sign-in and sign-out', () => {
  it('shows the sign-in page on every URL when signed out', () => {
    for (const path of ['/', '/w/w1', '/w/w1/kontakti/c1', '/anything']) {
      const { unmount } = renderApp(path, fakeApi(), fakeAuth(null));
      expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Prijava' })).toBeInTheDocument();
      unmount();
    }
  });

  it('signs in with email and password', async () => {
    const auth = fakeAuth(null);
    renderApp('/', fakeApi(), auth);
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText('E-pošta'), 'ana@example.si');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText('Geslo'), 'geslo123');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Prijava' }));
    expect(auth.signIn).toHaveBeenCalledWith('ana@example.si', 'geslo123');
  });

  it('signs up with name, email and password', async () => {
    const auth = fakeAuth(null);
    renderApp('/', fakeApi(), auth);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registracija' }));
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText('Ime in priimek'), 'Ana Kos');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText('E-pošta'), 'ana@example.si');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText('Geslo'), 'geslo123');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registracija' }));
    expect(auth.signUp).toHaveBeenCalledWith('ana@example.si', 'geslo123', 'Ana Kos');
  });

  it('after sign-out the page shows the sign-in page', async () => {
    const api = fakeApi({ listWorkspaces: vi.fn(async () => [workspace()]) });
    renderApp('/', api);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('link', { name: 'Projekt' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Odjava' }));
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Prijava' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: 'Projekt' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe('AC-002 Workspaces', () => {
  it('lists the Workspaces with the Role', async () => {
    const api = fakeApi({ listWorkspaces: vi.fn(async () => [workspace('VIEWER', 'Bralni')]) });
    renderApp('/', api);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('link', { name: 'Bralni' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Bralec')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('creates a Workspace and refuses an empty name without calling the API', async () => {
    const createWorkspace = vi.fn(async () => workspace());
    const api = fakeApi({ createWorkspace });
    renderApp('/', api);
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Ustvari' }));
    expect(screen.getByText('Polje je obvezno.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(createWorkspace).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText('Ime'), 'Nov projekt');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ustvari' }));
    expect(createWorkspace).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Nov projekt');
  });

  it('shows the API field error next to the name', async () => {
    const api = fakeApi({
      createWorkspace: vi.fn(async () => {
        throw new ApiError(400, [{ field: 'name', message: 'at most 100 characters' }]);
      }),
    });
    renderApp('/', api);
    await userEvent.type(await screen.findByLabelText('Ime'), 'x');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ustvari' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Največ 100 znakov.')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('an Owner renames the Workspace in the settings', async () => {
    const renameWorkspace = vi.fn(async () => workspace('OWNER', 'Novo'));
    const api = fakeApi({ getWorkspace: vi.fn(async () => workspace()), renameWorkspace });
    renderApp('/w/w1/nastavitve', api);
    const input = await screen.findByLabelText('Ime delovnega prostora');
    await userEvent.clear(input);
    await userEvent.type(input, 'Novo');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Shrani' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(renameWorkspace).toHaveBeenCalledWith('w1', 'Novo'));
  });

  it('a non-Member sees the not-found page', async () => {
    const api = fakeApi({
      getWorkspace: vi.fn(async () => {
        throw new ApiError(404, [{ field: null, message: 'not found' }]);
      }),
    });
    renderApp('/w/w1', api);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Ni najdeno' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

    listen 8080 default_server;
    server_name _;

package si.contacts.store;

import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/** Members and invitations of one Workspace. */
@Repository
public class MemberStore {
  private final JdbcClient db;

  public MemberStore(JdbcClient db) {
    this.db = db;
  }

  public record MemberRow(UUID userId, String email, String displayName, String role) {}

  public record InvitationRow(UUID id, String email, String role, OffsetDateTime createdAt) {}

  public List<MemberRow> members(WorkspaceScope s) {
    return db.sql(
            "SELECT u.id, u.email, u.display_name, m.role FROM memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id"
                + " WHERE m.workspace_id = ? ORDER BY lower(coalesce(u.display_name, u.email)), u.id")
        .param(s.workspaceId())
        .query((rs, i) -> new MemberRow(rs.getObject(1, UUID.class), rs.getString(2), rs.getString(3), rs.getString(4)))
        .list();
  }

  public Optional<MemberRow> member(WorkspaceScope s, UUID userId) {
    return members(s).stream().filter(m -> m.userId().equals(userId)).findFirst();
  }

  public List<InvitationRow> invitations(WorkspaceScope s) {
    return db.sql("SELECT id, email, role, created_at FROM invitations WHERE workspace_id = ? ORDER BY created_at, id")
        .param(s.workspaceId())
        .query(
            (rs, i) ->
                new InvitationRow(
                    rs.getObject(1, UUID.class), rs.getString(2), rs.getString(3), rs.getObject(4, OffsetDateTime.class)))
        .list();
  }

  /** Whether a Member with this email (ignoring case) or an invitation for it exists. */
  public boolean memberOrInvited(WorkspaceScope s, String emailLower) {
    return db.sql(
            "SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id"
                + " WHERE m.workspace_id = ? AND u.email_lower = ?)"
                + " OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invitations WHERE workspace_id = ? AND email_lower = ?)")
        .params(s.workspaceId(), emailLower, s.workspaceId(), emailLower)
        .query(Boolean.class)
        .single();
  }

  public boolean isMember(WorkspaceScope s, UUID userId) {
    return db.sql("SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships WHERE workspace_id = ? AND user_id = ?)")
        .params(s.workspaceId(), userId)
        .query(Boolean.class)
        .single();
  }

  public void addMember(WorkspaceScope s, UUID userId, String role) {
    db.sql("INSERT INTO memberships (workspace_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)").params(s.workspaceId(), userId, role).update();
  }

  public InvitationRow invite(WorkspaceScope s, String email, String role) {
    UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
    return db.sql(
            "INSERT INTO invitations (id, workspace_id, email, email_lower, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?, lower(?), ?)"
                + " RETURNING id, email, role, created_at")
        .params(id, s.workspaceId(), email, email, role)
        .query(
            (rs, i) ->
                new InvitationRow(
                    rs.getObject(1, UUID.class), rs.getString(2), rs.getString(3), rs.getObject(4, OffsetDateTime.class)))
        .single();
  }

  public int owners(WorkspaceScope s) {
    return db.sql("SELECT count(*) FROM memberships WHERE workspace_id = ? AND role = 'OWNER'")
        .param(s.workspaceId())
        .query(Integer.class)
        .single();
  }

  public void changeRole(WorkspaceScope s, UUID userId, String role) {
    db.sql("UPDATE memberships SET role = ? WHERE workspace_id = ? AND user_id = ?").params(role, s.workspaceId(), userId).update();
  }

  public void remove(WorkspaceScope s, UUID userId) {
    db.sql("DELETE FROM memberships WHERE workspace_id = ? AND user_id = ?").params(s.workspaceId(), userId).update();
  }

  public boolean cancelInvitation(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id) {
    return db.sql("DELETE FROM invitations WHERE workspace_id = ? AND id = ?").params(s.workspaceId(), id).update() > 0;
  }
}

package si.contacts.web;

import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/** A pragmatic email check: one @, a dotted domain, no whitespace, at most 254 characters. */
public final class Emails {
  private static final Pattern EMAIL =
      Pattern.compile("^[^@\\s\"(),:;<>\\[\\\\\\]]+@[^@\\s\"(),:;<>\\[\\\\\\]]+\\.[^@\\s\"(),:;<>\\[\\\\\\].]{2,}$");
  public static final int MAX = 254;

  private Emails() {}

  public static boolean valid(String email) {
    return email != null && email.length() <= MAX && EMAIL.matcher(email).matches() && !email.contains("..");
  }
}

package si.contacts.workspace;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PatchMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ResponseStatus;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import si.contacts.store.MemberStore;
import si.contacts.store.MemberStore.InvitationRow;
import si.contacts.store.MemberStore.MemberRow;
import si.contacts.store.UserStore;
import si.contacts.user.User;
import si.contacts.web.ApiException;
import si.contacts.web.Emails;
import si.contacts.web.Text;

/** US-003: an Owner shares the Workspace; a Workspace always keeps at least one Owner. */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/workspaces/{wid}")
public class MemberController {
  private final WorkspaceAccess access;
  private final MemberStore members;
  private final UserStore users;

  public MemberController(WorkspaceAccess access, MemberStore members, UserStore users) {
    this.access = access;
    this.members = members;
    this.users = users;
  }

  @GetMapping("/members")
  Map<String, Object> list(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user);
    return Map.of(
        "members", members.members(s).stream().map(MemberController::view).toList(),
        "invitations", members.invitations(s).stream().map(MemberController::view).toList());
  }

  @PostMapping("/members")
  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  @Transactional
  Map<String, Object> add(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.openForUpdate(wid, user).require(Role.OWNER);
    String email = Text.clean(body.get("email") instanceof String e ? e : null);
    if (email == null) throw ApiException.badRequest("email", "required");
    if (!Emails.valid(email)) throw ApiException.badRequest("email", "must be a valid email");
    Role role = role(body.get("role"));
    String lower = email.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    if (members.memberOrInvited(s, lower)) throw ApiException.conflict("email", "already a member or invited");
    var existing = users.findVerifiedByEmail(lower);
    if (existing.isPresent()) {
      User u = existing.get();
      if (members.isMember(s, u.id())) throw ApiException.conflict("email", "already a member or invited");
      members.addMember(s, u.id(), role.name());
      return Map.of("status", "MEMBER", "member", view(members.member(s, u.id()).orElseThrow()));
    }
    return Map.of("status", "INVITED", "invitation", view(members.invite(s, email, role.name())));
  }

  @PatchMapping("/members/{userId}")
  @Transactional
  Map<String, Object> changeRole(
      User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable UUID userId, @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.openForUpdate(wid, user).require(Role.OWNER);
    Role role = role(body.get("role"));
    MemberRow target = members.member(s, userId).orElseThrow(ApiException::notFound);
    if (target.role().equals("OWNER") && role != Role.OWNER && members.owners(s) <= 1)
      throw ApiException.conflict("role", "a workspace needs an owner");
    members.changeRole(s, userId, role.name());
    return view(members.member(s, userId).orElseThrow());
  }

  @DeleteMapping("/members/{userId}")
  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  @Transactional
  void remove(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable UUID userId) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.openForUpdate(wid, user);
    if (!userId.equals(user.id())) s.require(Role.OWNER);
    MemberRow target = members.member(s, userId).orElseThrow(ApiException::notFound);
    if (target.role().equals("OWNER") && members.owners(s) <= 1)
      throw ApiException.conflict(null, "a workspace needs an owner");
    members.remove(s, userId);
  }

  @DeleteMapping("/invitations/{id}")
  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  @Transactional
  void cancel(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable UUID id) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user).require(Role.OWNER);
    if (!members.cancelInvitation(s, id)) throw ApiException.notFound();
  }

  static Role role(Object raw) {
    if (raw instanceof String r) {
      try {
        return Role.valueOf(r);
      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
        // fall through
      }
    }
    throw ApiException.badRequest("role", "invalid role");
  }

  static Map<String, Object> view(MemberRow m) {
    Map<String, Object> v = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    v.put("userId", m.userId());
    v.put("email", m.email());
    v.put("displayName", m.displayName());
    v.put("role", m.role());
    return v;
  }

  static Map<String, Object> view(InvitationRow i) {
    Map<String, Object> v = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    v.put("id", i.id());
    v.put("email", i.email());
    v.put("role", i.role());
    v.put("createdAt", i.createdAt());
    return v;
  }
}

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import type { Role } from '../lib/api';
import { useApi, useUser } from '../lib/context';
import { useLoad } from '../lib/useLoad';
import { errorText, fieldErrors } from '../lib/messages';
import { ROLE_LABEL, can } from '../lib/roles';
import { FormField } from '../components/FormField';
import { Alert } from '../components/Alert';
import { useWorkspace } from './WorkspaceLayout';

const ROLES: Role[] = ['OWNER', 'EDITOR', 'VIEWER'];

export function MembersPage() {
  const api = useApi();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const me = useLoad(() => api.me(), [api]);
  const { workspace } = useWorkspace();
  const user = useUser();
  const isOwner = can(workspace.role, 'OWNER');
  const list = useLoad(() => api.listMembers(workspace.id), [api, workspace.id]);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [role, setRole] = useState<Role>('VIEWER');
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function act(fn: () => Promise<unknown>, after?: () => void) {
    setActionError(null);
    try {
      await fn();
      if (after) after();
      else await list.reload();
    } catch (e) {
      setActionError(errorText(e));
    }
  }

  async function add(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setMessage(null);
    if (!email.trim()) return setErrors({ email: 'Polje je obvezno.' });
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email.trim())) return setErrors({ email: 'Vnesite veljaven e-poštni naslov.' });
    try {
      const r = await api.addMember(workspace.id, email.trim(), role);
      setMessage(r.status === 'MEMBER' ? 'Član je dodan.' : 'Povabilo je ustvarjeno; velja po prijavi s potrjeno e-pošto.');
      setEmail('');
      setErrors({});
      await list.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      const f = fieldErrors(err);
      setErrors(Object.keys(f).length ? f : { email: errorText(err) });
    }
  }

  return (
    <section>
      <h1>Člani</h1>
      {list.error ? <Alert>{errorText(list.error)}</Alert> : null}
      {actionError && <Alert>{actionError}</Alert>}
      {list.data && (
        <table>
          <caption className="sr-only">Člani delovnega prostora</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">Ime</th>
              <th scope="col">E-pošta</th>
              <th scope="col">Vloga</th>
              <th scope="col">Dejanja</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {list.data.members.map((m) => {
              const self = me.data?.id === m.userId || (!me.data && m.email === user?.email);
              return (
                <tr key={m.userId}>
                  <td>{m.displayName ?? '—'}</td>
                  <td>{m.email}</td>
                  <td>
                    {isOwner ? (
                      <select
                        aria-label={`Vloga za ${m.email ?? m.displayName ?? ''}`}
                        value={m.role}
                        onChange={(e) => void act(() => api.changeRole(workspace.id, m.userId, e.target.value as Role))}
                      >
                        {ROLES.map((r) => (
                          <option key={r} value={r}>
                            {ROLE_LABEL[r]}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    ) : (
                      ROLE_LABEL[m.role]
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    {self ? (
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => void act(() => api.removeMember(workspace.id, m.userId), () => navigate('/'))}>
                        Zapusti delovni prostor
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      isOwner && (
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => void act(() => api.removeMember(workspace.id, m.userId))}>
                          Odstrani
                        </button>
                      )
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}
      <h2>Čakajoča povabila</h2>
      {list.data && list.data.invitations.length === 0 && <p>Ni čakajočih povabil.</p>}
      {list.data && list.data.invitations.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="cards">
          {list.data.invitations.map((i) => (
            <li key={i.id}>
              {i.email} <span className="badge">{ROLE_LABEL[i.role]}</span>{' '}
              {isOwner && (
                <button type="button" onClick={() => void act(() => api.cancelInvitation(workspace.id, i.id))}>
                  Prekliči povabilo
                </button>
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {isOwner && (
        <form onSubmit={add} noValidate className="inline">
          <h2>Dodaj člana</h2>
          <FormField label="E-pošta člana" name="email" type="email" value={email} error={errors.email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
          <div className="field">
            <label htmlFor="new-role">Vloga</label>
            <select id="new-role" value={role} onChange={(e) => setRole(e.target.value as Role)}>
              {ROLES.map((r) => (
                <option key={r} value={r}>
                  {ROLE_LABEL[r]}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          {message && <Alert kind="info">{message}</Alert>}
          <button type="submit" className="primary">
            Dodaj
          </button>
        </form>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import { screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { Api } from '../src/lib/api';
import { fakeApi, renderApp, workspace } from './helpers';

const members = {
  members: [
    { userId: 'u1', email: 'ana@example.si', displayName: 'Ana', role: 'OWNER' as const },
    { userId: 'u2', email: 'bor@example.si', displayName: 'Bor', role: 'VIEWER' as const },
  ],
  invitations: [{ id: 'i1', email: 'nova@example.si', role: 'EDITOR' as const, createdAt: '2026-01-01' }],
};

function api(role: 'OWNER' | 'EDITOR' | 'VIEWER', over: Partial<Api> = {}) {
  return fakeApi({ getWorkspace: vi.fn(async () => workspace(role)), listMembers: vi.fn(async () => members), ...over });
}

describe('Members page', () => {
  it('shows Members and pending invitations', async () => {
    renderApp('/w/w1/clani', api('VIEWER'));
    expect(await screen.findByText('bor@example.si')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('nova@example.si')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('hides member management from Editors and Viewers, but lets them leave', async () => {
    for (const role of ['EDITOR', 'VIEWER'] as const) {
      const { unmount } = renderApp('/w/w1/clani', api(role));
      await screen.findByText('bor@example.si');
      expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Dodaj' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Odstrani' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Prekliči povabilo' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.queryByRole('combobox')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: 'Nastavitve' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Zapusti delovni prostor' })).toBeInTheDocument();
      unmount();
    }
  });

  it('an Owner adds a Member by email with a Role', async () => {
    const addMember = vi.fn(async () => ({ status: 'INVITED' as const }));
    renderApp('/w/w1/clani', api('OWNER', { addMember }));
    await userEvent.type(await screen.findByLabelText('E-pošta člana'), 'cene@example.si');
    await userEvent.selectOptions(screen.getByLabelText('Vloga'), 'EDITOR');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dodaj' }));
    expect(addMember).toHaveBeenCalledWith('w1', 'cene@example.si', 'EDITOR');
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Povabilo je ustvarjeno/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('an Owner changes a Role, removes a Member and cancels an invitation', async () => {
    const changeRole = vi.fn(async () => members.members[1]);
    const removeMember = vi.fn(async () => {});
    const cancelInvitation = vi.fn(async () => {});
    renderApp('/w/w1/clani', api('OWNER', { changeRole, removeMember, cancelInvitation }));
    await userEvent.selectOptions(await screen.findByLabelText('Vloga za bor@example.si'), 'EDITOR');
    expect(changeRole).toHaveBeenCalledWith('w1', 'u2', 'EDITOR');
    const row = screen.getByText('bor@example.si').closest('tr')!;
    await userEvent.click(within(row).getByRole('button', { name: 'Odstrani' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(removeMember).toHaveBeenCalledWith('w1', 'u2'));
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Prekliči povabilo' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(cancelInvitation).toHaveBeenCalledWith('w1', 'i1'));
  });
});

package si.contacts.acceptance;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import si.contacts.support.Api;
import si.contacts.support.ApiTestBase;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;

/** US-005: Contacts with Predefined fields, Revisions and version checks. */
class ContactApiTest extends ApiTestBase {
  TestUser owner;
  String w;
  String contacts;

  @BeforeEach
  void workspace() {
    owner = user("Owner");
    w = createWorkspace(owner, "Kontakti");
    contacts = "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts";
  }

  static Map<String, Object> full() {
    return contact(
        "firstName", "Saša", "lastName", "Novak", "email", "sasa.novak@example.si", "phone", "+386 41 123 456",
        "company", "Podjetje d.o.o.", "jobTitle", "Vodja projektov", "street", "Slovenska cesta 1",
        "postalCode", "1000", "city", "Ljubljana", "country", "SI", "note", "Srečala na konferenci.");
  }

  @Test
  void AC_005_01_aValidContactIsCreatedWithVersion1AndEveryValueStored() {
    Api.Res r = api.post(owner.token(), contacts, full());
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(201);
    JsonNode c = r.json();
    assertThat(c.get("version").asInt()).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(c.get("deleted").asBoolean()).isFalse();
    full().forEach((k, v) -> assertThat(c.get(k).asText()).as(k).isEqualTo(v));
    JsonNode read = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + c.get("id").asText()).json();
    full().forEach((k, v) -> assertThat(read.get(k).asText()).as(k).isEqualTo(v));
    assertThat(read.get("version").asInt()).isEqualTo(1);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_005_02_aContactWithoutFirstNameLastNameAndEmailIsRejected() {
    Api.Res r = api.post(owner.token(), contacts, contact("company", "Samo podjetje", "firstName", "   "));
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(400);
    assertThat(errorFields(r)).contains("firstName");
    for (String only : new String[] {"firstName", "lastName", "email"}) {
      Object value = only.equals("email") ? "a@example.si" : "Ime";
      assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), contacts, contact(only, value)).status()).as(only).isEqualTo(201);
    }
  }

  @Test
  void AC_005_03_leadingAndTrailingSpacesAreRemovedAndBlankValuesBecomeAbsent() {
    JsonNode c = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "  Ana  ", "lastName", "\tKos ", "city", "   "));
    assertThat(c.get("firstName").asText()).isEqualTo("Ana");
    assertThat(c.get("lastName").asText()).isEqualTo("Kos");
    assertThat(c.get("city").isNull()).isTrue();
  }

  @Test
  void AC_005_04_invalidEmailUnknownCountryOrOverlongValuesAreRejectedWithTheFieldsError() {
    Api.Res r =
        api.post(
            owner.token(),
            contacts,
            contact("firstName", "x".repeat(101), "email", "ni-email", "country", "XX", "note", "n".repeat(2001)));
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(400);
    assertThat(errorFields(r)).containsExactlyInAnyOrder("firstName", "email", "country", "note");
    JsonNode c = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "Ana", "country", "si"));
    assertThat(c.get("country").asText()).isEqualTo("SI");
    assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), contacts, contact("firstName", 12)).status()).isEqualTo(400);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_005_05_slovenianCharactersSurviveUnchanged() {
    String text = "čšž ČŠŽ ćđ ĆĐ";
    JsonNode c = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "Čedomir", "lastName", "Šuštaršič", "city", "Žalec", "note", text));
    JsonNode read = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + c.get("id").asText()).json();
    assertThat(read.get("firstName").asText()).isEqualTo("Čedomir");
    assertThat(read.get("lastName").asText()).isEqualTo("Šuštaršič");
    assertThat(read.get("city").asText()).isEqualTo("Žalec");
    assertThat(read.get("note").asText()).isEqualTo(text);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_005_06_anUpdateNamingTheCurrentVersionIsAppliedAndAnOutdatedVersionGets409() {
    JsonNode c = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "Ana"));
    String path = contacts + "/" + c.get("id").asText();
    Map<String, Object> body = contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Ana", "lastName", "Kos");
    Api.Res ok = api.put(owner.token(), path, body);
    assertThat(ok.status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(ok.json().get("version").asInt()).isEqualTo(2);
    assertThat(ok.json().get("lastName").asText()).isEqualTo("Kos");
    Api.Res stale = api.put(owner.token(), path, contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Stara"));
    assertThat(stale.status()).isEqualTo(409);
    JsonNode now = api.get(owner.token(), path).json();
    assertThat(now.get("firstName").asText()).isEqualTo("Ana");
    assertThat(now.get("version").asInt()).isEqualTo(2);
    Api.Res missing = api.put(owner.token(), path, contact("firstName", "Brez"));
    assertThat(missing.status()).isEqualTo(400);
    assertThat(errorFields(missing)).containsExactly("version");
  }

  @Test
  void AC_005_07_deleteHidesTheContactAndWritesADeleteRevision() {
    JsonNode c = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "Brisani"));
    String id = c.get("id").asText();
    assertThat(api.delete(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "?version=1").status()).isEqualTo(204);
    JsonNode list = api.get(owner.token(), contacts).json();
    assertThat(list.get("items").valueStream().map(i -> i.get("id").asText())).doesNotContain(id);
    JsonNode read = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id).json();
    assertThat(read.get("deleted").asBoolean()).isTrue();
    assertThat(read.get("version").asInt()).isEqualTo(2);
    JsonNode revs = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions").json();
    assertThat(revs.get(0).get("type").asText()).isEqualTo("DELETE");
    assertThat(revs.get(0).get("number").asInt()).isEqualTo(2);
    assertThat(api.delete(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id).status()).isEqualTo(409);
  }

  @Test
  void deleteWithAnOutdatedVersionGets409() {
    String id = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "X")).get("id").asText();
    api.put(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id, contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Y"));
    assertThat(api.delete(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "?version=1").status()).isEqualTo(409);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_005_08_aViewerCannotCreateUpdateDeleteOrRestore() {
    TestUser viewer = user("Viewer");
    addMember(owner, w, viewer, "VIEWER");
    String id = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "Ana")).get("id").asText();
    String path = contacts + "/" + id;
    assertThat(api.post(viewer.token(), contacts, contact("firstName", "V")).status()).isEqualTo(403);
    assertThat(api.put(viewer.token(), path, contact("version", 1, "firstName", "V")).status()).isEqualTo(403);
    assertThat(api.delete(viewer.token(), path).status()).isEqualTo(403);
    assertThat(api.post(viewer.token(), path + "/restore", null).status()).isEqualTo(403);
    assertThat(api.post(viewer.token(), path + "/revisions/1/restore", Map.of("version", 1)).status()).isEqualTo(403);
    assertThat(api.get(viewer.token(), path).status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(api.get(viewer.token(), path).json().get("version").asInt()).isEqualTo(1);
  }

  @Test
  void anEditorCanChangeContacts() {
    TestUser editor = user("Editor");
    addMember(owner, w, editor, "EDITOR");
    String id = createContact(editor, w, contact("firstName", "Ana")).get("id").asText();
    assertThat(api.put(editor.token(), contacts + "/" + id, contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Ana B")).status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(api.delete(editor.token(), contacts + "/" + id).status()).isEqualTo(204);
  }

  @Test
  void anUnknownContactGets404() {
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + java.util.UUID.randomUUID()).status()).isEqualTo(404);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/nope").status()).isEqualTo(404);
  }
}

  sort_company  VARCHAR(200),
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX contacts_ws_active ON contacts (workspace_id, deleted, sort_last, sort_first, id);
CREATE INDEX contacts_ws_updated ON contacts (workspace_id, deleted, updated_at);
CREATE INDEX contacts_email_norm ON contacts (workspace_id, email_norm) WHERE NOT deleted;
CREATE INDEX contacts_phone_norm ON contacts (workspace_id, phone_norm) WHERE NOT deleted;
CREATE INDEX contacts_name_norm ON contacts (workspace_id, name_norm) WHERE NOT deleted;
CREATE INDEX contacts_search_trgm ON contacts USING gin (search_text gin_trgm_ops);

CREATE TABLE contact_attributes (
  contact_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position    INTEGER NOT NULL,
  key         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  key_lower   VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  value       VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (contact_id, position),
  UNIQUE (contact_id, key_lower)
);
CREATE INDEX contact_attributes_key ON contact_attributes (key_lower, contact_id);

CREATE TABLE tags (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  name_lower    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (workspace_id, name_lower)
);

CREATE TABLE contact_tags (
  contact_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  tag_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position    INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (contact_id, tag_id)
);
CREATE INDEX contact_tags_tag ON contact_tags (tag_id, contact_id);

CREATE TABLE revisions (
  contact_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  workspace_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  number        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  type          VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('CREATE', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'RESTORE', 'MERGE', 'MERGED_AWAY')),
  author_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  state         JSONB NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (contact_id, number)
);

-- Revisions are immutable: only removal together with their Contact (purge, Workspace deletion) is allowed.
CREATE FUNCTION revisions_immutable() RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'revisions are immutable';
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER revisions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON revisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION revisions_immutable();

package si.contacts.contact;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * The full state of a Contact: what every Revision holds. {@code fields} has every Predefined
 * field in order, absent values as null.
 */
public record ContactState(
    Map<String, String> fields, List<Attribute> attributes, List<String> tags, boolean deleted, UUID mergedInto) {

  public ContactState {
    Map<String, String> ordered = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (String f : Fields.PREDEFINED) ordered.put(f, fields.get(f));
    fields = Collections.unmodifiableMap(ordered);
    attributes = List.copyOf(attributes);
    tags = List.copyOf(tags);
  }

  public String field(String name) {
    return fields.get(name);
  }

  public ContactState withTags(List<String> newTags) {
    return new ContactState(fields, attributes, newTags, deleted, mergedInto);
  }

  public ContactState withDeleted(boolean d, UUID into) {
    return new ContactState(fields, attributes, tags, d, into);
  }

  /** The Predefined fields, Attributes and Tags as a JSON-ready map (Revision state shape). */
  public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
    Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>(fields);
    m.put("attributes", attributes.stream().map(a -> Map.of("key", a.key(), "value", a.value())).toList());
    m.put("tags", tags);
    m.put("deleted", deleted);
    m.put("mergedInto", mergedInto);
    return m;
  }

  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
  public static ContactState fromMap(Map<String, Object> m) {
    Map<String, String> f = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (String name : Fields.PREDEFINED) f.put(name, (String) m.get(name));
    List<Attribute> attrs =
        ((List<Map<String, Object>>) m.getOrDefault("attributes", List.of()))
            .stream().map(a -> new Attribute((String) a.get("key"), (String) a.get("value"))).toList();
    List<String> tags = (List<String>) m.getOrDefault("tags", List.of());
    Object into = m.get("mergedInto");
    return new ContactState(
        f, attrs, tags, Boolean.TRUE.equals(m.get("deleted")), into == null ? null : UUID.fromString(into.toString()));
  }
}

package si.contacts.contact;

import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/** A Contact as stored now; its version is the number of its latest Revision. */
public record Contact(UUID id, int version, ContactState state, OffsetDateTime createdAt, OffsetDateTime updatedAt) {

  public Map<String, Object> toJson() {
    Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    m.put("id", id);
    m.put("version", version);
    m.put("deleted", state.deleted());
    m.put("mergedInto", state.mergedInto());
    m.putAll(state.fields());
    m.put("attributes", state.attributes().stream().map(a -> Map.of("key", a.key(), "value", a.value())).toList());
    m.put("tags", state.tags());
    m.put("createdAt", createdAt);
    m.put("updatedAt", updatedAt);
    return m;
  }
}

package si.contacts.contact;

import java.text.Normalizer;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/** Normalisation for search and Duplicate matching (case, diacritics, whitespace, phone digits). */
public final class Normalize {
  private static final Pattern MARKS = Pattern.compile("\\p{M}+");
  private static final Pattern SPACES = Pattern.compile("\\s+");

  private Normalize() {}

  /** Lower case, diacritics removed (also đ→d), whitespace collapsed; null stays null. */
  public static String text(String s) {
    if (s == null) return null;
    String n = Normalizer.normalize(s, Normalizer.Form.NFD);
    n = MARKS.matcher(n).replaceAll("");
    n = n.replace('đ', 'd').replace('Đ', 'D').replace('ł', 'l').replace('Ł', 'L').replace('ø', 'o').replace('Ø', 'O');
    n = n.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    return SPACES.matcher(n).replaceAll(" ").strip();
  }

  public static String email(String email) {
    return email == null ? null : email.strip().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
  }

  /** {@code 00} becomes {@code +}, then digits only; fewer than 6 digits never match (null). */
  public static String phone(String phone) {
    if (phone == null) return null;
    String p = phone.strip();
    if (p.startsWith("00")) p = "+" + p.substring(2);
    String digits = p.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");
    if (digits.length() < 6) return null;
    return (p.startsWith("+") ? "+" : "") + digits;
  }

  /** First and last name together; needs both, otherwise null (a first name alone never matches). */
  public static String fullName(String first, String last) {
    String f = text(first);
    String l = text(last);
    if (f == null || l == null || f.isEmpty() || l.isEmpty()) return null;
    return f + " " + l;
  }

  /** The text the search box looks in: names, full name, email, phone, company and city. */
  public static String searchText(ContactState s) {
    StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
    String first = s.field("firstName");
    String last = s.field("lastName");
    append(b, text(first));
    append(b, text(last));
    if (first != null && last != null) append(b, text(first + " " + last));
    append(b, text(s.field("email")));
    String phone = s.field("phone");
    append(b, text(phone));
    if (phone != null) append(b, phone.replaceAll("[^0-9+]", ""));
    append(b, text(s.field("company")));
    append(b, text(s.field("city")));
    return b.toString();
  }

  private static void append(StringBuilder b, String s) {
    if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) return;
    b.append('\u0001').append(s);
  }

  /** Escapes a value for use inside a LIKE pattern with ESCAPE '\'. */
  public static String likeEscape(String s) {
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_");
  }
}

package si.contacts.contact;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import si.contacts.web.ApiException;
import si.contacts.web.Emails;
import si.contacts.web.FieldError;
import si.contacts.web.Text;

/**
 * Turns a request body into a valid {@link ContactState} or a 400 with every field error. Unknown
 * properties (ids, authors, versions of others) are ignored and never widen access.
 */
public final class ContactValidator {
  public static final int MAX_ATTRIBUTES = 100;
  public static final int MAX_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = 500;
  public static final int MAX_TAGS = 50;
  public static final int MAX_TAG = 50;
  public static final Pattern KEY = Pattern.compile("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,49}$");
  private static final Set<String> COUNTRIES = Set.of(Locale.getISOCountries());
  private static final Set<String> RESERVED_KEYS = reserved();

  private ContactValidator() {}

  private static Set<String> reserved() {
    Set<String> s = new HashSet<>();
    Fields.PREDEFINED.forEach(f -> s.add(f.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)));
    s.add("id");
    s.add("tags");
    return Set.copyOf(s);
  }

  public static ContactState parse(Map<String, Object> body) {
    List<FieldError> errors = new ArrayList<>();
    Map<String, String> fields = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (String f : Fields.PREDEFINED) {
      Object raw = body.get(f);
      if (raw != null && !(raw instanceof String)) {
        errors.add(new FieldError(f, "must be text"));
        continue;
      }
      String v = Text.clean(raw);
      if (v != null && v.length() > Fields.MAX_LENGTH.get(f)) {
        errors.add(new FieldError(f, "at most " + Fields.MAX_LENGTH.get(f) + " characters"));
        continue;
      }
      if (v != null && f.equals("email") && !Emails.valid(v)) {
        errors.add(new FieldError(f, "must be a valid email"));
        continue;
      }
      if (v != null && f.equals("country")) {
        v = v.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (!COUNTRIES.contains(v)) {
          errors.add(new FieldError(f, "must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code"));
          continue;
        }
      }
      fields.put(f, v);
    }
    boolean anyError = errors.stream().anyMatch(e -> Set.of("firstName", "lastName", "email").contains(e.field()));
    if (!anyError && fields.get("firstName") == null && fields.get("lastName") == null && fields.get("email") == null)
      errors.add(new FieldError("firstName", "first name, last name or email is required"));
    List<Attribute> attributes = attributes(body.get("attributes"), errors);
    List<String> tags = tags(body.get("tags"), errors);
    if (!errors.isEmpty()) throw ApiException.badRequest(errors);
    return new ContactState(fields, attributes, tags, false, null);
  }

  static List<Attribute> attributes(Object raw, List<FieldError> errors) {
    List<Attribute> out = new ArrayList<>();
    if (raw == null) return out;
    if (!(raw instanceof List<?> list)) {
      errors.add(new FieldError("attributes", "must be a list"));
      return out;
    }
    if (list.size() > MAX_ATTRIBUTES) {
      errors.add(new FieldError("attributes", "too many attributes"));
      return out;
    }
    Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
      String at = "attributes[" + i + "]";
      if (!(list.get(i) instanceof Map<?, ?> item)) {
        errors.add(new FieldError(at, "must be an object"));
        continue;
      }
      Object k = item.get("key");
      Object v = item.get("value");
      String key = k instanceof String s ? s.strip() : null;
      if (key == null || !KEY.matcher(key).matches()) {
        errors.add(new FieldError(at + ".key", "invalid key"));
      } else if (RESERVED_KEYS.contains(key.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) {
        errors.add(new FieldError(at + ".key", "reserved key"));
      } else if (!seen.add(key.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) {
        errors.add(new FieldError(at + ".key", "duplicate key"));
      }
      String value = v instanceof String s ? Text.clean(s) : null;
      if (v != null && !(v instanceof String)) errors.add(new FieldError(at + ".value", "must be text"));
      else if (value == null) errors.add(new FieldError(at + ".value", "required"));
      else if (value.length() > MAX_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
        errors.add(new FieldError(at + ".value", "at most " + MAX_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE + " characters"));
      if (key != null && value != null) out.add(new Attribute(key, value));
    }
    return out;
  }

  static List<String> tags(Object raw, List<FieldError> errors) {
    List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
    if (raw == null) return out;
    if (!(raw instanceof List<?> list)) {
      errors.add(new FieldError("tags", "must be a list"));
      return out;
    }
    if (list.size() > MAX_TAGS) {
      errors.add(new FieldError("tags", "too many tags"));
      return out;
    }
    Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
      String at = "tags[" + i + "]";
      String tag = list.get(i) instanceof String s ? s.strip() : null;
      if (!validTag(tag)) errors.add(new FieldError(at, "invalid tag"));
      else if (!seen.add(tag.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) errors.add(new FieldError(at, "duplicate tag"));
      else out.add(tag);
    }
    return out;
  }

  public static boolean validTag(String tag) {
    return tag != null && !tag.isEmpty() && tag.length() <= MAX_TAG && tag.codePoints().noneMatch(Character::isWhitespace);
  }
}

package si.contacts.store;

import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import si.contacts.contact.Attribute;
import si.contacts.contact.Contact;
import si.contacts.contact.ContactState;
import si.contacts.contact.Fields;
import si.contacts.contact.Normalize;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/** Contacts of one Workspace with their Attributes and Tags. */
@Repository
public class ContactStore {
  static final String COLUMNS =
      "c.id, c.version, c.deleted, c.merged_into, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.phone, c.company,"
          + " c.job_title, c.street, c.postal_code, c.city, c.country, c.note, c.created_at, c.updated_at";
  private final JdbcClient db;

  public ContactStore(JdbcClient db) {
    this.db = db;
  }

  public record Tag(UUID id, String name) {}

  public void insert(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id, ContactState st, List<Tag> tags) {
    Map<String, Object> p = params(st);
    p.put("id", id);
    p.put("ws", s.workspaceId());
    db.sql(
            "INSERT INTO contacts (id, workspace_id, version, deleted, merged_into, first_name, last_name, email, phone,"
                + " company, job_title, street, postal_code, city, country, note, search_text, email_norm, phone_norm,"
                + " name_norm, sort_last, sort_first, sort_company) VALUES (:id, :ws, 1, :deleted, :mergedInto,"
                + " :firstName, :lastName, :email, :phone, :company, :jobTitle, :street, :postalCode, :city, :country,"
                + " :note, :searchText, :emailNorm, :phoneNorm, :nameNorm, :sortLast, :sortFirst, :sortCompany)")
        .params(p)
        .update();
    writeChildren(id, st, tags);
  }

  /**
   * Writes the new state if the Contact is still at {@code expectedVersion}; returns the new
   * version, or empty when the version was outdated.
   */
  public Optional<Integer> update(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id, int expectedVersion, ContactState st, List<Tag> tags) {
    Map<String, Object> p = params(st);
    p.put("id", id);
    p.put("ws", s.workspaceId());
    p.put("expected", expectedVersion);
    Optional<Integer> version =
        db.sql(
                "UPDATE contacts SET version = version + 1, updated_at = now(), deleted = :deleted,"
                    + " merged_into = :mergedInto, first_name = :firstName, last_name = :lastName, email = :email,"
                    + " phone = :phone, company = :company, job_title = :jobTitle, street = :street,"
                    + " postal_code = :postalCode, city = :city, country = :country, note = :note,"
                    + " search_text = :searchText, email_norm = :emailNorm, phone_norm = :phoneNorm,"
                    + " name_norm = :nameNorm, sort_last = :sortLast, sort_first = :sortFirst,"
                    + " sort_company = :sortCompany"
                    + " WHERE id = :id AND workspace_id = :ws AND version = :expected RETURNING version")
            .params(p)
            .query(Integer.class)
            .optional();
    if (version.isPresent()) {
      db.sql("DELETE FROM contact_attributes WHERE contact_id = ?").param(id).update();
      db.sql("DELETE FROM contact_tags WHERE contact_id = ?").param(id).update();
      writeChildren(id, st, tags);
    }
    return version;
  }

  private void writeChildren(UUID id, ContactState st, List<Tag> tags) {
    for (int i = 0; i < st.attributes().size(); i++) {
      Attribute a = st.attributes().get(i);
      db.sql("INSERT INTO contact_attributes (contact_id, position, key, key_lower, value) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)")
          .params(id, i, a.key(), a.key().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), a.value())
          .update();
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < tags.size(); i++) {
      db.sql("INSERT INTO contact_tags (contact_id, tag_id, position) VALUES (?, ?, ?)").params(id, tags.get(i).id(), i).update();
    }
  }

  private static Map<String, Object> params(ContactState st) {
    Map<String, Object> p = new HashMap<>();
    st.fields().forEach(p::put);
    p.put("deleted", st.deleted());
    p.put("mergedInto", st.mergedInto());
    p.put("searchText", Normalize.searchText(st));
    p.put("emailNorm", Normalize.email(st.field("email")));
    p.put("phoneNorm", Normalize.phone(st.field("phone")));
    p.put("nameNorm", Normalize.fullName(st.field("firstName"), st.field("lastName")));
    p.put("sortLast", Normalize.text(st.field("lastName")));
    p.put("sortFirst", Normalize.text(st.field("firstName")));
    p.put("sortCompany", Normalize.text(st.field("company")));
    return p;
  }

  public Optional<Contact> find(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id) {
    return load(s, List.of(id)).stream().findFirst();
  }

  /** Locks the Contact row for the rest of the transaction. */
  public Optional<Contact> findForUpdate(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id) {
    boolean exists =
        db.sql("SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE id = ? AND workspace_id = ? FOR UPDATE")
            .params(id, s.workspaceId())
            .query(UUID.class)
            .optional()
            .isPresent();
    return exists ? find(s, id) : Optional.empty();
  }

  /** The Contacts with these ids in this Workspace, in the order of {@code ids}. */
  public List<Contact> load(WorkspaceScope s, List<UUID> ids) {
    if (ids.isEmpty()) return List.of();
    UUID[] arr = ids.toArray(UUID[]::new);
    List<Row> rows =
        db.sql("SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM contacts c WHERE c.workspace_id = ? AND c.id = ANY(?)")
            .params(s.workspaceId(), arr)
            .query(ContactStore::row)
            .list();
    Map<UUID, List<Attribute>> attrs = new HashMap<>();
    db.sql(
            "SELECT a.contact_id, a.key, a.value FROM contact_attributes a JOIN contacts c ON c.id = a.contact_id"
                + " WHERE c.workspace_id = ? AND a.contact_id = ANY(?) ORDER BY a.contact_id, a.position")
        .params(s.workspaceId(), arr)
        .query(
            rs -> {
              attrs.computeIfAbsent(rs.getObject(1, UUID.class), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(new Attribute(rs.getString(2), rs.getString(3)));
            });
    Map<UUID, List<String>> tags = new HashMap<>();
    db.sql(
            "SELECT ct.contact_id, t.name FROM contact_tags ct JOIN tags t ON t.id = ct.tag_id"
                + " WHERE t.workspace_id = ? AND ct.contact_id = ANY(?) ORDER BY ct.contact_id, ct.position")
        .params(s.workspaceId(), arr)
        .query(rs -> {
          tags.computeIfAbsent(rs.getObject(1, UUID.class), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(rs.getString(2));
        });
    Map<UUID, Contact> byId = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (Row r : rows) {
      ContactState st =
          new ContactState(
              r.fields, attrs.getOrDefault(r.id, List.of()), tags.getOrDefault(r.id, List.of()), r.deleted, r.mergedInto);
      byId.put(r.id, new Contact(r.id, r.version, st, r.createdAt, r.updatedAt));
    }
    return ids.stream().map(byId::get).filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull).collect(Collectors.toList());
  }

  public void purge(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id) {
    db.sql("DELETE FROM contacts WHERE id = ? AND workspace_id = ?").params(id, s.workspaceId()).update();
  }

  record Row(
      UUID id, int version, boolean deleted, UUID mergedInto, Map<String, String> fields, OffsetDateTime createdAt, OffsetDateTime updatedAt) {}

  static Row row(ResultSet rs, int i) throws SQLException {
    Map<String, String> f = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (String name : Fields.PREDEFINED) f.put(name, rs.getString(Fields.COLUMN.get(name)));
    return new Row(
        rs.getObject("id", UUID.class),
        rs.getInt("version"),
        rs.getBoolean("deleted"),
        rs.getObject("merged_into", UUID.class),
        f,
        rs.getObject("created_at", OffsetDateTime.class),
        rs.getObject("updated_at", OffsetDateTime.class));
  }
}

package si.contacts.store;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import si.contacts.store.ContactStore.Tag;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/** Tags of one Workspace: created on first use, the same Tag regardless of letter case. */
@Repository
public class TagStore {
  private final JdbcClient db;

  public TagStore(JdbcClient db) {
    this.db = db;
  }

  /** The Tags for these names in order, creating missing ones; existing Tags keep their spelling. */
  public List<Tag> resolve(WorkspaceScope s, List<String> names) {
    List<Tag> out = new ArrayList<>();
    for (String name : names) {
      String lower = name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
      db.sql(
              "INSERT INTO tags (id, workspace_id, name, name_lower) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)"
                  + " ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, name_lower) DO NOTHING")
          .params(UUID.randomUUID(), s.workspaceId(), name, lower)
          .update();
      out.add(
          db.sql("SELECT id, name FROM tags WHERE workspace_id = ? AND name_lower = ?")
              .params(s.workspaceId(), lower)
              .query((rs, i) -> new Tag(rs.getObject(1, UUID.class), rs.getString(2)))
              .single());
    }
    return out;
  }
}

package si.contacts.store;

import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/** Immutable Revisions: append and read only. */
@Repository
public class RevisionStore {
  private final JdbcClient db;

  public RevisionStore(JdbcClient db) {
    this.db = db;
  }

  public record RevisionRow(
      int number, String type, UUID authorId, String authorEmail, String authorName, OffsetDateTime createdAt, String stateJson) {}

  public void append(WorkspaceScope s, UUID contactId, int number, String type, String stateJson) {
    db.sql(
            "INSERT INTO revisions (contact_id, workspace_id, number, type, author_id, state)"
                + " VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CAST(? AS jsonb))")
        .params(contactId, s.workspaceId(), number, type, s.user().id(), stateJson)
        .update();
  }

  public List<RevisionRow> list(WorkspaceScope s, UUID contactId) {
    return db.sql(
            "SELECT r.number, r.type, u.id, u.email, u.display_name, r.created_at, r.state::text FROM revisions r"
                + " JOIN users u ON u.id = r.author_id WHERE r.workspace_id = ? AND r.contact_id = ?"
                + " ORDER BY r.number DESC")
        .params(s.workspaceId(), contactId)
        .query(RevisionStore::row)
        .list();
  }

  public Optional<RevisionRow> find(WorkspaceScope s, UUID contactId, int number) {
    return db.sql(
            "SELECT r.number, r.type, u.id, u.email, u.display_name, r.created_at, r.state::text FROM revisions r"
                + " JOIN users u ON u.id = r.author_id WHERE r.workspace_id = ? AND r.contact_id = ? AND r.number = ?")
        .params(s.workspaceId(), contactId, number)
        .query(RevisionStore::row)
        .optional();
  }

  static RevisionRow row(ResultSet rs, int i) throws SQLException {
    return new RevisionRow(
        rs.getInt(1),
        rs.getString(2),
        rs.getObject(3, UUID.class),
        rs.getString(4),
        rs.getString(5),
        rs.getObject(6, OffsetDateTime.class),
        rs.getString(7));
  }
}

package si.contacts.contact;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import si.contacts.store.ContactStore;
import si.contacts.store.ContactStore.Tag;
import si.contacts.store.RevisionStore;
import si.contacts.store.TagStore;
import si.contacts.web.ApiException;
import si.contacts.workspace.Role;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;
import tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;

/**
 * Every change of a Contact: the change, its one immutable Revision and the version check share
 * one transaction.
 */
@Service
public class ContactService {
  private final ContactStore contacts;
  private final RevisionStore revisions;
  private final TagStore tags;
  private final ObjectMapper json;

  public ContactService(ContactStore contacts, RevisionStore revisions, TagStore tags, ObjectMapper json) {
    this.contacts = contacts;
    this.revisions = revisions;
    this.tags = tags;
    this.json = json;
  }

  @Transactional
  public Contact create(WorkspaceScope s, ContactState input) {
    s.require(Role.EDITOR);
    UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
    List<Tag> resolved = tags.resolve(s, input.tags());
    ContactState st = input.withTags(resolved.stream().map(Tag::name).toList());
    contacts.insert(s, id, st, resolved);
    revisions.append(s, id, 1, "CREATE", write(st));
    return contacts.find(s, id).orElseThrow();
  }

  public Contact get(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id) {
    return contacts.find(s, id).orElseThrow(ApiException::notFound);
  }

  @Transactional
  public Contact update(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id, Integer version, ContactState input) {
    s.require(Role.EDITOR);
    if (version == null) throw ApiException.badRequest("version", "required");
    Contact current = get(s, id);
    if (current.state().deleted()) {
      if (current.version() != version) throw ApiException.outdatedVersion();
      throw ApiException.conflict(null, "contact is deleted");
    }
    return write(s, current, version, input, "UPDATE");
  }

  @Transactional
  public void delete(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id, Integer version) {
    s.require(Role.EDITOR);
    Contact current = contacts.findForUpdate(s, id).orElseThrow(ApiException::notFound);
    int expected = version == null ? current.version() : version;
    if (current.version() != expected) throw ApiException.outdatedVersion();
    if (current.state().deleted()) throw ApiException.conflict(null, "contact is deleted");
    write(s, current, expected, current.state().withDeleted(true, null), "DELETE");
  }

  /** Restores a Deleted contact with its last state. */
  @Transactional
  public Contact restoreDeleted(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id) {
    s.require(Role.EDITOR);
    Contact current = contacts.findForUpdate(s, id).orElseThrow(ApiException::notFound);
    if (!current.state().deleted()) throw ApiException.conflict(null, "contact is not deleted");
    return write(s, current, current.version(), current.state().withDeleted(false, null), "RESTORE");
  }

  /** Makes Revision {@code number} current again as a new RESTORE Revision. */
  @Transactional
  public Contact restoreRevision(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id, int number, Integer version) {
    s.require(Role.EDITOR);
    if (version == null) throw ApiException.badRequest("version", "required");
    Contact current = get(s, id);
    var rev = revisions.find(s, id, number).orElseThrow(ApiException::notFound);
    if (current.state().deleted()) throw ApiException.conflict(null, "contact is deleted");
    ContactState old = read(rev.stateJson());
    return write(s, current, version, old.withDeleted(false, null), "RESTORE");
  }

  /** Permanently removes a Deleted contact and all its Revisions. */
  @Transactional
  public void purge(WorkspaceScope s, UUID id) {
    s.require(Role.OWNER);
    Contact current = contacts.findForUpdate(s, id).orElseThrow(ApiException::notFound);
    if (!current.state().deleted()) throw ApiException.conflict(null, "contact is not deleted");
    contacts.purge(s, id);
  }

  /**
   * Writes {@code next} on top of {@code current} if it is still at {@code expectedVersion}, with
   * one Revision of {@code type}. Tags are resolved (and re-created if deleted since).
   */
  public Contact write(WorkspaceScope s, Contact current, int expectedVersion, ContactState next, String type) {
    List<Tag> resolved = tags.resolve(s, next.tags());
    ContactState st = next.withTags(resolved.stream().map(Tag::name).toList());
    int version =
        contacts.update(s, current.id(), expectedVersion, st, resolved).orElseThrow(ApiException::outdatedVersion);
    revisions.append(s, current.id(), version, type, write(st));
    return contacts.find(s, current.id()).orElseThrow();
  }

  public String write(ContactState st) {
    return json.writeValueAsString(st.toMap());
  }

  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
  public ContactState read(String stateJson) {
    return ContactState.fromMap(json.readValue(stateJson, Map.class));
  }
}

package si.contacts.contact;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ResponseStatus;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import si.contacts.store.RevisionStore;
import si.contacts.user.User;
import si.contacts.web.ApiException;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceAccess;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/workspaces/{wid}/contacts")
public class ContactController {
  private final WorkspaceAccess access;
  private final ContactService service;
  private final ContactQueries queries;
  private final RevisionStore revisions;

  public ContactController(
      WorkspaceAccess access, ContactService service, ContactQueries queries, RevisionStore revisions) {
    this.access = access;
    this.service = service;
    this.queries = queries;
    this.revisions = revisions;
  }

  @GetMapping
  Map<String, Object> list(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @RequestParam Map<String, String> single,
      @RequestParam(name = "tag", required = false) List<String> tag,
      @RequestParam(name = "attr", required = false) List<String> attr) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user);
    ContactQuery q = ContactQuery.parse(single, tag, attr);
    return queries.page(s, q);
  }

  @PostMapping
  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  Map<String, Object> create(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user).require(si.contacts.workspace.Role.EDITOR);
    Contact c = service.create(s, ContactValidator.parse(body));
    return queries.withDuplicates(s, c);
  }

  @GetMapping("/{cid}")
  Map<String, Object> get(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable UUID cid) {
    return service.get(access.open(wid, user), cid).toJson();
  }

  @PutMapping("/{cid}")
  Map<String, Object> update(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable UUID cid, @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user).require(si.contacts.workspace.Role.EDITOR);
    Integer version = version(body.get("version"));
    Contact c = service.update(s, cid, version, ContactValidator.parse(body));
    return queries.withDuplicates(s, c);
  }

  @DeleteMapping("/{cid}")
  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  void delete(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable UUID cid, @RequestParam(required = false) Integer version) {
    service.delete(access.open(wid, user), cid, version);
  }

  @PostMapping("/{cid}/restore")
  Map<String, Object> restore(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable UUID cid) {
    return service.restoreDeleted(access.open(wid, user), cid).toJson();
  }

  @PostMapping("/{cid}/purge")
  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  void purge(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable UUID cid) {
    service.purge(access.open(wid, user), cid);
  }

  @GetMapping("/{cid}/revisions")
  List<Map<String, Object>> revisions(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable UUID cid) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user);
    service.get(s, cid);
    return revisions.list(s, cid).stream()
        .map(
            r -> {
              Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
              m.put("number", r.number());
              m.put("type", r.type());
              Map<String, Object> author = new LinkedHashMap<>();
              author.put("id", r.authorId());
              author.put("email", r.authorEmail());
              author.put("displayName", r.authorName());
              m.put("author", author);
              m.put("createdAt", r.createdAt());
              m.put("state", service.read(r.stateJson()).toMap());
              return m;
            })
        .toList();
  }

  @PostMapping("/{cid}/revisions/{number}/restore")
  Map<String, Object> restoreRevision(
      User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable UUID cid, @PathVariable int number,
      @RequestBody(required = false) Map<String, Object> body) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user).require(si.contacts.workspace.Role.EDITOR);
    return service.restoreRevision(s, cid, number, version(body == null ? null : body.get("version"))).toJson();
  }

  static Integer version(Object raw) {
    if (raw == null) return null;
    if (raw instanceof Integer i) return i;
    if (raw instanceof Number n && n.doubleValue() == n.intValue()) return n.intValue();
    throw ApiException.badRequest("version", "must be a number");
  }
}

package si.contacts.contact;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import si.contacts.web.ApiException;
import si.contacts.web.Text;

/** Search, filters, sort and paging of the Contact list (all evaluated in the database, AR-10). */
public record ContactQuery(
    String q,
    List<String> tags,
    boolean tagModeAny,
    List<String> attrs,
    String country,
    String company,
    boolean deleted,
    String sort,
    boolean descending,
    int page,
    int size) {
  public static final int MAX_SIZE = 100;
  static final Set<String> SORTS = Set.of("lastName", "firstName", "company", "updatedAt");

  public static ContactQuery parse(Map<String, String> p, List<String> tags, List<String> attrs) {
    String sort = p.getOrDefault("sort", "lastName");
    if (!SORTS.contains(sort)) throw ApiException.badRequest("sort", "invalid sort");
    String dir = p.getOrDefault("dir", sort.equals("updatedAt") ? "desc" : "asc");
    if (!dir.equals("asc") && !dir.equals("desc")) throw ApiException.badRequest("dir", "invalid direction");
    String mode = p.getOrDefault("tagMode", "all");
    if (!mode.equals("all") && !mode.equals("any")) throw ApiException.badRequest("tagMode", "invalid tag mode");
    int page = integer(p.get("page"), 0, "page");
    int size = integer(p.get("size"), 20, "size");
    if (page < 0) throw ApiException.badRequest("page", "between 0 and 100000");
    if (size < 1 || size > MAX_SIZE) throw ApiException.badRequest("size", "between 1 and " + MAX_SIZE);
    return new ContactQuery(
        Text.clean(p.get("q")),
        clean(tags),
        mode.equals("any"),
        clean(attrs),
        upper(Text.clean(p.get("country"))),
        Text.clean(p.get("company")),
        "true".equals(p.get("deleted")),
        sort,
        dir.equals("desc"),
        page,
        size);
  }

  /** A filter for an Export: everything matching, in the filter's order. */
  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
  public static ContactQuery fromFilter(Map<String, Object> f) {
    Map<String, String> single = new java.util.HashMap<>();
    for (String k : List.of("q", "tagMode", "country", "company", "sort", "dir")) {
      Object v = f.get(k);
      if (v != null) single.put(k, v.toString());
    }
    List<String> tags = asList(f.get("tag"), "filter.tag");
    List<String> attrs = asList(f.get("attr"), "filter.attr");
    return parse(single, tags, attrs);
  }

  private static List<String> asList(Object v, String field) {
    if (v == null) return List.of();
    if (v instanceof String s) return List.of(s);
    if (v instanceof List<?> l && l.stream().allMatch(x -> x instanceof String)) return l.stream().map(Object::toString).toList();
    throw ApiException.badRequest(field, "must be a list");
  }

  private static List<String> clean(List<String> in) {
    if (in == null) return List.of();
    return in.stream().map(Text::clean).filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
  }

  private static String upper(String s) {
    return s == null ? null : s.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
  }

  private static int integer(String raw, int def, String field) {
    if (raw == null || raw.isBlank()) return def;
    try {
      return Integer.parseInt(raw.trim());
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
      throw ApiException.badRequest(field, "must be a number");
    }
  }

  public ContactQuery withPaging(int newPage, int newSize) {
    return new ContactQuery(q, tags, tagModeAny, attrs, country, company, deleted, sort, descending, newPage, newSize);
  }
}

package si.contacts.contact;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import si.contacts.store.ContactStore;
import si.contacts.store.ContactSearchStore;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/** Read side of Contacts: list pages and the save-time duplicate warning. */
@Service
public class ContactQueries {
  private final ContactStore contacts;
  private final ContactSearchStore search;

  public ContactQueries(ContactStore contacts, ContactSearchStore search) {
    this.contacts = contacts;
    this.search = search;
  }

  public Map<String, Object> page(WorkspaceScope s, ContactQuery q) {
    List<UUID> ids = search.ids(s, q, q.page() * q.size(), q.size());
    long total = search.count(s, q);
    Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    m.put("items", contacts.load(s, ids).stream().map(Contact::toJson).toList());
    m.put("total", total);
    m.put("page", q.page());
    m.put("size", q.size());
    return m;
  }

  /** The Contact plus possible duplicates among the other active Contacts (never blocks a save). */
  public Map<String, Object> withDuplicates(WorkspaceScope s, Contact c) {
    Map<String, Object> m = c.toJson();
    m.put("possibleDuplicates", search.possibleDuplicates(s, c));
    return m;
  }
}

package si.contacts.store;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import si.contacts.contact.Contact;
import si.contacts.contact.ContactQuery;
import si.contacts.contact.Normalize;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/** Search, filter, sort and paging of Contacts, evaluated entirely in PostgreSQL (AR-10). */
@Repository
public class ContactSearchStore {
  private final JdbcClient db;

  public ContactSearchStore(JdbcClient db) {
    this.db = db;
  }

  private record Where(String sql, Map<String, Object> params) {}

  private static Where where(WorkspaceScope s, ContactQuery q) {
    StringBuilder w = new StringBuilder("c.workspace_id = :ws AND c.deleted = :deleted");
    Map<String, Object> p = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    p.put("ws", s.workspaceId());
    p.put("deleted", q.deleted());
    if (q.q() != null) {
      String norm = Normalize.text(q.q());
      if (!norm.isEmpty()) {
        w.append(" AND c.search_text LIKE :q ESCAPE '\\'");
        p.put("q", "%" + Normalize.likeEscape(norm) + "%");
      }
    }
    if (!q.tags().isEmpty()) {
      List<String> lower = q.tags().stream().map(t -> t.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)).toList();
      if (q.tagModeAny()) {
        w.append(
            " AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_tags ct JOIN tags t ON t.id = ct.tag_id"
                + " WHERE ct.contact_id = c.id AND t.name_lower IN (:tagsAny))");
        p.put("tagsAny", lower);
      } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < lower.size(); i++) {
          w.append(
              " AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_tags ct JOIN tags t ON t.id = ct.tag_id"
                  + " WHERE ct.contact_id = c.id AND t.name_lower = :tag" + i + ")");
          p.put("tag" + i, lower.get(i));
        }
      }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < q.attrs().size(); i++) {
      String a = q.attrs().get(i);
      int eq = a.indexOf('=');
      String key = (eq < 0 ? a : a.substring(0, eq)).strip().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
      w.append(" AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_attributes a WHERE a.contact_id = c.id AND a.key_lower = :ak").append(i);
      p.put("ak" + i, key);
      if (eq >= 0) {
        w.append(" AND lower(a.value) = lower(:av").append(i).append(")");
        p.put("av" + i, a.substring(eq + 1).strip());
      }
      w.append(")");
    }
    if (q.country() != null) {
      w.append(" AND c.country = :country");
      p.put("country", q.country());
    }
    if (q.company() != null) {
      w.append(" AND lower(c.company) = lower(:company)");
      p.put("company", q.company());
    }
    return new Where(w.toString(), p);
  }

  static String orderBy(ContactQuery q) {
    String dir = q.descending() ? "DESC" : "ASC";
    String nulls = q.descending() ? "NULLS LAST" : "NULLS LAST";
    return switch (q.sort()) {
      case "firstName" -> "c.sort_first " + dir + " " + nulls + ", c.sort_last " + dir + " " + nulls + ", c.id";
      case "company" -> "c.sort_company " + dir + " " + nulls + ", c.sort_last " + dir + " " + nulls + ", c.id";
      case "updatedAt" -> "c.updated_at " + dir + ", c.id";
      default -> "c.sort_last " + dir + " " + nulls + ", c.sort_first " + dir + " " + nulls + ", c.id";
    };
  }

  public List<UUID> ids(WorkspaceScope s, ContactQuery q, int offset, int limit) {
    Where w = where(s, q);
    return db.sql("SELECT c.id FROM contacts c WHERE " + w.sql() + " ORDER BY " + orderBy(q) + " LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset")
        .params(w.params())
        .param("limit", limit)
        .param("offset", offset)
        .query(UUID.class)
        .list();
  }

  public long count(WorkspaceScope s, ContactQuery q) {
    Where w = where(s, q);
    return db.sql("SELECT count(*) FROM contacts c WHERE " + w.sql()).params(w.params()).query(Long.class).single();
  }

  /** Active Contacts (other than {@code c}) sharing its normalised email, phone or full name. */
  public List<Map<String, Object>> possibleDuplicates(WorkspaceScope s, Contact c) {
    if (c.state().deleted()) return List.of();
    String email = Normalize.email(c.state().field("email"));
    String phone = Normalize.phone(c.state().field("phone"));
    String name = Normalize.fullName(c.state().field("firstName"), c.state().field("lastName"));
    if (email == null && phone == null && name == null) return List.of();
    List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();
    db.sql(
            "SELECT c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.phone, c.email_norm = :email AS m_email,"
                + " c.phone_norm = :phone AS m_phone, c.name_norm = :name AS m_name FROM contacts c"
                + " WHERE c.workspace_id = :ws AND NOT c.deleted AND c.id <> :id"
                + " AND (c.email_norm = :email OR c.phone_norm = :phone OR c.name_norm = :name)"
                + " ORDER BY c.sort_last NULLS LAST, c.sort_first NULLS LAST, c.id LIMIT 20")
        .param("ws", s.workspaceId())
        .param("id", c.id())
        .param("email", email)
        .param("phone", phone)
        .param("name", name)
        .query(
            rs -> {
              Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
              m.put("id", rs.getObject("id", UUID.class));
              m.put("firstName", rs.getString("first_name"));
              m.put("lastName", rs.getString("last_name"));
              m.put("email", rs.getString("email"));
              m.put("phone", rs.getString("phone"));
              List<String> kinds = new ArrayList<>();
              if (rs.getBoolean("m_email")) kinds.add("EMAIL");
              if (rs.getBoolean("m_phone")) kinds.add("PHONE");
              if (rs.getBoolean("m_name")) kinds.add("NAME");
              m.put("matchKinds", kinds);
              out.add(m);
            });
    return out;
  }
}
