import { PREDEFINED_FIELDS, type Attribute, type Contact, type ContactInput, type PredefinedField } from './api';

export const FIELD_LABEL: Record<PredefinedField, string> = {
  firstName: 'Ime',
  lastName: 'Priimek',
  email: 'E-pošta',
  phone: 'Telefon',
  company: 'Podjetje',
  jobTitle: 'Delovno mesto',
  street: 'Ulica',
  postalCode: 'Poštna številka',
  city: 'Kraj',
  country: 'Država',
  note: 'Opomba',
};

export const MAX_LENGTH: Record<PredefinedField, number> = {
  firstName: 100,
  lastName: 100,
  email: 254,
  phone: 50,
  company: 200,
  jobTitle: 200,
  street: 200,
  postalCode: 20,
  city: 100,
  country: 2,
  note: 2000,
};

const KEY = /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,49}$/;
const RESERVED = new Set([...PREDEFINED_FIELDS.map((f) => f.toLowerCase()), 'id', 'tags']);

export interface FormValues {
  fields: Record<PredefinedField, string>;
  attributes: Attribute[];
  tags: string;
}

export function emptyForm(): FormValues {
  const fields = Object.fromEntries(PREDEFINED_FIELDS.map((f) => [f, ''])) as Record<PredefinedField, string>;
  return { fields, attributes: [], tags: '' };
}

export function formFrom(c: Contact): FormValues {
  const fields = Object.fromEntries(PREDEFINED_FIELDS.map((f) => [f, c[f] ?? ''])) as Record<PredefinedField, string>;
  return { fields, attributes: c.attributes.map((a) => ({ ...a })), tags: c.tags.join(' ') };
}

export function splitTags(text: string): string[] {
  return text
    .split(/[\s,]+/)
    .map((t) => t.trim())
    .filter((t) => t.length > 0);
}

export function toInput(v: FormValues): ContactInput {
  const out = {} as ContactInput;
  PREDEFINED_FIELDS.forEach((f) => {
    const t = v.fields[f].trim();
    out[f] = t === '' ? null : f === 'country' ? t.toUpperCase() : t;
  });
  out.attributes = v.attributes.map((a) => ({ key: a.key.trim(), value: a.value.trim() }));
  out.tags = splitTags(v.tags);
  return out;
}

/** The obvious mistakes, checked before sending; keys match the API's field names. */
export function validate(v: FormValues): Record<string, string> {
  const e: Record<string, string> = {};
  const input = toInput(v);
  PREDEFINED_FIELDS.forEach((f) => {
    const value = input[f];
    if (value && value.length > MAX_LENGTH[f]) e[f] = `Največ ${MAX_LENGTH[f]} znakov.`;
  });
  if (!e.email && input.email && !/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s.]{2,}$/.test(input.email))
    e.email = 'Vnesite veljaven e-poštni naslov.';
  if (!e.country && input.country && !/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(input.country))
    e.country = 'Vnesite veljavno dvočrkovno kodo države (npr. SI).';
  if (!input.firstName && !input.lastName && !input.email && !e.firstName)
    e.firstName = 'Vnesite vsaj ime, priimek ali e-pošto.';
  if (input.attributes.length > 100) e.attributes = 'Največ 100 atributov.';
  const keys = new Set<string>();
  input.attributes.forEach((a, i) => {
    const lower = a.key.toLowerCase();
    if (!KEY.test(a.key)) e[`attributes[${i}].key`] = 'Ključ mora se začeti s črko in vsebovati le črke, števke, _, . ali -.';
    else if (RESERVED.has(lower)) e[`attributes[${i}].key`] = 'Ključ je enak imenu vnaprej določenega polja.';
    else if (keys.has(lower)) e[`attributes[${i}].key`] = 'Ključ se ponavlja.';
    keys.add(lower);
    if (!a.value) e[`attributes[${i}].value`] = 'Polje je obvezno.';
    else if (a.value.length > 500) e[`attributes[${i}].value`] = 'Največ 500 znakov.';
  });
  const tags = input.tags;
  if (tags.length > 50) e.tags = 'Največ 50 oznak.';
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  tags.forEach((t, i) => {
    if (t.length > 50) e[`tags[${i}]`] = `Oznaka »${t.slice(0, 20)}…« je daljša od 50 znakov.`;
    else if (seen.has(t.toLowerCase())) e[`tags[${i}]`] = `Oznaka »${t}« se ponavlja.`;
    seen.add(t.toLowerCase());
  });
  return e;
}

/** Error text for the tags input: the list error or the first per-Tag error. */
export function tagsError(errors: Record<string, string>): string | undefined {
  if (errors.tags) return errors.tags;
  const key = Object.keys(errors).find((k) => k.startsWith('tags['));
  return key ? errors[key] : undefined;
}

export function attributesError(errors: Record<string, string>): string | undefined {
  return errors.attributes;
}

import { Link } from 'react-router';
import type { PossibleDuplicate } from '../lib/api';

const KIND: Record<string, string> = { EMAIL: 'e-pošta', PHONE: 'telefon', NAME: 'ime in priimek' };

/** The save-time warning: the Contact is saved, but looks like these existing ones. */
export function DuplicateWarning({ wid, duplicates }: { wid: string; duplicates: PossibleDuplicate[] }) {
  if (duplicates.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="alert alert-warning" role="status">
      <p>
        <strong>Kontakt je shranjen, vendar je podoben obstoječim kontaktom:</strong>
      </p>
      <ul>
        {duplicates.map((d) => (
          <li key={d.id}>
            <Link to={`/w/${wid}/kontakti/${d.id}`}>
              {[d.firstName, d.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || d.email || 'Kontakt'}
            </Link>{' '}
            (ujema se: {d.matchKinds.map((k) => KIND[k]).join(', ')})
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router';
import { ApiError, PREDEFINED_FIELDS, type PossibleDuplicate } from '../lib/api';
import { useApi } from '../lib/context';
import { errorText, fieldErrors } from '../lib/messages';
import { FIELD_LABEL, emptyForm, formFrom, tagsError, toInput, validate, type FormValues } from '../lib/contactForm';
import { can } from '../lib/roles';
import { FormField } from '../components/FormField';
import { Alert } from '../components/Alert';
import { DuplicateWarning } from '../components/DuplicateWarning';
import { useWorkspace } from './WorkspaceLayout';

export function ContactFormPage() {
  const { cid } = useParams();
  const api = useApi();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { workspace } = useWorkspace();
  const [values, setValues] = useState<FormValues>(emptyForm());
  const [contactId, setContactId] = useState<string | undefined>(cid);
  const [version, setVersion] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [duplicates, setDuplicates] = useState<PossibleDuplicate[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!!cid);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!cid) return;
    let active = true;
    api.getContact(workspace.id, cid).then(
      (c) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setValues(formFrom(c));
        setVersion(c.version);
        setLoading(false);
      },
      (e: unknown) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setFailure(errorText(e));
        setLoading(false);
      },
    );
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [api, workspace.id, cid]);

  if (!can(workspace.role, 'EDITOR')) return <Alert>Za urejanje kontaktov nimate pravic.</Alert>;
  if (loading) return <p role="status">Nalaganje …</p>;

  const setField = (f: string, v: string) => setValues((old) => ({ ...old, fields: { ...old.fields, [f]: v } }));
  const setAttr = (i: number, part: 'key' | 'value', v: string) =>
    setValues((old) => ({ ...old, attributes: old.attributes.map((a, j) => (j === i ? { ...a, [part]: v } : a)) }));

  async function submit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFailure(null);
    setDuplicates([]);
    const local = validate(values);
    setErrors(local);
    if (Object.keys(local).length > 0) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const input = toInput(values);
      const saved =
        contactId && version !== null
          ? await api.updateContact(workspace.id, contactId, version, input)
          : await api.createContact(workspace.id, input);
      if (saved.possibleDuplicates.length > 0) {
        setContactId(saved.id);
        setVersion(saved.version);
        setValues(formFrom(saved));
        setDuplicates(saved.possibleDuplicates);
      } else {
        navigate(`/w/${workspace.id}/kontakti/${saved.id}`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const f = fieldErrors(err);
      setErrors(f);
      if (Object.keys(f).length === 0 || (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 409)) setFailure(errorText(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <section>
      <h1>{contactId ? 'Uredi kontakt' : 'Nov kontakt'}</h1>
      <DuplicateWarning wid={workspace.id} duplicates={duplicates} />
      {duplicates.length > 0 && contactId && (
        <p>
          <Link to={`/w/${workspace.id}/kontakti/${contactId}`}>Odpri shranjeni kontakt</Link>
        </p>
      )}
      {failure && <Alert>{failure}</Alert>}
      <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate aria-label="Kontakt">
        <div className="grid2">
          {PREDEFINED_FIELDS.filter((f) => f !== 'note').map((f) => (
            <FormField
              key={f}
              label={FIELD_LABEL[f] + (f === 'country' ? ' (koda, npr. SI)' : '')}
              name={f}
              type={f === 'email' ? 'email' : 'text'}
              value={values.fields[f]}
              error={errors[f]}
              onChange={(e) => setField(f, e.target.value)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
        <FormField label={FIELD_LABEL.note} name="note" multiline value={values.fields.note} error={errors.note} onChange={(e) => setField('note', e.target.value)} />

        <fieldset>
          <legend>Atributi</legend>
          {errors.attributes && <span className="error">{errors.attributes}</span>}
          {values.attributes.map((a, i) => (
            <div className="toolbar" key={i}>
              <FormField label={`Ključ ${i + 1}`} value={a.key} error={errors[`attributes[${i}].key`]} onChange={(e) => setAttr(i, 'key', e.target.value)} />
              <FormField label={`Vrednost ${i + 1}`} value={a.value} error={errors[`attributes[${i}].value`]} onChange={(e) => setAttr(i, 'value', e.target.value)} />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setValues((old) => ({ ...old, attributes: old.attributes.filter((_, j) => j !== i) }))}
              >
                Odstrani atribut {i + 1}
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setValues((old) => ({ ...old, attributes: [...old.attributes, { key: '', value: '' }] }))}>
            Dodaj atribut
          </button>
        </fieldset>

        <FormField
          label="Oznake (ločene s presledkom)"
          name="tags"
          value={values.tags}
          error={tagsError(errors)}
          onChange={(e) => setValues((old) => ({ ...old, tags: e.target.value }))}
        />

        <div className="actions">
          <button type="submit" className="primary" disabled={busy}>
            Shrani
          </button>
          <Link to={contactId ? `/w/${workspace.id}/kontakti/${contactId}` : `/w/${workspace.id}`}>Prekliči</Link>
        </div>
      </form>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router';
import { ApiError, PREDEFINED_FIELDS } from '../lib/api';
import { useApi } from '../lib/context';
import { useLoad } from '../lib/useLoad';
import { errorText } from '../lib/messages';
import { FIELD_LABEL } from '../lib/contactForm';
import { can } from '../lib/roles';
import { Alert } from '../components/Alert';
import { NotFoundPage } from './NotFoundPage';
import { useWorkspace } from './WorkspaceLayout';

export function contactName(c: { firstName: string | null; lastName: string | null; email: string | null }): string {
  return [c.firstName, c.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || c.email || 'Brez imena';
}

export function ContactPage() {
  const { cid = '' } = useParams();
  const api = useApi();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { workspace } = useWorkspace();
  const contact = useLoad(() => api.getContact(workspace.id, cid), [api, workspace.id, cid]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirmPurge, setConfirmPurge] = useState(false);

  if (contact.error instanceof ApiError && contact.error.status === 404) return <NotFoundPage />;
  if (contact.error) return <Alert>{errorText(contact.error)}</Alert>;
  if (!contact.data) return <p role="status">Nalaganje …</p>;
  const c = contact.data;
  const editor = can(workspace.role, 'EDITOR');

  async function act(fn: () => Promise<unknown>, after?: () => void) {
    setError(null);
    try {
      await fn();
      if (after) after();
      else await contact.reload();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    }
  }

  return (
    <section>
      <h1>{contactName(c)}</h1>
      {c.deleted && (
        <Alert kind="warning">
          Kontakt je izbrisan.
          {c.mergedInto && (
            <>
              {' '}
              Združen je v <Link to={`/w/${workspace.id}/kontakti/${c.mergedInto}`}>ohranjeni kontakt</Link>.
            </>
          )}
        </Alert>
      )}
      {error && <Alert>{error}</Alert>}
      <div className="actions">
        {editor && !c.deleted && (
          <>
            <Link to={`/w/${workspace.id}/kontakti/${c.id}/uredi`}>Uredi</Link>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => void act(() => api.deleteContact(workspace.id, c.id, c.version), () => navigate(`/w/${workspace.id}`))}>
              Izbriši
            </button>
          </>
        )}
        {editor && c.deleted && (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => void act(() => api.restoreContact(workspace.id, c.id))}>
            Obnovi kontakt
          </button>
        )}
        {c.deleted && can(workspace.role, 'OWNER') && !confirmPurge && (
          <button type="button" className="danger" onClick={() => setConfirmPurge(true)}>
            Trajno izbriši
          </button>
        )}
        <Link to={`/w/${workspace.id}/kontakti/${c.id}/zgodovina`}>Zgodovina sprememb</Link>
      </div>
      {confirmPurge && (
        <Alert kind="warning">
          <p>Kontakt in vse njegove revizije bodo trajno odstranjeni. Tega ni mogoče razveljaviti.</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="danger"
            onClick={() => void act(() => api.purgeContact(workspace.id, c.id), () => navigate(`/w/${workspace.id}/izbrisani`))}
          >
            Potrdi trajni izbris
          </button>{' '}
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirmPurge(false)}>
            Prekliči
          </button>
        </Alert>
      )}
      <dl className="props">
        {PREDEFINED_FIELDS.filter((f) => c[f]).map((f) => (
          <div key={f} style={{ display: 'contents' }}>
            <dt>{FIELD_LABEL[f]}</dt>
            <dd>{c[f]}</dd>
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>
      <h2>Atributi</h2>
      {c.attributes.length === 0 ? (
        <p>Ni atributov.</p>
      ) : (
        <dl className="props">
          {c.attributes.map((a) => (
            <div key={a.key} style={{ display: 'contents' }}>
              <dt>{a.key}</dt>
              <dd>{a.value}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
      <h2>Oznake</h2>
      {c.tags.length === 0 ? (
        <p>Ni oznak.</p>
      ) : (
        <p>
          {c.tags.map((t) => (
            <span className="tag" key={t}>
              {t}
            </span>
          ))}
        </p>
      )}
      <p className="muted">Različica {c.version}</p>
    </section>
  );
}

package si.contacts.acceptance;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import si.contacts.support.Api;
import si.contacts.support.ApiTestBase;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;

/** US-006: Attributes on Contacts. */
class AttributeApiTest extends ApiTestBase {
  TestUser owner;
  String contacts;

  @BeforeEach
  void workspace() {
    owner = user("Owner");
    contacts = "/api/workspaces/" + createWorkspace(owner, "Atributi") + "/contacts";
  }

  static Map<String, Object> attr(String k, String v) {
    return Map.of("key", k, "value", v);
  }

  Api.Res create(List<?> attributes) {
    return api.post(owner.token(), contacts, contact("firstName", "Ana", "attributes", attributes));
  }

  @Test
  void AC_006_01_attributesAreStoredAndReturnedInTheOrderGiven() {
    Api.Res r = create(List.of(attr("zadnji", "1"), attr("kompetenca", "spletnoProgramiranje"), attr("Alfa", "Č")));
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(201);
    JsonNode read = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + r.json().get("id").asText()).json();
    assertThat(read.get("attributes").valueStream().map(a -> a.get("key").asText())).containsExactly("zadnji", "kompetenca", "Alfa");
    assertThat(read.get("attributes").get(1).get("value").asText()).isEqualTo("spletnoProgramiranje");
    assertThat(read.get("attributes").get(2).get("value").asText()).isEqualTo("Č");
  }

  @Test
  void AC_006_02_aKeyOutsideThePatternIsRejected() {
    for (String key : new String[] {"1abc", "ima presledek", "", "a".repeat(51), "šola", "a/b"}) {
      Api.Res r = create(List.of(attr("ok", "v"), attr(key, "v")));
      assertThat(r.status()).as(key).isEqualTo(400);
      assertThat(errorFields(r)).as(key).containsExactly("attributes[1].key");
    }
    assertThat(create(List.of(attr("a_b.c-d1", "v"))).status()).isEqualTo(201);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_006_03_twoKeysDifferingOnlyInLetterCaseAreRejectedForTheSecond() {
    Api.Res r = create(List.of(attr("Kompetenca", "a"), attr("kompetenca", "b")));
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(400);
    assertThat(errorFields(r)).containsExactly("attributes[1].key");
  }

  @Test
  void AC_006_04_aKeyEqualToAPredefinedFieldIdOrTagsIsRejected() {
    for (String key : new String[] {"email", "FIRSTNAME", "postalCode", "id", "Tags", "note"}) {
      Api.Res r = create(List.of(attr(key, "v")));
      assertThat(r.status()).as(key).isEqualTo(400);
      assertThat(errorFields(r)).as(key).containsExactly("attributes[0].key");
    }
  }

  @Test
  void AC_006_05_emptyOrOverlongValuesAndMoreThan100AttributesAreRejected() {
    Api.Res empty = create(List.of(attr("a", "   ")));
    assertThat(empty.status()).isEqualTo(400);
    assertThat(errorFields(empty)).containsExactly("attributes[0].value");
    Api.Res longValue = create(List.of(attr("a", "x".repeat(501))));
    assertThat(errorFields(longValue)).containsExactly("attributes[0].value");
    assertThat(create(List.of(attr("a", "x".repeat(500)))).status()).isEqualTo(201);
    List<Map<String, Object>> many = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) many.add(attr("k" + i, "v"));
    Api.Res tooMany = create(many);
    assertThat(tooMany.status()).isEqualTo(400);
    assertThat(errorFields(tooMany)).containsExactly("attributes");
    assertThat(create(many.subList(0, 100)).status()).isEqualTo(201);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_006_06_anUpdateReplacesTheAttributesAsGiven() {
    JsonNode c = create(List.of(attr("a", "1"), attr("b", "2"))).json();
    String path = contacts + "/" + c.get("id").asText();
    Api.Res r = api.put(owner.token(), path, contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Ana", "attributes", List.of(attr("c", "3"), attr("a", "novo"))));
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(200);
    JsonNode read = api.get(owner.token(), path).json();
    assertThat(read.get("attributes").valueStream().map(a -> a.get("key").asText() + "=" + a.get("value").asText()))
        .containsExactly("c=3", "a=novo");
    api.put(owner.token(), path, contact("version", 2, "firstName", "Ana"));
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), path).json().get("attributes").size()).isZero();
  }
}

package si.contacts.acceptance;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import si.contacts.support.Api;
import si.contacts.support.ApiTestBase;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;

/** US-007: Tags. */
class TagApiTest extends ApiTestBase {
  TestUser owner;
  String w;
  String contacts;
  String tags;

  @BeforeEach
  void workspace() {
    owner = user("Owner");
    w = createWorkspace(owner, "Oznake");
    contacts = "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts";
    tags = "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/tags";
  }

  String create(String name, String... tagNames) {
    return createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", name, "tags", List.of(tagNames))).get("id").asText();
  }

  Map<String, Integer> counts() {
    Map<String, Integer> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
    api.get(owner.token(), tags).json().valueStream().forEach(t -> m.put(t.get("name").asText(), t.get("count").asInt()));
    return m;
  }

  @Test
  void AC_007_01_02_tagsAreCreatedImplicitlyAndReusedCaseInsensitivelyWithCorrectCounts() {
    String a = create("A", "neObvescaj", "udelezenec2025");
    JsonNode b = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "B", "tags", List.of("NEOBVESCAJ")));
    assertThat(b.get("tags").get(0).asText()).isEqualTo("neObvescaj");
    String c = create("C", "udelezenec2025");
    assertThat(counts()).containsExactly(Map.entry("neObvescaj", 2), Map.entry("udelezenec2025", 2));
    api.delete(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + c);
    assertThat(counts()).containsEntry("udelezenec2025", 1);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + a).json().get("tags").valueStream().map(JsonNode::asText))
        .containsExactly("neObvescaj", "udelezenec2025");
  }

  @Test
  void AC_007_03_invalidTagsAreRejected() {
    for (List<String> bad : List.of(List.of("ima presledek"), List.of("x".repeat(51)), List.of("vip", "VIP"))) {
      Api.Res r = api.post(owner.token(), contacts, contact("firstName", "A", "tags", bad));
      assertThat(r.status()).as(bad.toString()).isEqualTo(400);
      assertThat(errorFields(r).get(0)).startsWith("tags[");
    }
    List<String> many = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < 51; i++) many.add("t" + i);
    Api.Res tooMany = api.post(owner.token(), contacts, contact("firstName", "A", "tags", many));
    assertThat(tooMany.status()).isEqualTo(400);
    assertThat(errorFields(tooMany)).containsExactly("tags");
    assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), contacts, contact("firstName", "A", "tags", many.subList(0, 50))).status()).isEqualTo(201);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_007_04_renameUpdatesEveryContactAndWritesAnUpdateRevisionOnEach() {
    String a = create("A", "staro", "drugo");
    String b = create("B", "staro");
    String other = create("C", "drugo");
    Api.Res r = api.patch(owner.token(), tags + "/STARO", Map.of("name", "novo"));
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(r.json().get("name").asText()).isEqualTo("novo");
    assertThat(r.json().get("count").asInt()).isEqualTo(2);
    for (String id : List.of(a, b)) {
      JsonNode c = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id).json();
      assertThat(c.get("tags").valueStream().map(JsonNode::asText)).contains("novo").doesNotContain("staro");
      assertThat(c.get("version").asInt()).isEqualTo(2);
      JsonNode rev = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions").json().get(0);
      assertThat(rev.get("type").asText()).isEqualTo("UPDATE");
      assertThat(rev.get("state").get("tags").valueStream().map(JsonNode::asText)).contains("novo");
    }
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + a).json().get("tags").valueStream().map(JsonNode::asText))
        .containsExactly("novo", "drugo");
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + other).json().get("version").asInt()).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(api.patch(owner.token(), tags + "/novo", Map.of("name", "Novo")).status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(counts()).containsKey("Novo");
    assertThat(api.patch(owner.token(), tags + "/ni-ga", Map.of("name", "x")).status()).isEqualTo(404);
    assertThat(api.patch(owner.token(), tags + "/Novo", Map.of("name", "ima presledek")).status()).isEqualTo(400);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_007_05_renamingOntoAnExistingNameIsRejected() {
    create("A", "prvi", "drugi");
    Api.Res r = api.patch(owner.token(), tags + "/prvi", Map.of("name", "DRUGI"));
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(409);
    assertThat(counts()).containsExactly(Map.entry("drugi", 1), Map.entry("prvi", 1));
  }

  @Test
  void AC_007_06_deleteRemovesTheTagFromEveryContactWithARevisionEach() {
    String a = create("A", "brisi", "ostane");
    String b = create("B", "Brisi");
    assertThat(api.delete(owner.token(), tags + "/BRISI").status()).isEqualTo(204);
    assertThat(counts()).containsExactly(Map.entry("ostane", 1));
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + a).json().get("tags").valueStream().map(JsonNode::asText)).containsExactly("ostane");
    for (String id : List.of(a, b)) {
      JsonNode revs = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions").json();
      assertThat(revs.size()).isEqualTo(2);
      assertThat(revs.get(0).get("type").asText()).isEqualTo("UPDATE");
    }
    assertThat(api.delete(owner.token(), tags + "/brisi").status()).isEqualTo(404);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_007_07_aViewerCannotRenameOrDeleteTags() {
    TestUser viewer = user("Viewer");
    addMember(owner, w, viewer, "VIEWER");
    create("A", "oznaka");
    assertThat(api.patch(viewer.token(), tags + "/oznaka", Map.of("name", "x")).status()).isEqualTo(403);
    assertThat(api.delete(viewer.token(), tags + "/oznaka").status()).isEqualTo(403);
    assertThat(api.get(viewer.token(), tags).status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(counts()).containsEntry("oznaka", 1);
  }
}

p='store/TagStore.java'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.rstrip().rstrip('}')
s+='''
  public record TagCount(UUID id, String name, int count) {}

  /** Tags with the number of active Contacts carrying each, sorted by name. */
  public List<TagCount> counts(WorkspaceScope s) {
    return db.sql(
            "SELECT t.id, t.name, count(c.id) FROM tags t LEFT JOIN contact_tags ct ON ct.tag_id = t.id"
                + " LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = ct.contact_id AND NOT c.deleted"
                + " WHERE t.workspace_id = ? GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY t.name_lower, t.id")
        .param(s.workspaceId())
        .query((rs, i) -> new TagCount(rs.getObject(1, UUID.class), rs.getString(2), rs.getInt(3)))
        .list();
  }

  /** The Tag with this name ignoring case, locked for the rest of the transaction. */
  public java.util.Optional<Tag> findForUpdate(WorkspaceScope s, String name) {
    return db.sql("SELECT id, name FROM tags WHERE workspace_id = ? AND name_lower = ? FOR UPDATE")
        .params(s.workspaceId(), name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))
        .query((rs, i) -> new Tag(rs.getObject(1, UUID.class), rs.getString(2)))
        .optional();
  }

  public java.util.Optional<Tag> find(WorkspaceScope s, String name) {
    return db.sql("SELECT id, name FROM tags WHERE workspace_id = ? AND name_lower = ?")
        .params(s.workspaceId(), name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))
        .query((rs, i) -> new Tag(rs.getObject(1, UUID.class), rs.getString(2)))
        .optional();
  }

  /** Ids of every Contact (active or deleted) carrying the Tag, locked. */
  public List<UUID> contactsWith(WorkspaceScope s, UUID tagId) {
    return db.sql(
            "SELECT c.id FROM contacts c JOIN contact_tags ct ON ct.contact_id = c.id"
                + " WHERE c.workspace_id = ? AND ct.tag_id = ? ORDER BY c.id FOR UPDATE OF c")
        .params(s.workspaceId(), tagId)
        .query(UUID.class)
        .list();
  }

  public void rename(WorkspaceScope s, UUID tagId, String name) {
    db.sql("UPDATE tags SET name = ?, name_lower = ? WHERE workspace_id = ? AND id = ?")
        .params(name, name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), s.workspaceId(), tagId)
        .update();
  }

  public void delete(WorkspaceScope s, UUID tagId) {
    db.sql("DELETE FROM tags WHERE workspace_id = ? AND id = ?").params(s.workspaceId(), tagId).update();
  }
}

package si.contacts.tag;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PatchMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ResponseStatus;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import si.contacts.contact.Contact;
import si.contacts.contact.ContactService;
import si.contacts.contact.ContactValidator;
import si.contacts.store.ContactStore;
import si.contacts.store.ContactStore.Tag;
import si.contacts.store.TagStore;
import si.contacts.user.User;
import si.contacts.web.ApiException;
import si.contacts.workspace.Role;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceAccess;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/**
 * US-007: Tags of a Workspace. Rename and delete change every affected Contact, each with an
 * UPDATE Revision, in one transaction or not at all.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/workspaces/{wid}/tags")
public class TagController {
  private final WorkspaceAccess access;
  private final TagStore tags;
  private final ContactStore contacts;
  private final ContactService service;

  public TagController(WorkspaceAccess access, TagStore tags, ContactStore contacts, ContactService service) {
    this.access = access;
    this.tags = tags;
    this.contacts = contacts;
    this.service = service;
  }

  @GetMapping
  List<Map<String, Object>> list(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user);
    return tags.counts(s).stream().map(t -> view(t.name(), t.count())).toList();
  }

  @PatchMapping("/{name}")
  @Transactional
  Map<String, Object> rename(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable String name, @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user).require(Role.EDITOR);
    Object raw = body.get("name");
    String newName = raw instanceof String n ? n.strip() : null;
    if (!ContactValidator.validTag(newName)) throw ApiException.badRequest("name", "invalid tag");
    Tag tag = tags.findForUpdate(s, name).orElseThrow(ApiException::notFound);
    tags.find(s, newName)
        .filter(other -> !other.id().equals(tag.id()))
        .ifPresent(other -> {
          throw ApiException.conflict("name", "tag name taken");
        });
    List<UUID> affected = tags.contactsWith(s, tag.id());
    tags.rename(s, tag.id(), newName);
    for (Contact c : contacts.load(s, affected)) {
      List<String> renamed = c.state().tags().stream().map(t -> t.equalsIgnoreCase(tag.name()) ? newName : t).toList();
      service.write(s, c, c.version(), c.state().withTags(renamed), "UPDATE");
    }
    int count = (int) contacts.load(s, affected).stream().filter(c -> !c.state().deleted()).count();
    return view(newName, count);
  }

  @DeleteMapping("/{name}")
  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  @Transactional
  void delete(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @PathVariable String name) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user).require(Role.EDITOR);
    Tag tag = tags.findForUpdate(s, name).orElseThrow(ApiException::notFound);
    for (Contact c : contacts.load(s, tags.contactsWith(s, tag.id()))) {
      List<String> rest = c.state().tags().stream().filter(t -> !t.equalsIgnoreCase(tag.name())).toList();
      service.write(s, c, c.version(), c.state().withTags(rest), "UPDATE");
    }
    tags.delete(s, tag.id());
  }

  static Map<String, Object> view(String name, int count) {
    Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    m.put("name", name);
    m.put("count", count);
    return m;
  }
}

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router';
import { useApi } from '../lib/context';
import { useLoad } from '../lib/useLoad';
import { errorText, fieldErrors } from '../lib/messages';
import { can } from '../lib/roles';
import { Alert } from '../components/Alert';
import { FormField } from '../components/FormField';
import { useWorkspace } from './WorkspaceLayout';

export function TagsPage() {
  const api = useApi();
  const { workspace } = useWorkspace();
  const editor = can(workspace.role, 'EDITOR');
  const list = useLoad(() => api.listTags(workspace.id), [api, workspace.id]);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [renameError, setRenameError] = useState<string>();
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function rename(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editing) return;
    const n = newName.trim();
    if (!n || /\s/.test(n) || n.length > 50) return setRenameError('Oznaka ne sme vsebovati presledkov in je dolga največ 50 znakov.');
    try {
      await api.renameTag(workspace.id, editing, n);
      setEditing(null);
      setRenameError(undefined);
      await list.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      setRenameError(fieldErrors(err).name ?? errorText(err));
    }
  }

  async function remove(name: string) {
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.deleteTag(workspace.id, name);
      setDeleting(null);
      await list.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(errorText(err));
    }
  }

  return (
    <section>
      <h1>Oznake</h1>
      {list.error ? <Alert>{errorText(list.error)}</Alert> : null}
      {error && <Alert>{error}</Alert>}
      {list.data && list.data.length === 0 && <p>V tem delovnem prostoru še ni oznak.</p>}
      {list.data && list.data.length > 0 && (
        <table>
          <caption className="sr-only">Oznake in število kontaktov</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">Oznaka</th>
              <th scope="col">Kontaktov</th>
              {editor && <th scope="col">Dejanja</th>}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {list.data.map((t) => (
              <tr key={t.name}>
                <td>
                  <Link to={`/w/${workspace.id}?tag=${encodeURIComponent(t.name)}`}>{t.name}</Link>
                </td>
                <td>{t.count}</td>
                {editor && (
                  <td>
                    {editing === t.name ? (
                      <form onSubmit={rename} noValidate className="toolbar">
                        <FormField label={`Novo ime za ${t.name}`} value={newName} error={renameError} onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)} />
                        <button type="submit" className="primary">
                          Shrani ime
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>
                          Prekliči
                        </button>
                      </form>
                    ) : deleting === t.name ? (
                      <span>
                        Odstranim oznako z vseh kontaktov?{' '}
                        <button type="button" className="danger" onClick={() => void remove(t.name)}>
                          Potrdi izbris {t.name}
                        </button>{' '}
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => setDeleting(null)}>
                          Prekliči
                        </button>
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="actions">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setEditing(t.name);
                            setNewName(t.name);
                            setRenameError(undefined);
                          }}
                        >
                          Preimenuj {t.name}
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => setDeleting(t.name)}>
                          Izbriši {t.name}
                        </button>
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                )}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright';
import { expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

export const EMULATOR = process.env.E2E_AUTH_EMULATOR ?? 'http://localhost:9099';
const API_KEY = 'demo-api-key';

export function uniqueEmail(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}.${Date.now()}.${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6)}@example.si`;
}

export const PASSWORD = 'geslo-123456';

/** Signs up through the UI and lands on the Workspace list. */
export async function signUp(page: Page, name: string, email: string): Promise<void> {
  await page.goto('/');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registracija' }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('Ime in priimek').fill(name);
  await page.getByLabel('E-pošta').fill(email);
  await page.getByLabel('Geslo').fill(PASSWORD);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registracija' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Delovni prostori' })).toBeVisible();
}

export async function signIn(page: Page, email: string): Promise<void> {
  await page.goto('/');
  await page.getByLabel('E-pošta').fill(email);
  await page.getByLabel('Geslo').fill(PASSWORD);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Prijava', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Delovni prostori' })).toBeVisible();
}

export async function signOut(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Odjava' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Prijava' })).toBeVisible();
}

/** Marks the account's email as verified in the Auth emulator (what clicking the link would do). */
export async function verifyEmail(email: string): Promise<void> {
  const signInRes = await fetch(`${EMULATOR}/identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:signInWithPassword?key=${API_KEY}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ email, password: PASSWORD, returnSecureToken: true }),
  });
  const { localId } = (await signInRes.json()) as { localId: string };
  const res = await fetch(`${EMULATOR}/identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:update?key=${API_KEY}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer owner' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ localId, emailVerified: true }),
  });
  expect(res.ok).toBeTruthy();
}

export async function createWorkspace(page: Page, name: string): Promise<void> {
  await page.getByLabel('Ime', { exact: true }).fill(name);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ustvari' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('link', { name }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Kontakti' })).toBeVisible();
}

export interface NewContact {
  firstName?: string;
  lastName?: string;
  email?: string;
  phone?: string;
  company?: string;
  city?: string;
  country?: string;
  tags?: string;
  attributes?: [string, string][];
}

/** Creates a Contact through the form; ends on the Contact page (or the form when a duplicate warning shows). */
export async function createContact(page: Page, c: NewContact): Promise<void> {
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Nov kontakt' }).click();
  if (c.firstName) await page.getByLabel('Ime', { exact: true }).fill(c.firstName);
  if (c.lastName) await page.getByLabel('Priimek').fill(c.lastName);
  if (c.email) await page.getByLabel('E-pošta').fill(c.email);
  if (c.phone) await page.getByLabel('Telefon').fill(c.phone);
  if (c.company) await page.getByLabel('Podjetje').fill(c.company);
  if (c.city) await page.getByLabel('Kraj').fill(c.city);
  if (c.country) await page.getByLabel('Država (koda, npr. SI)').fill(c.country);
  for (const [i, [k, v]] of (c.attributes ?? []).entries()) {
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dodaj atribut' }).click();
    await page.getByLabel(`Ključ ${i + 1}`).fill(k);
    await page.getByLabel(`Vrednost ${i + 1}`).fill(v);
  }
  if (c.tags) await page.getByLabel('Oznake (ločene s presledkom)').fill(c.tags);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Shrani' }).click();
}

/** NFR-06: no serious or critical axe-core violations on the current page. */
export async function expectAccessible(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page }).analyze();
  const bad = results.violations.filter((v) => v.impact === 'serious' || v.impact === 'critical');
  expect(bad.map((v) => `${v.id}: ${v.nodes.map((n) => n.target.join(' ')).join(', ')}`)).toEqual([]);
}

  }

    assertThat(r.status()).as(r.toString()).isEqualTo(200);
    return r.json().get("items").valueStream().map(i -> i.get("id").asText()).toList();
  }

  static String enc(String s) {
    return java.net.URLEncoder.encode(s, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_008_01_searchIgnoresCaseAndDiacritics() {
    String sasa = add("firstName", "Saša", "lastName", "Đurić");
    String other = add("firstName", "Marko");
    assertThat(ids("?q=sasa")).containsExactly(sasa);
    assertThat(ids("?q=SAŠA")).containsExactly(sasa);
    assertThat(ids("?q=duric")).containsExactly(sasa);
    assertThat(ids("?q=" + enc("saša đurić"))).containsExactly(sasa);
    assertThat(ids("?q=mark")).containsExactly(other);
    assertThat(ids("?q=" + enc("%"))).isEmpty();
  }

  @Test
  void AC_008_02_searchCoversExactlyNameEmailPhoneCompanyAndCity() {
    String byEmail = add("firstName", "A", "email", "posta@primer.si");
    String byPhone = add("firstName", "B", "phone", "+386 41 987 654");
    String byCompany = add("firstName", "C", "company", "Krka d.d.");
    String byCity = add("firstName", "D", "city", "Novo mesto");
    add("firstName", "E", "jobTitle", "skrito", "street", "skrito", "note", "skrito", "postalCode", "8000",
        "attributes", List.of(Map.of("key", "x", "value", "skrito")), "tags", List.of("skrito"));
    assertThat(ids("?q=primer.si")).containsExactly(byEmail);
    assertThat(ids("?q=987")).containsExactly(byPhone);
    assertThat(ids("?q=krka")).containsExactly(byCompany);
    assertThat(ids("?q=novo%20mesto")).containsExactly(byCity);
    assertThat(ids("?q=skrito")).isEmpty();
    assertThat(ids("?q=8000")).isEmpty();
  }

  @Test
  void AC_008_03_tagFiltersWithAllAndAny() {
    String ab = add("firstName", "AB", "tags", List.of("a", "b"));
    String a = add("firstName", "A", "tags", List.of("a"));
    String b = add("firstName", "B", "tags", List.of("B"));
    add("firstName", "N");
    assertThat(ids("?tag=a&tag=B")).containsExactly(ab);
    assertThat(ids("?tag=a&tag=b&tagMode=all")).containsExactly(ab);
    assertThat(ids("?tag=A&tag=b&tagMode=any")).containsExactlyInAnyOrder(ab, a, b);
    assertThat(ids("?tag=neznana")).isEmpty();
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "?tagMode=none").status()).isEqualTo(400);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_008_04_attributeFiltersByKeyValueCaseInsensitivelyAndByKey() {
    String web = add("firstName", "W", "attributes", List.of(Map.of("key", "kompetenca", "value", "spletnoProgramiranje")));
    String other = add("firstName", "O", "attributes", List.of(Map.of("key", "Kompetenca", "value", "oblikovanje")));
    add("firstName", "N");
    assertThat(ids("?attr=" + enc("KOMPETENCA=spletnoprogramiranje"))).containsExactly(web);
    assertThat(ids("?attr=kompetenca")).containsExactlyInAnyOrder(web, other);
    assertThat(ids("?attr=kompetenca&attr=" + enc("kompetenca=oblikovanje"))).containsExactly(other);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_008_05_countryCompanyAndSearchTextCombineWithAnd() {
    String match = add("firstName", "Ana", "country", "SI", "company", "Krka");
    add("firstName", "Ana", "country", "AT", "company", "Krka");
    add("firstName", "Ana", "country", "SI", "company", "Lek");
    add("firstName", "Bor", "country", "SI", "company", "Krka");
    assertThat(ids("?country=si&company=KRKA&q=ana")).containsExactly(match);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_008_06_pagingWithTotalAndNoRepeatsAndSizeAbove100IsRejected() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 25; i++) add("firstName", "Ime" + i, "lastName", "Priimek" + (char) ('A' + (i % 26)));
    Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
    List<String> all = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int page = 0; page < 3; page++) {
      JsonNode r = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "?size=10&page=" + page).json();
      assertThat(r.get("total").asInt()).isEqualTo(25);
      assertThat(r.get("page").asInt()).isEqualTo(page);
      r.get("items").valueStream().forEach(i -> {
        assertThat(seen.add(i.get("id").asText())).isTrue();
        all.add(i.get("lastName").asText());
      });
    }
    assertThat(seen).hasSize(25);
    assertThat(all).isSorted();
    Api.Res big = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "?size=101");
    assertThat(big.status()).isEqualTo(400);
    assertThat(errorFields(big)).containsExactly("size");
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "?size=100").status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "?page=-1").status()).isEqualTo(400);
  }

  @Test
  void sortsByFirstNameCompanyAndLastChange() {
    String c = add("firstName", "Cene", "company", "Alfa");
    String a = add("firstName", "Ana", "company", "Cveta");
    String b = add("firstName", "Bor", "company", "Beta");
    assertThat(ids("?sort=firstName")).containsExactly(a, b, c);
    assertThat(ids("?sort=firstName&dir=desc")).containsExactly(c, b, a);
    assertThat(ids("?sort=company")).containsExactly(c, b, a);
    api.put(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + a, contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Ana"));
    assertThat(ids("?sort=updatedAt").get(0)).isEqualTo(a);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "?sort=email").status()).isEqualTo(400);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_008_07_deletedContactsOnlyInTheDeletedView() {
    String active = add("firstName", "Aktiven");
    String gone = add("firstName", "Izbrisan");
    api.delete(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + gone);
    assertThat(ids("")).containsExactly(active);
    assertThat(ids("?deleted=true")).containsExactly(gone);
    assertThat(ids("?deleted=true&q=izbrisan")).containsExactly(gone);
    assertThat(ids("?q=izbrisan")).isEmpty();
  }
}

import type { ContactQuery, SortField } from './api';
import { splitTags } from './contactForm';

export const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/** The list's search and filters live in the URL, so they survive navigation and links like ?tag=x. */
export function queryFromParams(p: URLSearchParams): ContactQuery {
  const tags = p.getAll('tag').flatMap(splitTags);
  return {
    q: p.get('q') ?? undefined,
    tag: tags.length ? tags : undefined,
    tagMode: p.get('tagMode') === 'any' ? 'any' : undefined,
    attr: p.getAll('attr').filter(Boolean),
    country: p.get('country') ?? undefined,
    company: p.get('company') ?? undefined,
    sort: (p.get('sort') as SortField | null) ?? undefined,
    dir: p.get('dir') === 'desc' ? 'desc' : p.get('dir') === 'asc' ? 'asc' : undefined,
    page: Number(p.get('page') ?? 0) || 0,
    size: PAGE_SIZE,
  };
}

/** The filter part only (for Export): no paging. */
export function filterOf(q: ContactQuery) {
  const { page: _page, size: _size, deleted: _deleted, ...filter } = q;
  void _page;
  void _size;
  void _deleted;
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(filter).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== '' && !(Array.isArray(v) && v.length === 0)),
  );
}
EOF

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router';
import type { Contact, ContactPage } from '../lib/api';
import { useApi } from '../lib/context';
import { errorText } from '../lib/messages';
import { PAGE_SIZE, filterOf, queryFromParams } from '../lib/listQuery';
import { can } from '../lib/roles';
import { Alert } from '../components/Alert';
import { contactName } from './ContactPage';
import { useWorkspace } from './WorkspaceLayout';

const SORTS = [
  ['lastName', 'Priimek'],
  ['firstName', 'Ime'],
  ['company', 'Podjetje'],
  ['updatedAt', 'Zadnja sprememba'],
] as const;

/** One text input bound to a URL parameter; updates the list while typing, without a reload. */
function ParamInput({ label, name, params, set }: { label: string; name: string; params: URLSearchParams; set: (n: string, v: string) => void }) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(params.getAll(name).join(' '));
  const current = params.getAll(name).join(' ');
  useEffect(() => setValue(current), [current]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (value === current) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => set(name, value), 250);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [value, current, name, set]);
  return (
    <div className="field">
      <label htmlFor={`f-${name}`}>{label}</label>
      <input id={`f-${name}`} type="search" value={value} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)} />
    </div>
  );
}

export function ContactListPage({ deleted = false }: { deleted?: boolean }) {
  const api = useApi();
  const { workspace } = useWorkspace();
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const query = useMemo(() => ({ ...queryFromParams(params), deleted }), [params, deleted]);
  const [page, setPage] = useState<ContactPage | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [exportError, setExportError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  const key = JSON.stringify(query);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    api.listContacts(workspace.id, query).then(
      (p) => {
        if (active) {
          setPage(p);
          setError(null);
        }
      },
      (e: unknown) => {
        if (active) setError(e);
      },
    );
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [api, workspace.id, key]);

  const set = useMemo(
    () => (name: string, value: string) =>
      setParams(
        (old) => {
          const next = new URLSearchParams(old);
          next.delete(name);
          if (value.trim()) next.set(name, value.trim());
          if (name !== 'page') next.delete('page');
          return next;
        },
        { replace: true },
      ),
    [setParams],
  );

  function toggle(id: string) {
    setSelected((old) => {
      const next = new Set(old);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  }

  async function exportContacts() {
    setExportError(null);
    setExporting(true);
    try {
      const request = selected.size > 0 ? { contactIds: [...selected] } : { filter: filterOf(query) };
      const file = await api.exportContacts(workspace.id, request);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(file.blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = file.filename;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    } catch (e) {
      setExportError(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setExporting(false);
    }
  }

  const items: Contact[] = page?.items ?? [];
  const allOnPage = items.length > 0 && items.every((c) => selected.has(c.id));
  const pages = page ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(page.total / PAGE_SIZE)) : 1;
  const current = query.page ?? 0;

  return (
    <section>
      <h1>{deleted ? 'Izbrisani kontakti' : 'Kontakti'}</h1>
      {!deleted && can(workspace.role, 'EDITOR') && (
        <p>
          <Link to={`/w/${workspace.id}/kontakti/nov`}>Nov kontakt</Link>
        </p>
      )}
      <form role="search" aria-label="Iskanje in filtri" className="toolbar" onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
        <ParamInput label="Iskanje" name="q" params={params} set={set} />
        {!deleted && (
          <>
            <ParamInput label="Oznake" name="tag" params={params} set={set} />
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="f-tagMode">Ujemanje oznak</label>
              <select id="f-tagMode" value={query.tagMode ?? 'all'} onChange={(e) => set('tagMode', e.target.value === 'any' ? 'any' : '')}>
                <option value="all">vse oznake</option>
                <option value="any">katera koli oznaka</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <ParamInput label="Atribut (ključ ali ključ=vrednost)" name="attr" params={params} set={set} />
            <ParamInput label="Država" name="country" params={params} set={set} />
            <ParamInput label="Podjetje (natančno)" name="company" params={params} set={set} />
          </>
        )}
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="f-sort">Razvrsti po</label>
          <select id="f-sort" value={query.sort ?? 'lastName'} onChange={(e) => set('sort', e.target.value === 'lastName' ? '' : e.target.value)}>
            {SORTS.map(([v, l]) => (
              <option key={v} value={v}>
                {l}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="f-dir">Smer</label>
          <select id="f-dir" value={query.dir ?? ''} onChange={(e) => set('dir', e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">privzeto</option>
            <option value="asc">naraščajoče</option>
            <option value="desc">padajoče</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </form>
      {error ? <Alert>{errorText(error)}</Alert> : null}
      {page && (
        <p role="status" aria-live="polite">
          Najdenih: {page.total}
        </p>
      )}
      {!deleted && page && (
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" className="primary" disabled={exporting || (selected.size === 0 && page.total === 0)} onClick={() => void exportContacts()}>
            {selected.size > 0 ? `Izvozi izbrane (${selected.size})` : `Izvozi vse najdene (${page.total})`}
          </button>
          {selected.size > 0 && (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setSelected(new Set())}>
              Počisti izbor
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {exportError && <Alert>{exportError}</Alert>}
      {page && items.length > 0 && (
        <table>
          <caption className="sr-only">{deleted ? 'Izbrisani kontakti' : 'Kontakti'}</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              {!deleted && (
                <th scope="col">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    aria-label="Izberi vse na strani"
                    checked={allOnPage}
                    onChange={() =>
                      setSelected((old) => {
                        const next = new Set(old);
                        items.forEach((c) => (allOnPage ? next.delete(c.id) : next.add(c.id)));
                        return next;
                      })
                    }
                  />
                </th>
              )}
              <th scope="col">Ime in priimek</th>
              <th scope="col">E-pošta</th>
              <th scope="col">Telefon</th>
              <th scope="col">Podjetje</th>
              <th scope="col">Kraj</th>
              <th scope="col">Oznake</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {items.map((c) => (
              <tr key={c.id}>
                {!deleted && (
                  <td>
                    <input type="checkbox" aria-label={`Izberi ${contactName(c)}`} checked={selected.has(c.id)} onChange={() => toggle(c.id)} />
                  </td>
                )}
                <td>
                  <Link to={`/w/${workspace.id}/kontakti/${c.id}`}>{contactName(c)}</Link>
                </td>
                <td>{c.email}</td>
                <td>{c.phone}</td>
                <td>{c.company}</td>
                <td>{c.city}</td>
                <td>
                  {c.tags.map((t) => (
                    <span className="tag" key={t}>
                      {t}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}
      {page && items.length === 0 && <p>{deleted ? 'Ni izbrisanih kontaktov.' : 'Ni kontaktov, ki bi ustrezali iskanju.'}</p>}
      {page && pages > 1 && (
        <nav className="pager" aria-label="Strani">
          <button type="button" disabled={current === 0} onClick={() => set('page', String(current - 1))}>
            Prejšnja stran
          </button>
          <span>
            Stran {current + 1} od {pages}
          </span>
          <button type="button" disabled={current + 1 >= pages} onClick={() => set('page', String(current + 1))}>
            Naslednja stran
          </button>
        </nav>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

p='src/pages/ContactListPage.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';","import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';")
s=s.replace('''  const set = useMemo(
    () => (name: string, value: string) =>
      setParams(
        (old) => {
          const next = new URLSearchParams(old);
          next.delete(name);
          if (value.trim()) next.set(name, value.trim());
          if (name !== 'page') next.delete('page');
          return next;
        },
        { replace: true },
      ),
    [setParams],
  );''','''  // Several debounced inputs may fire before a re-render; build on the latest params, not the rendered ones.
  const latest = useRef(params);
  useEffect(() => {
    latest.current = params;
  }, [params]);
  const set = useMemo(
    () => (name: string, value: string) => {
      const next = new URLSearchParams(latest.current);
      next.delete(name);
      if (value.trim()) next.set(name, value.trim());
      if (name !== 'page') next.delete('page');
      latest.current = next;
      setParams(next, { replace: true });
    },
    [setParams],
  );''')
open(p,'w').write(s)

package si.contacts.acceptance;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.CyclicBarrier;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

/** US-009: Revision history and Restore. */
class RevisionApiTest extends ApiTestBase {

  String w;
  String contacts;

  @BeforeEach
  void workspace() {
    owner = user("Owner Revizij");
    w = createWorkspace(owner, "Revizije");
    contacts = "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts";

  @Test
  void AC_009_01_revisionsAreListedNewestFirstWithNumberTypeAuthorAndFullState() {
    TestUser editor = user("Urednica");
    addMember(owner, w, editor, "EDITOR");

    api.put(editor.token(), contacts + "/" + id, contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Ana", "lastName", "Kos", "author", "lažni"));
    api.delete(editor.token(), contacts + "/" + id);
    JsonNode revs = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions").json();
    assertThat(revs.valueStream().map(r -> r.get("number").asInt())).containsExactly(3, 2, 1);
    assertThat(revs.valueStream().map(r -> r.get("type").asText())).containsExactly("DELETE", "UPDATE", "CREATE");
    assertThat(revs.get(1).get("author").get("email").asText()).isEqualTo(editor.email());
    assertThat(revs.get(2).get("author").get("email").asText()).isEqualTo(owner.email());
    assertThat(revs.get(2).get("author").get("displayName").asText()).isEqualTo("Owner Revizij");
    assertThat(revs.get(2).get("createdAt").asText()).isNotBlank();
    JsonNode first = revs.get(2).get("state");
    assertThat(first.get("firstName").asText()).isEqualTo("Ana");
    assertThat(first.get("lastName").isNull()).isTrue();
    assertThat(first.get("tags").get(0).asText()).isEqualTo("t1");
    assertThat(first.get("attributes").get(0).get("key").asText()).isEqualTo("k");
    assertThat(first.get("deleted").asBoolean()).isFalse();
    assertThat(revs.get(1).get("state").get("lastName").asText()).isEqualTo("Kos");
    assertThat(revs.get(1).get("state").get("tags").size()).isZero();
    assertThat(revs.get(0).get("state").get("deleted").asBoolean()).isTrue();
  }

  @Test
  void AC_009_02_restoringRevision1WritesRevisionNPlus1EqualToItAndLeavesTheOthersUnchanged() {
    String id = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "Prvotna", "city", "Kranj")).get("id").asText();
    api.put(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id, contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Druga"));
    api.put(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id, contact("version", 2, "firstName", "Tretja", "email", "t@example.si"));
    JsonNode before = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions").json();
    Api.Res r = api.post(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions/1/restore", Map.of("version", 3));
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(r.json().get("version").asInt()).isEqualTo(4);
    assertThat(r.json().get("firstName").asText()).isEqualTo("Prvotna");
    assertThat(r.json().get("city").asText()).isEqualTo("Kranj");
    assertThat(r.json().get("email").isNull()).isTrue();
    JsonNode after = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions").json();
    assertThat(after.get(0).get("number").asInt()).isEqualTo(4);
    assertThat(after.get(0).get("type").asText()).isEqualTo("RESTORE");
    assertThat(after.get(0).get("state")).isEqualTo(after.get(3).get("state"));
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) assertThat(after.get(i + 1)).isEqualTo(before.get(i));
    assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions/1/restore", Map.of("version", 3)).status()).isEqualTo(409);
    assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions/9/restore", Map.of("version", 4)).status()).isEqualTo(404);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_009_03_restoringBringsBackATagDeletedFromTheWorkspaceSince() {
    String id = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "A", "tags", List.of("Izgubljena"))).get("id").asText();
    assertThat(api.delete(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/tags/izgubljena").status()).isEqualTo(204);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/tags").json().size()).isZero();
    Api.Res r = api.post(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions/1/restore", Map.of("version", 2));
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(r.json().get("tags").get(0).asText()).isEqualTo("Izgubljena");
    JsonNode tags = api.get(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/tags").json();
    assertThat(tags.get(0).get("name").asText()).isEqualTo("Izgubljena");
    assertThat(tags.get(0).get("count").asInt()).isEqualTo(1);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_009_04_aDeletedContactIsRestoredWithItsLastStateAndRestoringAnEarlierRevisionIsRejected() {
    String id = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "A")).get("id").asText();
    api.put(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id, contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Zadnja", "tags", List.of("x")));
    api.delete(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id);
    assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions/1/restore", Map.of("version", 3)).status()).isEqualTo(409);
    Api.Res r = api.post(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/restore", null);
    assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(r.json().get("deleted").asBoolean()).isFalse();
    assertThat(r.json().get("firstName").asText()).isEqualTo("Zadnja");
    assertThat(r.json().get("tags").get(0).asText()).isEqualTo("x");
    assertThat(r.json().get("version").asInt()).isEqualTo(4);
    JsonNode revs = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions").json();
    assertThat(revs.get(0).get("type").asText()).isEqualTo("RESTORE");
    assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/restore", null).status()).isEqualTo(409);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts).json().get("total").asInt()).isEqualTo(1);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_009_05_ofTwoConcurrentSavesOnTheSameVersionExactlyOneWins() throws Exception {
    for (int round = 0; round < 5; round++) {
      String id = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "Sočasno")).get("id").asText();
      CyclicBarrier barrier = new CyclicBarrier(2);
      List<CompletableFuture<Integer>> saves =
          List.of("Prvi", "Drugi").stream()
              .map(name -> CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> {
                try {
                  barrier.await();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                  throw new IllegalStateException(e);
                }
                return api.put(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id, contact("version", 1, "firstName", name)).status();
              }))
              .toList();
      List<Integer> statuses = saves.stream().map(CompletableFuture::join).sorted().toList();
      assertThat(statuses).containsExactly(200, 409);
      JsonNode revs = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions").json();
      assertThat(revs.size()).isEqualTo(2);
    }
  }

  @Test
  void AC_009_08_noEndpointChangesOrDeletesARevision() {
    String id = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "A")).get("id").asText();
    String rev = contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions/1";
    assertThat(api.put(owner.token(), rev, Map.of("type", "UPDATE")).status()).isIn(404, 405);
    assertThat(api.patch(owner.token(), rev, Map.of("type", "UPDATE")).status()).isIn(404, 405);
    assertThat(api.delete(owner.token(), rev).status()).isIn(404, 405);
    assertThat(api.delete(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions").status()).isIn(404, 405);
    assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions", Map.of("type", "UPDATE")).status()).isIn(404, 405);
    JsonNode revs = api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions").json();
    assertThat(revs.size()).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(revs.get(0).get("type").asText()).isEqualTo("CREATE");
  }
}

import { PREDEFINED_FIELDS, type ContactState } from './api';
import { FIELD_LABEL } from './contactForm';

export interface Change {
  label: string;
  old: string | null;
  new: string | null;
}

/** What changed from `before` (null for the first Revision) to `after`: fields, Attributes and Tags. */
export function diff(before: ContactState | null, after: ContactState): Change[] {
  const out: Change[] = [];
  PREDEFINED_FIELDS.forEach((f) => {
    const o = before ? before[f] : null;
    const n = after[f];
    if ((o ?? null) !== (n ?? null)) out.push({ label: FIELD_LABEL[f], old: o ?? null, new: n ?? null });
  });
  const oldAttrs = new Map((before?.attributes ?? []).map((a) => [a.key.toLowerCase(), a]));
  const newAttrs = new Map(after.attributes.map((a) => [a.key.toLowerCase(), a]));
  after.attributes.forEach((a) => {
    const prev = oldAttrs.get(a.key.toLowerCase());
    if (!prev || prev.value !== a.value) out.push({ label: `Atribut ${a.key}`, old: prev?.value ?? null, new: a.value });
  });
  (before?.attributes ?? []).forEach((a) => {
    if (!newAttrs.has(a.key.toLowerCase())) out.push({ label: `Atribut ${a.key}`, old: a.value, new: null });
  });
  const oldTags = before?.tags ?? [];
  const added = after.tags.filter((t) => !oldTags.some((o) => o.toLowerCase() === t.toLowerCase()));
  const removed = oldTags.filter((t) => !after.tags.some((o) => o.toLowerCase() === t.toLowerCase()));
  const renamed = after.tags.filter((t) => oldTags.some((o) => o !== t && o.toLowerCase() === t.toLowerCase()));
  added.forEach((t) => out.push({ label: 'Oznaka', old: null, new: t }));
  removed.forEach((t) => out.push({ label: 'Oznaka', old: t, new: null }));
  renamed.forEach((t) => out.push({ label: 'Oznaka', old: oldTags.find((o) => o.toLowerCase() === t.toLowerCase()) ?? null, new: t }));
  if (before && before.deleted !== after.deleted)
    out.push({ label: 'Stanje', old: before.deleted ? 'izbrisan' : 'aktiven', new: after.deleted ? 'izbrisan' : 'aktiven' });
  return out;
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router';
import { ApiError, type RevisionType } from '../lib/api';
import { useApi } from '../lib/context';
import { useLoad } from '../lib/useLoad';
import { errorText } from '../lib/messages';
import { diff } from '../lib/diff';
import { can } from '../lib/roles';
import { Alert } from '../components/Alert';
import { NotFoundPage } from './NotFoundPage';
import { contactName } from './ContactPage';
import { useWorkspace } from './WorkspaceLayout';

const TYPE_LABEL: Record<RevisionType, string> = {
  CREATE: 'Ustvarjen',
  UPDATE: 'Spremenjen',
  DELETE: 'Izbrisan',
  RESTORE: 'Obnovljen',
  MERGE: 'Združen (ohranjen)',
  MERGED_AWAY: 'Združen v drug kontakt',
};

function formatTime(iso: string): string {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('sl-SI', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' });
}

export function HistoryPage() {
  const { cid = '' } = useParams();
  const api = useApi();
  const { workspace } = useWorkspace();
  const data = useLoad(
    async () => {
      const [contact, revisions] = await Promise.all([api.getContact(workspace.id, cid), api.listRevisions(workspace.id, cid)]);
      return { contact, revisions };
    },
    [api, workspace.id, cid],
  );
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (data.error instanceof ApiError && data.error.status === 404) return <NotFoundPage />;
  if (data.error) return <Alert>{errorText(data.error)}</Alert>;
  if (!data.data) return <p role="status">Nalaganje …</p>;
  const { contact, revisions } = data.data;
  const editor = can(workspace.role, 'EDITOR');

  async function restore(number: number) {
    setError(null);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      await api.restoreRevision(workspace.id, cid, number, contact.version);
      setMessage(`Revizija ${number} je obnovljena kot nova revizija.`);
      await data.reload();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    }
  }

  return (
    <section>
      <h1>Zgodovina: {contactName(contact)}</h1>
      <p>
        <Link to={`/w/${workspace.id}/kontakti/${cid}`}>Nazaj na kontakt</Link>
      </p>
      {message && <Alert kind="info">{message}</Alert>}
      {error && <Alert>{error}</Alert>}
      <ol className="cards" reversed>
        {revisions.map((r) => {
          const previous = revisions.find((p) => p.number === r.number - 1) ?? null;
          const changes = diff(previous?.state ?? null, r.state);
          return (
            <li key={r.number} aria-label={`Revizija ${r.number}`}>
              <h2>
                Revizija {r.number}: {TYPE_LABEL[r.type]}
              </h2>
              <p className="muted">
                {r.author.displayName || r.author.email} · {formatTime(r.createdAt)}
              </p>
              {changes.length === 0 ? (
                <p>Brez sprememb podatkov.</p>
              ) : (
                <table>
                  <caption className="sr-only">Spremembe v reviziji {r.number}</caption>
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th scope="col">Polje</th>
                      <th scope="col">Prej</th>
                      <th scope="col">Potem</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {changes.map((c, i) => (
                      <tr key={i}>
                        <td>{c.label}</td>
                        <td>{c.old !== null ? <del className="diff-old">{c.old}</del> : '—'}</td>
                        <td>{c.new !== null ? <ins className="diff-new">{c.new}</ins> : '—'}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              )}
              {editor && !contact.deleted && r.number !== contact.version && (
                <button type="button" onClick={() => void restore(r.number)}>
                  Obnovi revizijo {r.number}
                </button>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </section>
  );
}
EOF

    add("firstName", "C", "email", "druga@example.si");

  }

    String c = add("firstName", "C", "phone", "(00386) 41 123456");
    add("firstName", "D", "phone", "12345");
    add("firstName", "E", "phone", "1-2-3-4-5");
    add("firstName", "F", "phone", "041 123 456");
    assertThat(sets()).containsExactly(Set.of(a, b, c));
  }

  @Test
  void AC_010_03_fullNamesMatchIgnoringCaseSpacesAndDiacriticsAndAFirstNameAloneNeverMatches() {
    String a = add("firstName", "Saša", "lastName", "Đurić");
    String b = add("firstName", "  sasa ", "lastName", "DURIC");
    String c = add("firstName", "Sa  ša", "lastName", "Đurić");
    add("firstName", "Saša");
    add("firstName", "Saša", "email", "x@example.si");
    add("lastName", "Đurić");
    List<Set<String>> s = sets();
    assertThat(s).hasSize(1);
    assertThat(s.get(0)).contains(a, b).doesNotContain(c);

    String b = add("firstName", "Anka", "email", "ANA@example.si", "phone", "+386 40 555 666");
    String c = add("firstName", "Cilka", "phone", "00386 40 555 666");
    String d = add("firstName", "ana", "lastName", "kos");
    String e = add("firstName", "Lonely", "email", "lonely@example.si");
    assertThat(sets()).containsExactly(Set.of(a, b, c, d));
    JsonNode set = api.get(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/duplicate-sets").json().get(0);
    assertThat(set.get("matches").valueStream().map(m -> m.get("kind").asText())).containsExactlyInAnyOrder("EMAIL", "PHONE", "NAME");
    JsonNode email = set.get("matches").valueStream().filter(m -> m.get("kind").asText().equals("EMAIL")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
    assertThat(email.get("contactIds").valueStream().map(JsonNode::asText)).containsExactlyInAnyOrder(a, b);
    assertThat(email.get("value").asText()).isEqualTo("ana@example.si");
    assertThat(e).isNotNull();
  }

  @Test

    String c = add("firstName", "C", "email", "x@example.si");
    api.delete(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + c);
    assertThat(sets()).containsExactly(Set.of(a, b));
    api.delete(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + b);
    assertThat(sets()).isEmpty();
  }

  @Test
  void AC_010_06_createAndUpdateReturnPossibleDuplicatesWithoutBlockingTheSave() {
    String a = add("firstName", "Ana", "lastName", "Kos", "email", "ana@example.si", "phone", "041 222 333");
    Api.Res created = api.post(owner.token(), contacts, contact("firstName", "ANA", "lastName", "kos", "email", "Ana@Example.si"));
    assertThat(created.status()).isEqualTo(201);
    JsonNode dup = created.json().get("possibleDuplicates");
    assertThat(dup.size()).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(dup.get(0).get("id").asText()).isEqualTo(a);
    assertThat(dup.get(0).get("matchKinds").valueStream().map(JsonNode::asText)).containsExactly("EMAIL", "NAME");
    String b = created.json().get("id").asText();
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + b).status()).isEqualTo(200);

    Api.Res other = api.post(owner.token(), contacts, contact("firstName", "Bor"));
    assertThat(other.json().get("possibleDuplicates").size()).isZero();
    Api.Res updated = api.put(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + other.json().get("id").asText(),
        contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Bor", "phone", "+386 41 222 333"));
    assertThat(updated.status()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(updated.json().get("possibleDuplicates").size()).isZero();
    Api.Res updated2 = api.put(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + other.json().get("id").asText(),
        contact("version", 2, "firstName", "Bor", "phone", "041-222-333"));
    assertThat(updated2.json().get("possibleDuplicates").get(0).get("matchKinds").get(0).asText()).isEqualTo("PHONE");
  }
}

package si.contacts.store;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/** The normalised match keys of the active Contacts of a Workspace that share one with another. */
@Repository
public class DuplicateStore {
  private final JdbcClient db;

  public DuplicateStore(JdbcClient db) {
    this.db = db;
  }

  public record Key(UUID contactId, String kind, String value) {}

  /** Every (Contact, kind, value) whose value is shared by at least two active Contacts. */
  public List<Key> sharedKeys(WorkspaceScope s) {
    return db.sql(
            "WITH keys AS ("
                + " SELECT id, 'EMAIL' AS kind, email_norm AS value FROM contacts WHERE workspace_id = :ws AND NOT deleted AND email_norm IS NOT NULL"
                + " UNION ALL SELECT id, 'PHONE', phone_norm FROM contacts WHERE workspace_id = :ws AND NOT deleted AND phone_norm IS NOT NULL"
                + " UNION ALL SELECT id, 'NAME', name_norm FROM contacts WHERE workspace_id = :ws AND NOT deleted AND name_norm IS NOT NULL)"
                + " SELECT k.id, k.kind, k.value FROM keys k JOIN (SELECT kind, value FROM keys GROUP BY kind, value HAVING count(*) > 1) d"
                + " ON d.kind = k.kind AND d.value = k.value ORDER BY k.kind, k.value, k.id")
        .param("ws", s.workspaceId())
        .query((rs, i) -> new Key(rs.getObject(1, UUID.class), rs.getString(2), rs.getString(3)))
        .list();
  }
}
