import si.contacts.store.DuplicateStore;
import si.contacts.store.DuplicateStore.Key;
import si.contacts.user.User;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceAccess;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/** US-010: Duplicate sets are active Contacts sharing a match key, grouped transitively. */
@RestController
public class DuplicateController {
  private final WorkspaceAccess access;
  private final DuplicateStore duplicates;
  private final ContactStore contacts;

  public DuplicateController(WorkspaceAccess access, DuplicateStore duplicates, ContactStore contacts) {
    this.access = access;
    this.duplicates = duplicates;
    this.contacts = contacts;
  }

  @GetMapping("/api/workspaces/{wid}/duplicate-sets")
  List<Map<String, Object>> sets(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user);
    List<Key> keys = duplicates.sharedKeys(s);
    Map<String, List<UUID>> byValue = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (Key k : keys) byValue.computeIfAbsent(k.kind() + "\u0000" + k.value(), x -> new ArrayList<>()).add(k.contactId());

    Map<UUID, UUID> parent = new HashMap<>();
    for (List<UUID> group : byValue.values()) for (UUID id : group) union(parent, group.get(0), id);

    Map<UUID, List<UUID>> members = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (UUID id : parent.keySet()) members.computeIfAbsent(find(parent, id), x -> new ArrayList<>()).add(id);

    List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();
    for (List<UUID> ids : members.values()) {
      List<Contact> loaded = new ArrayList<>(contacts.load(s, ids));
      loaded.sort(ORDER);
      UUID root = find(parent, ids.get(0));
      List<Map<String, Object>> matches = new ArrayList<>();
      byValue.forEach(
          (kv, group) -> {
            if (!find(parent, group.get(0)).equals(root)) return;
            String[] parts = kv.split("\u0000", 2);
            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            m.put("contactIds", group);
            m.put("kind", parts[0]);
            m.put("value", parts[1]);
            matches.add(m);
          });
      Map<String, Object> set = new LinkedHashMap<>();
      set.put("contacts", loaded.stream().map(Contact::toJson).toList());
      set.put("matches", matches);
      out.add(set);
    }
    out.sort(Comparator.comparing(m -> sortKey(m)));
    return out;
  }

  static final Comparator<Contact> ORDER =
      Comparator.comparing((Contact c) -> Objects.toString(Normalize.text(c.state().field("lastName")), "￿"))
          .thenComparing(c -> Objects.toString(Normalize.text(c.state().field("firstName")), "￿"))
          .thenComparing(c -> c.id().toString());

  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
  static String sortKey(Map<String, Object> set) {
    Map<String, Object> first = ((List<Map<String, Object>>) set.get("contacts")).get(0);
    return Objects.toString(Normalize.text((String) first.get("lastName")), "￿")
        + "\u0000" + Objects.toString(Normalize.text((String) first.get("firstName")), "￿")
        + "\u0000" + first.get("id");
  }

  private static UUID find(Map<UUID, UUID> parent, UUID x) {
    parent.putIfAbsent(x, x);
    UUID p = parent.get(x);
    if (p.equals(x)) return x;
    UUID root = find(parent, p);
    parent.put(x, root);
    return root;
  }

  private static void union(Map<UUID, UUID> parent, UUID a, UUID b) {
    UUID ra = find(parent, a);
    UUID rb = find(parent, b);
    if (!ra.equals(rb)) parent.put(rb, ra);
  }
}

package si.contacts.merge;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import si.contacts.contact.Attribute;
import si.contacts.contact.Contact;
import si.contacts.contact.ContactService;
import si.contacts.contact.ContactState;
import si.contacts.contact.Fields;
import si.contacts.store.ContactStore;
import si.contacts.user.User;
import si.contacts.web.ApiException;
import si.contacts.workspace.Role;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceAccess;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/**
 * US-011: merges 2–10 active Contacts into the Survivor. All affected Contacts change in one
 * transaction, each with one Revision, or nothing changes.
 */
@RestController
public class MergeController {
  static final int MIN = 2;
  static final int MAX = 10;
  private final WorkspaceAccess access;
  private final ContactStore contacts;
  private final ContactService service;

  public MergeController(WorkspaceAccess access, ContactStore contacts, ContactService service) {
    this.access = access;
    this.contacts = contacts;
    this.service = service;
  }

  record Ref(UUID id, int version) {}

  @PostMapping("/api/workspaces/{wid}/merge")
  @Transactional
  Map<String, Object> merge(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user).require(Role.EDITOR);
    UUID survivorId = uuid(body.get("survivorId"), "survivorId");
    List<Ref> refs = refs(body.get("contacts"));
    Set<UUID> listed = new HashSet<>();
    for (Ref r : refs) if (!listed.add(r.id())) throw ApiException.badRequest("contacts", "repeated contact");
    if (!listed.contains(survivorId)) throw ApiException.badRequest("survivorId", "survivor must be listed");
    Map<String, UUID> fieldSources = sources(body.get("fieldSources"), "fieldSources", listed);
    for (String f : fieldSources.keySet())
      if (!Fields.PREDEFINED.contains(f)) throw ApiException.badRequest("fieldSources." + f, "unknown field");
    Map<String, UUID> attributeSources = sources(body.get("attributeSources"), "attributeSources", listed);

    // Lock in a fixed order to avoid deadlocks between concurrent merges.
    Map<UUID, Contact> byId = new HashMap<>();
    listed.stream().sorted().forEach(id -> {
      Contact c = contacts.findForUpdate(s, id).orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.badRequest("contacts", "invalid selection"));
      byId.put(id, c);
    });
    for (Ref r : refs) if (byId.get(r.id()).state().deleted()) throw ApiException.badRequest("contacts", "contact is deleted");
    for (Ref r : refs) if (byId.get(r.id()).version() != r.version()) throw ApiException.outdatedVersion();

    List<Contact> ordered = refs.stream().map(r -> byId.get(r.id())).toList();
    Contact survivor = byId.get(survivorId);
    ContactState merged = combine(survivor, ordered, fieldSources, attributeSources, byId);

    Contact result = service.write(s, survivor, survivor.version(), merged, "MERGE");
    for (Contact c : ordered) {
      if (c.id().equals(survivorId)) continue;
      service.write(s, c, c.version(), c.state().withDeleted(true, survivorId), "MERGED_AWAY");
    }
    return result.toJson();
  }

  static ContactState combine(
      Contact survivor,
      List<Contact> ordered,
      Map<String, UUID> fieldSources,
      Map<String, UUID> attributeSources,
      Map<UUID, Contact> byId) {
    Map<String, String> fields = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (String f : Fields.PREDEFINED) {
      UUID source = fieldSources.get(f);
      String value;
      if (source != null) value = byId.get(source).state().field(f);
      else {
        value = survivor.state().field(f);
        if (value == null)
          value = ordered.stream().map(c -> c.state().field(f)).filter(v -> v != null).findFirst().orElse(null);
      }
      fields.put(f, value);
    }
    if (fields.get("firstName") == null && fields.get("lastName") == null && fields.get("email") == null)
      throw ApiException.badRequest("fieldSources", "first name, last name or email is required");

    // Attributes: Survivor's first, then new keys in list order; the Survivor's value wins unless chosen.
    Map<String, Attribute> attrs = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    List<Contact> survivorFirst = new ArrayList<>();
    survivorFirst.add(survivor);
    ordered.stream().filter(c -> !c.id().equals(survivor.id())).forEach(survivorFirst::add);
    for (Contact c : survivorFirst)
      for (Attribute a : c.state().attributes()) attrs.putIfAbsent(a.key().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), a);
    for (Map.Entry<String, UUID> e : attributeSources.entrySet()) {
      String lower = e.getKey().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
      Attribute existing = attrs.get(lower);
      Attribute fromSource =
          byId.get(e.getValue()).state().attributes().stream()
              .filter(a -> a.key().equalsIgnoreCase(e.getKey()))
              .findFirst()
              .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.badRequest("attributeSources." + e.getKey(), "source has no such attribute"));
      attrs.put(lower, new Attribute(existing.key(), fromSource.value()));
    }
    if (attrs.size() > 100) throw ApiException.badRequest("attributes", "too many attributes");

    Map<String, String> tags = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (Contact c : survivorFirst) for (String t : c.state().tags()) tags.putIfAbsent(t.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), t);
    if (tags.size() > 50) throw ApiException.badRequest("tags", "too many tags");

    return new ContactState(fields, new ArrayList<>(attrs.values()), new ArrayList<>(tags.values()), false, null);
  }

  static List<Ref> refs(Object raw) {
    if (!(raw instanceof List<?> list)) throw ApiException.badRequest("contacts", "required");
    if (list.size() < MIN || list.size() > MAX) throw ApiException.badRequest("contacts", "between " + MIN + " and " + MAX + " contacts");
    List<Ref> out = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
      if (!(list.get(i) instanceof Map<?, ?> m)) throw ApiException.badRequest("contacts[" + i + "]", "must be an object");
      UUID id = uuid(m.get("id"), "contacts[" + i + "].id");
      if (!(m.get("version") instanceof Integer v)) throw ApiException.badRequest("contacts[" + i + "].version", "required");
      out.add(new Ref(id, v));
    }
    return out;
  }

  static Map<String, UUID> sources(Object raw, String field, Set<UUID> listed) {
    Map<String, UUID> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    if (raw == null) return out;
    if (!(raw instanceof Map<?, ?> m)) throw ApiException.badRequest(field, "must be an object");
    for (Map.Entry<?, ?> e : m.entrySet()) {
      String key = String.valueOf(e.getKey());
      UUID id = uuid(e.getValue(), field + "." + key);
      if (!listed.contains(id)) throw ApiException.badRequest(field + "." + key, "source must be listed");
      out.put(key, id);
    }
    return out;
  }

  static UUID uuid(Object raw, String field) {
    if (raw instanceof String s) {
      try {
        return UUID.fromString(s);
      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
        // fall through
      }
    }
    throw ApiException.badRequest(field, "required");
  }
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { PREDEFINED_FIELDS, type Contact, type PredefinedField } from '../lib/api';
import { useApi } from '../lib/context';
import { errorText } from '../lib/messages';
import { FIELD_LABEL } from '../lib/contactForm';
import { contactName } from '../pages/ContactPage';
import { Alert } from './Alert';

interface Props {
  wid: string;
  contacts: Contact[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onMerged: (survivorName: string) => void;
}

/** The value the API keeps by default: the Survivor's, or the first non-empty one in list order. */
function defaultSource(f: PredefinedField, survivor: Contact, contacts: Contact[]): string | undefined {
  if (survivor[f]) return survivor.id;
  return contacts.find((c) => c[f])?.id;
}

export function MergeDialog({ wid, contacts, onClose, onMerged }: Props) {
  const api = useApi();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(contacts.slice(0, 10).map((c) => c.id)));
  const [survivorId, setSurvivorId] = useState(contacts[0].id);
  const [fieldChoice, setFieldChoice] = useState<Partial<Record<PredefinedField, string>>>({});
  const [attrChoice, setAttrChoice] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const d = ref.current;
    if (d && !d.open) {
      if (typeof d.showModal === 'function') d.showModal();
      else d.setAttribute('open', '');
    }
  }, []);

  const chosen = contacts.filter((c) => selected.has(c.id));
  const survivor = chosen.find((c) => c.id === survivorId) ?? chosen[0];

  const differing = useMemo(
    () => PREDEFINED_FIELDS.filter((f) => new Set(chosen.map((c) => c[f] ?? '')).size > 1),
    [chosen],
  );
  const conflictingAttrs = useMemo(() => {
    const values = new Map<string, Map<string, string>>();
    chosen.forEach((c) =>
      c.attributes.forEach((a) => {
        const k = a.key.toLowerCase();
        if (!values.has(k)) values.set(k, new Map());
        values.get(k)!.set(c.id, a.value);
      }),
    );
    return [...values.entries()].filter(([, m]) => new Set(m.values()).size > 1);
  }, [chosen]);

  function toggle(id: string) {
    setSelected((old) => {
      const next = new Set(old);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  }

  async function submit() {
    setError(null);
    if (chosen.length < 2 || chosen.length > 10) return setError('Izberite od 2 do 10 kontaktov.');
    if (!survivor) return;
    const fieldSources: Partial<Record<PredefinedField, string>> = {};
    differing.forEach((f) => {
      const id = fieldChoice[f];
      if (id && selected.has(id)) fieldSources[f] = id;
    });
    const attributeSources: Record<string, string> = {};
    conflictingAttrs.forEach(([k, m]) => {
      const id = attrChoice[k];
      if (id && m.has(id)) attributeSources[k] = id;
    });
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.merge(wid, {
        survivorId: survivor.id,
        contacts: chosen.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, version: c.version })),
        fieldSources,
        attributeSources,
      });
      ref.current?.close();
      onMerged(contactName(survivor));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <dialog ref={ref} aria-labelledby="merge-title" onClose={onClose}>
      <h2 id="merge-title">Združi kontakte</h2>
      {error && <Alert>{error}</Alert>}
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Kontakti za združitev</legend>
        {contacts.map((c) => (
          <div key={c.id}>
            <input id={`m-sel-${c.id}`} type="checkbox" checked={selected.has(c.id)} onChange={() => toggle(c.id)} />{' '}
            <label htmlFor={`m-sel-${c.id}`}>Združi {contactName(c)}</label>
          </div>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Ohranjeni kontakt</legend>
        {chosen.map((c) => (
          <div key={c.id}>
            <input id={`m-surv-${c.id}`} type="radio" name="survivor" checked={survivor?.id === c.id} onChange={() => setSurvivorId(c.id)} />{' '}
            <label htmlFor={`m-surv-${c.id}`}>
              Ohrani {contactName(c)}
              {c.email ? ` (${c.email})` : ''}
            </label>
          </div>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      {survivor &&
        differing.map((f) => {
          const current = fieldChoice[f] ?? defaultSource(f, survivor, chosen);
          return (
            <fieldset key={f}>
              <legend>{FIELD_LABEL[f]}</legend>
              {chosen.map((c) => (
                <div key={c.id}>
                  <input
                    id={`m-${f}-${c.id}`}
                    type="radio"
                    name={`field-${f}`}
                    checked={current === c.id}
                    onChange={() => setFieldChoice((old) => ({ ...old, [f]: c.id }))}
                  />{' '}
                  <label htmlFor={`m-${f}-${c.id}`}>
                    {FIELD_LABEL[f]}: {c[f] ?? '(prazno)'}
                  </label>
                </div>
              ))}
            </fieldset>
          );
        })}
      {survivor &&
        conflictingAttrs.map(([k, m]) => {
          const current = attrChoice[k] ?? (m.has(survivor.id) ? survivor.id : [...m.keys()][0]);
          return (
            <fieldset key={k}>
              <legend>Atribut {k}</legend>
              {[...m.entries()].map(([id, value]) => (
                <div key={id}>
                  <input id={`m-a-${k}-${id}`} type="radio" name={`attr-${k}`} checked={current === id} onChange={() => setAttrChoice((old) => ({ ...old, [k]: id }))} />{' '}
                  <label htmlFor={`m-a-${k}-${id}`}>
                    {k}: {value}
                  </label>
                </div>
              ))}
            </fieldset>
          );
        })}
      <p>Oznake in atributi vseh kontaktov se združijo. Ostali kontakti postanejo izbrisani in kažejo na ohranjenega.</p>
      <div className="actions">
        <button type="button" className="primary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void submit()}>
          Potrdi združitev
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            ref.current?.close();
            onClose();
          }}
        >
          Prekliči
        </button>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  );
}

import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.CellType;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Row;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Sheet;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Workbook;
import org.apache.poi.xssf.usermodel.XSSFWorkbook;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import si.contacts.support.Api;
import si.contacts.support.ApiTestBase;

/** US-012: Excel Export. */
class ExportApiTest extends ApiTestBase {
  static final List<String> FIXED =
      List.of("Ime", "Priimek", "E-pošta", "Telefon", "Podjetje", "Delovno mesto", "Ulica", "Poštna številka", "Kraj", "Država", "Opomba", "Oznake");
  TestUser owner;
  String w;
  String export;

  @BeforeEach
  void workspace() {
    owner = user("Owner");
    w = createWorkspace(owner, "Izvoz Škofja Loka");
    export = "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/export";
  }

  String add(Object... kv) {
    return createContact(owner, w, contact(kv)).get("id").asText();
  }

  static List<List<String>> rows(Api.Res r) throws Exception {
    assertThat(r.status()).as(r.toString()).isEqualTo(200);
    try (Workbook wb = new XSSFWorkbook(new ByteArrayInputStream(r.bytes()))) {
      Sheet sheet = wb.getSheetAt(0);
      List<List<String>> out = new ArrayList<>();
      int width = sheet.getRow(0).getLastCellNum();
      for (Row row : sheet) {
        List<String> cells = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < width; i++) {
          Cell c = row.getCell(i);
          if (c != null) assertThat(c.getCellType()).isIn(CellType.STRING, CellType.BLANK);
          cells.add(c == null ? "" : c.getStringCellValue());
        }
        out.add(cells);
      }
      return out;
    }
  }

  @Test
  void AC_012_01_aSelectionExportContainsExactlyThoseContactsInListOrder() throws Exception {
    String c = add("firstName", "Cene", "lastName", "Cerar");
    String a = add("firstName", "Ana", "lastName", "Avsec");
    add("firstName", "Bor", "lastName", "Bizjak");
    List<List<String>> rows = rows(api.post(owner.token(), export, Map.of("contactIds", List.of(c, a))));
    assertThat(rows).hasSize(3);
    assertThat(rows.get(1).subList(0, 2)).containsExactly("Ana", "Avsec");
    assertThat(rows.get(2).subList(0, 2)).containsExactly("Cene", "Cerar");
  }

  @Test
  void AC_012_02_aFilterExportContainsEveryMatchingContactInTheFiltersOrder() throws Exception {
    add("firstName", "Ana", "tags", List.of("vip"), "company", "Alfa");
    add("firstName", "Bor", "tags", List.of("vip"), "company", "Cveta");
    add("firstName", "Cene", "company", "Beta");
    String gone = add("firstName", "Dan", "tags", List.of("vip"));
    api.delete(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts/" + gone);
    List<List<String>> rows = rows(api.post(owner.token(), export, Map.of("filter", Map.of("tag", List.of("VIP"), "sort", "company", "dir", "desc"))));
    assertThat(rows.stream().skip(1).map(r -> r.get(0))).containsExactly("Bor", "Ana");
    List<List<String>> all = rows(api.post(owner.token(), export, Map.of("filter", Map.of())));
    assertThat(all).hasSize(4);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_012_03_fixedColumnsInContractOrderThenAttributeColumnsLowerCaseSortedAndTagsJoined() throws Exception {
    add("firstName", "Ana", "lastName", "Kos", "email", "ana@example.si", "phone", "041 1", "company", "Krka", "jobTitle", "Vodja",
        "street", "Cesta 1", "postalCode", "8000", "city", "Novo mesto", "country", "SI", "note", "Opomba",
        "tags", List.of("vip", "udelezenec2025"), "attributes", List.of(Map.of("key", "Zeta", "value", "z"), Map.of("key", "alfa", "value", "a")));
    add("firstName", "Bor", "attributes", List.of(Map.of("key", "ZETA", "value", "z2"), Map.of("key", "mid", "value", "m")));
    List<List<String>> rows = rows(api.post(owner.token(), export, Map.of("filter", Map.of())));
    List<String> header = new ArrayList<>(FIXED);
    header.addAll(List.of("alfa", "mid", "zeta"));
    assertThat(rows.get(0)).containsExactlyElementsOf(header);
    assertThat(rows.get(1)).containsExactly("Ana", "Kos", "ana@example.si", "041 1", "Krka", "Vodja", "Cesta 1", "8000", "Novo mesto", "SI", "Opomba",
        "vip, udelezenec2025", "a", "", "z");
    assertThat(rows.get(2).subList(12, 15)).containsExactly("", "m", "z2");
  }

  @Test
  void AC_012_04_slovenianCharactersAndFormulaLikeValuesAreExportedUnchangedAsText() throws Exception {
    add("firstName", "=SUM(A1:A2)", "lastName", "Čuček", "company", "+cmd|' /C calc'!A0", "city", "-2+3", "note", "@SUM(1)",
        "jobTitle", "čšž ČŠŽ ćđ");
    List<List<String>> rows = rows(api.post(owner.token(), export, Map.of("filter", Map.of())));
    List<String> r = rows.get(1);
    assertThat(r.get(0)).isEqualTo("=SUM(A1:A2)");
    assertThat(r.get(1)).isEqualTo("Čuček");
    assertThat(r.get(4)).isEqualTo("+cmd|' /C calc'!A0");
    assertThat(r.get(5)).isEqualTo("čšž ČŠŽ ćđ");
    assertThat(r.get(8)).isEqualTo("-2+3");
    assertThat(r.get(10)).isEqualTo("@SUM(1)");
  }

  @Test
  void theFileIsNamedAfterTheWorkspaceAndTheDate() {
    add("firstName", "A");
    Api.Res r = api.post(owner.token(), export, Map.of("filter", Map.of()));
    assertThat(r.header("Content-Type")).startsWith("application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet");
    String date = LocalDate.now(java.time.ZoneId.of("Europe/Ljubljana")).toString();
    assertThat(r.header("Content-Disposition"))
        .contains("filename=\"Izvoz-Skofja-Loka-" + date + ".xlsx\"")
        .contains("filename*=UTF-8''Izvoz-%C5%A0kofja-Loka-" + date + ".xlsx");
  }

  @Test
  void AC_012_05_invalidExportRequestsAreRejected() {
    String a = add("firstName", "A");
    String gone = add("firstName", "B");
    api.delete(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts/" + gone);
    String other = createWorkspace(owner, "Drugi");
    String foreign = createContact(owner, other, contact("firstName", "F")).get("id").asText();
    List<Object> bad = List.of(
        Map.of(),
        Map.of("contactIds", List.of(a), "filter", Map.of()),
        Map.of("contactIds", List.of()),
        Map.of("contactIds", List.of(gone)),
        Map.of("contactIds", List.of(a, foreign)),
        Map.of("contactIds", List.of("not-a-uuid")),
        Map.of("filter", Map.of("sort", "nonsense")));
    for (Object body : bad) assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), export, body).status()).as(body.toString()).isEqualTo(400);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_012_07_viewersCanExport() throws Exception {
    TestUser viewer = user("Viewer");
    addMember(owner, w, viewer, "VIEWER");
    String a = add("firstName", "A");
    assertThat(rows(api.post(viewer.token(), export, Map.of("contactIds", List.of(a))))).hasSize(2);
  }
}

package si.contacts.export;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.CellStyle;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Row;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Sheet;
import org.apache.poi.xssf.streaming.SXSSFWorkbook;
import si.contacts.contact.Attribute;
import si.contacts.contact.Contact;
import si.contacts.contact.Fields;

/** Writes Contacts as an .xlsx workbook: fixed columns, then one per Attribute key; every cell text. */
public final class Workbooks {
  public static final List<String> HEADERS =
      List.of("Ime", "Priimek", "E-pošta", "Telefon", "Podjetje", "Delovno mesto", "Ulica", "Poštna številka", "Kraj", "Država", "Opomba", "Oznake");

  private Workbooks() {}

  public static byte[] write(List<Contact> contacts) {
    TreeMap<String, Integer> attrColumns = new TreeMap<>();
    for (Contact c : contacts)
      for (Attribute a : c.state().attributes()) attrColumns.putIfAbsent(a.key().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), 0);
    int i = HEADERS.size();
    for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : attrColumns.entrySet()) e.setValue(i++);

    try (SXSSFWorkbook wb = new SXSSFWorkbook(200)) {
      CellStyle text = wb.createCellStyle();
      text.setDataFormat(wb.createDataFormat().getFormat("@"));
      Sheet sheet = wb.createSheet("Kontakti");
      List<String> header = new ArrayList<>(HEADERS);
      header.addAll(attrColumns.keySet());
      Row h = sheet.createRow(0);
      for (int col = 0; col < header.size(); col++) cell(h, col, header.get(col), text);
      int r = 1;
      for (Contact c : contacts) {
        Row row = sheet.createRow(r++);
        int col = 0;
        for (String f : Fields.PREDEFINED) cell(row, col++, c.state().field(f), text);
        cell(row, col, String.join(", ", c.state().tags()), text);
        for (Attribute a : c.state().attributes()) cell(row, attrColumns.get(a.key().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)), a.value(), text);
      }
      ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
      wb.write(out);
      return out.toByteArray();
    } catch (IOException e) {
      throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
    }
  }

  /** Always a string cell: a value starting with = + - @ is never interpreted as a formula. */
  private static void cell(Row row, int col, String value, CellStyle style) {
    var cell = row.createCell(col);
    cell.setCellStyle(style);
    cell.setCellValue(value == null ? "" : value);
  }
}

package si.contacts.export;

import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import si.contacts.contact.Contact;
import si.contacts.contact.ContactQuery;
import si.contacts.contact.Normalize;
import si.contacts.store.ContactSearchStore;
import si.contacts.store.ContactStore;
import si.contacts.store.WorkspaceStore;
import si.contacts.user.User;
import si.contacts.web.ApiException;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceAccess;
import si.contacts.workspace.WorkspaceScope;

/** US-012: Export of the selected Contacts or of all Contacts matching a filter; Viewers may export. */
@RestController
public class ExportController {
  static final MediaType XLSX = MediaType.parseMediaType("application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet");
  static final ZoneId ZONE = ZoneId.of("Europe/Ljubljana");
  private final WorkspaceAccess access;
  private final ContactStore contacts;
  private final ContactSearchStore search;
  private final WorkspaceStore workspaces;
  private final int max;

  public ExportController(
      WorkspaceAccess access,
      ContactStore contacts,
      ContactSearchStore search,
      WorkspaceStore workspaces,
      @Value("${app.export.max-contacts:10000}") int max) {
    this.access = access;
    this.contacts = contacts;
    this.search = search;
    this.workspaces = workspaces;
    this.max = max;
  }

  @PostMapping("/api/workspaces/{wid}/export")
  @Transactional(readOnly = true)
  ResponseEntity<byte[]> export(User user, @PathVariable UUID wid, @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
    WorkspaceScope s = access.open(wid, user);
    boolean hasIds = body.containsKey("contactIds");
    boolean hasFilter = body.containsKey("filter");
    if (hasIds == hasFilter) throw ApiException.badRequest(null, "exactly one of contactIds and filter");
    List<Contact> selected = hasIds ? selection(s, body.get("contactIds")) : filtered(s, body.get("filter"));
    byte[] file = Workbooks.write(selected);
    String name = workspaces.name(s);
    String date = LocalDate.now(ZONE).toString();
    String utf8 = safe(name, false) + "-" + date + ".xlsx";
    String ascii = safe(name, true) + "-" + date + ".xlsx";
    return ResponseEntity.ok()
        .contentType(XLSX)
        .header(
            HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
            "attachment; filename=\"" + ascii + "\"; filename*=UTF-8''" + URLEncoder.encode(utf8, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20"))
        .body(file);
  }

  private List<Contact> selection(WorkspaceScope s, Object raw) {
    if (!(raw instanceof List<?> list) || list.isEmpty()) throw ApiException.badRequest("contactIds", "invalid selection");
    if (list.size() > max) throw ApiException.badRequest("contactIds", "too many contacts");
    Set<UUID> ids = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    for (Object o : list) {
      try {
        ids.add(UUID.fromString(String.valueOf(o)));
      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
        throw ApiException.badRequest("contactIds", "invalid selection");
      }
    }
    List<Contact> found = new ArrayList<>(contacts.load(s, new ArrayList<>(ids)));
    if (found.size() != ids.size() || found.stream().anyMatch(c -> c.state().deleted()))
      throw ApiException.badRequest("contactIds", "invalid selection");
    found.sort(DEFAULT_ORDER);
    return found;
  }

  private List<Contact> filtered(WorkspaceScope s, Object raw) {
    if (!(raw instanceof Map<?, ?> m)) throw ApiException.badRequest("filter", "must be an object");
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    ContactQuery q = ContactQuery.fromFilter((Map<String, Object>) m);
    List<UUID> ids = search.ids(s, q, 0, max + 1);
    if (ids.size() > max) throw ApiException.badRequest("filter", "too many contacts");
    return contacts.load(s, ids);
  }

  static final Comparator<Contact> DEFAULT_ORDER =
      Comparator.comparing((Contact c) -> Objects.toString(Normalize.text(c.state().field("lastName")), "￿"))
          .thenComparing(c -> Objects.toString(Normalize.text(c.state().field("firstName")), "￿"))
          .thenComparing(c -> c.id().toString());

  /** Letters, digits, - and _ only (ASCII when asked); spaces become -. */
  static String safe(String name, boolean ascii) {
    String n = ascii ? java.text.Normalizer.normalize(name.replace('đ', 'd').replace('Đ', 'D'), java.text.Normalizer.Form.NFD).replaceAll("\\p{M}+", "") : name;
    n = n.strip().replaceAll("\\s+", "-");
    n = ascii ? n.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "") : n.replaceAll("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}_-]", "");
    return n.isEmpty() ? "kontakti" : n;
  }
}

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { createContact, createWorkspace, goTo, signUp, uniqueEmail, workbookText } from './support';

// E2E-07: with nothing selected, Export takes every Contact matching the current search and filters.
test('E2E-07 Export of a filtered list', async ({ page }) => {
  await signUp(page, 'Filip Filter', uniqueEmail('filip'));
  await createWorkspace(page, 'Filtri');
  const people: [string, string, string][] = [
    ['Saša', 'Kranjc', 'udelezenec2025'],
    ['Tina', 'Bela', 'udelezenec2025'],
    ['Urban', 'Zelen', 'drugo'],
  ];
  for (const [first, last, tag] of people) {
    await createContact(page, { firstName: first, lastName: last, tags: tag, company: '=1+1' });
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: `${first} ${last}` })).toBeVisible();
    await goTo(page, 'Kontakti');
  }
  await page.getByLabel('Oznake', { exact: true }).fill('udelezenec2025');
  await expect(page.getByText('Najdenih: 2')).toBeVisible();
  expect(page.url()).toContain('tag=udelezenec2025');

  const downloadPromise = page.waitForEvent('download');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Izvozi vse najdene (2)' }).click();
  const text = await workbookText(await (await downloadPromise).path());
  expect(text).toContain('Kranjc');
  expect(text).toContain('Bela');
  expect(text).not.toContain('Zelen');
  expect(text).toContain('=1+1');
  expect(text).not.toContain('<f>');

  await page.getByLabel('Iskanje').fill('sasa');
  await expect(page.getByText('Najdenih: 1')).toBeVisible();
  const second = page.waitForEvent('download');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Izvozi vse najdene (1)' }).click();
  const text2 = await workbookText(await (await second).path());
  expect(text2).toContain('Kranjc');
  expect(text2).not.toContain('Bela');
});
EOF

package si.contacts.acceptance;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import si.contacts.support.Api;
import si.contacts.support.ApiTestBase;

/** US-013 and US-002: permanent erasure of a Deleted contact and Workspace deletion. */
class ErasureApiTest extends ApiTestBase {

  @Test
  void AC_013_01_purgingADeletedContactRemovesItAndItsRevisions() {
    TestUser owner = user("Owner");
    String w = createWorkspace(owner, "Izbris");
    String contacts = "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts";
    String id = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "Pozabi", "lastName", "Me", "tags", List.of("gdpr"))).get("id").asText();
    api.put(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id, contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Pozabi", "lastName", "Me", "tags", List.of("gdpr")));
    api.delete(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id);
    assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/purge", null).status()).isEqualTo(204);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id).status()).isEqualTo(404);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/revisions").status()).isEqualTo(404);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), contacts + "?deleted=true").json().get("total").asInt()).isZero();
    assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/restore", null).status()).isEqualTo(404);
    assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), contacts + "/" + id + "/purge", null).status()).isEqualTo(404);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/tags").json().get(0).get("count").asInt()).isZero();
  }

  @Test
  void AC_013_02_purgingAnActiveContactIsRejected() {
    TestUser owner = user("Owner");
    String w = createWorkspace(owner, "Aktivni");
    String id = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "Ostani")).get("id").asText();
    assertThat(api.post(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts/" + id + "/purge", null).status()).isEqualTo(409);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts/" + id).status()).isEqualTo(200);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_013_03_editorsAndViewersCannotPurge() {
    TestUser owner = user("Owner");
    TestUser editor = user("Editor");
    TestUser viewer = user("Viewer");
    String w = createWorkspace(owner, "Pravice");
    addMember(owner, w, editor, "EDITOR");
    addMember(owner, w, viewer, "VIEWER");
    String id = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "X")).get("id").asText();
    api.delete(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts/" + id);
    for (TestUser u : List.of(editor, viewer))
      assertThat(api.post(u.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts/" + id + "/purge", null).status()).isEqualTo(403);
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts/" + id).status()).isEqualTo(200);
  }

  @Test
  void AC_002_05_deletingAWorkspaceWithTheExactNameRemovesItForEveryFormerMember() {
    TestUser owner = user("Owner");
    TestUser editor = user("Editor");
    String w = createWorkspace(owner, "Konec Projekta");
    addMember(owner, w, editor, "EDITOR");
    api.post(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/members", Map.of("email", "pending@example.si", "role", "VIEWER"));
    String id = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "A", "tags", List.of("t"))).get("id").asText();
    assertThat(api.delete(editor.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w, Map.of("confirmName", "Konec Projekta")).status()).isEqualTo(403);
    assertThat(api.delete(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w, Map.of("confirmName", "Konec Projekta")).status()).isEqualTo(204);
    Api.Res missing = api.get(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + java.util.UUID.randomUUID());
    for (TestUser u : List.of(owner, editor)) {
      Api.Res r = api.get(u.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w);
      assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(404);
      assertThat(r.body()).isEqualTo(missing.body());
      assertThat(api.get(u.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts/" + id).status()).isEqualTo(404);
      assertThat(api.get(u.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts").status()).isEqualTo(404);
      assertThat(api.get(u.token(), "/api/workspaces").json().size()).isZero();
    }
  }

  @Test
  void AC_002_06_aWrongConfirmNameIsRejected() {
    TestUser owner = user("Owner");
    String w = createWorkspace(owner, "Pravo Ime");
    for (Object body : new Object[] {Map.of("confirmName", "pravo ime"), Map.of("confirmName", "Pravo Ime "), Map.of()}) {
      Api.Res r = api.delete(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w, body);
      assertThat(r.status()).isEqualTo(400);
      assertThat(errorFields(r)).containsExactly("confirmName");
    }
    assertThat(api.get(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w).status()).isEqualTo(200);
  }
}

import { screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { contact, fakeApi, renderApp, workspace } from './helpers';

describe('Workspace deletion', () => {
  it('requires the exact name before calling the API, then returns to the list', async () => {
    const deleteWorkspace = vi.fn(async () => {});
    renderApp('/w/w1/nastavitve', fakeApi({ getWorkspace: vi.fn(async () => workspace('OWNER', 'Projekt X')), deleteWorkspace }));
    await userEvent.type(await screen.findByLabelText('Ime za potrditev'), 'projekt x');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trajno izbriši' }));

    await userEvent.clear(screen.getByLabelText('Ime za potrditev'));
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText('Ime za potrditev'), 'Projekt X');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trajno izbriši' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(deleteWorkspace).toHaveBeenCalledWith('w1', 'Projekt X'));
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Delovni prostori' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('is not offered to Editors', async () => {
    renderApp('/w/w1/nastavitve', fakeApi({ getWorkspace: vi.fn(async () => workspace('EDITOR')) }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Za to stran nimate pravic.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Trajno izbriši' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe('Purge of a Deleted contact', () => {

    const purgeContact = vi.fn(async () => {});
    renderApp(
      '/w/w1/kontakti/c1',

    );
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Trajno izbriši' }));
    expect(purgeContact).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Potrdi trajni izbris' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(purgeContact).toHaveBeenCalledWith('w1', 'c1'));

    await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Saša Novak' });
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Trajno izbriši' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();

});

package si.contacts.acceptance;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import si.contacts.support.Api;
import si.contacts.support.ApiTestBase;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;

/** US-004: Workspaces are fully isolated. */
class IsolationApiTest extends ApiTestBase {
  TestUser owner;
  String w;
  String contactId;
  String ownerId;
  String invitationId;

  @BeforeEach
  void privateWorkspace() {
    owner = user("Owner");
    ownerId = api.get(owner.token(), "/api/me").json().get("id").asText();
    w = createWorkspace(owner, "Zasebno");
    contactId = createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "Skrivnost", "email", "skrit@example.si", "tags", List.of("tajno"))).get("id").asText();
    api.delete(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts/" + createContact(owner, w, contact("firstName", "Izbrisan")).get("id").asText());
    invitationId = api.post(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/members", Map.of("email", "inv@example.si", "role", "VIEWER"))
        .json().get("invitation").get("id").asText();
  }

  record Call(String method, String path, Object body) {}

  List<Call> everyEndpoint(String ws, String cid) {
    String c = "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/contacts/" + cid;
    Map<String, Object> contactBody = contact("version", 1, "firstName", "Napad");
    return List.of(
        new Call("GET", "/api/workspaces/" + ws, null),
        new Call("PATCH", "/api/workspaces/" + ws, Map.of("name", "Prevzeto")),
        new Call("DELETE", "/api/workspaces/" + ws, Map.of("confirmName", "Zasebno")),
        new Call("GET", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/members", null),
        new Call("POST", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/members", Map.of("email", "napadalec@example.si", "role", "OWNER")),
        new Call("PATCH", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/members/" + ownerId, Map.of("role", "VIEWER")),
        new Call("DELETE", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/members/" + ownerId, null),
        new Call("DELETE", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/invitations/" + invitationId, null),
        new Call("GET", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/contacts", null),
        new Call("GET", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/contacts?deleted=true", null),
        new Call("POST", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/contacts", contactBody),
        new Call("GET", c, null),
        new Call("PUT", c, contactBody),
        new Call("DELETE", c, null),
        new Call("POST", c + "/restore", null),
        new Call("POST", c + "/purge", null),
        new Call("GET", c + "/revisions", null),
        new Call("POST", c + "/revisions/1/restore", Map.of("version", 1)),
        new Call("GET", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/tags", null),
        new Call("PATCH", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/tags/tajno", Map.of("name", "javno")),
        new Call("DELETE", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/tags/tajno", null),
        new Call("GET", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/duplicate-sets", null),
        new Call("POST", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/merge",
            Map.of("survivorId", cid, "contacts", List.of(Map.of("id", cid, "version", 1), Map.of("id", UUID.randomUUID().toString(), "version", 1)))),
        new Call("POST", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/export", Map.of("filter", Map.of())),
        new Call("POST", "/api/workspaces/" + ws + "/export", Map.of("contactIds", List.of(cid))));
  }

  @Test
  void AC_004_01_everyWorkspaceEndpointAnswersANonMemberWith404LikeAMissingWorkspace() {
    TestUser stranger = user("Tujec");
    String missingBody = api.get(stranger.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + UUID.randomUUID()).body();
    for (Call call : everyEndpoint(w, contactId)) {
      Api.Res r = api.send(stranger.token(), call.method(), call.path(), call.body());
      assertThat(r.status()).as(call.toString()).isEqualTo(404);
      assertThat(r.body()).as(call.toString()).isEqualTo(missingBody);
    }
    for (Call call : everyEndpoint(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), UUID.randomUUID().toString())) {
      Api.Res r = api.send(stranger.token(), call.method(), call.path(), call.body());
      assertThat(r.status()).as(call.toString()).isEqualTo(404);
      assertThat(r.body()).as(call.toString()).isEqualTo(missingBody);
    }
    assertUntouched();
  }

  void assertUntouched() {
    JsonNode ws = api.get(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w).json();
    assertThat(ws.get("name").asText()).isEqualTo("Zasebno");
    JsonNode c = api.get(owner.token(), "/api/workspaces/" + w + "/contacts/" + contactId).json();
    assertThat(c.get("firstName").asText()).isEqualTo("Skrivnost");

/** Presses Tab until the focused element has this accessible name (keyboard-only navigation). */
export async function tabTo(page: Page, name: string, max = 60): Promise<void> {
  for (let i = 0; i < max; i++) {
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
    const focused = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const el = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      if (!el) return '';
      const id = el.getAttribute('id');
      const label = id ? document.querySelector(`label[for="${id}"]`)?.textContent : null;
      return (el.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? label ?? el.textContent ?? '').trim();
    });
    if (focused === name) return;
  }
  throw new Error(`Could not reach "${name}" with the keyboard`);
}
EOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""NFR-07 runtime demonstration (not a test).

Seeds one Workspace with 10,000 Contacts in the running Compose stack, then measures through the
real stack (nginx -> backend -> PostgreSQL):
  * list, search and filter requests: 95th percentile must be <= 500 ms;
  * an Export of all 10,000 Contacts must finish within 10 s.

Usage: docker compose up -d --wait && python3 scripts/nfr07_scale_demo.py
"""
import json
import random
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import unicodedata
import urllib.request
import uuid

BASE = "http://localhost:8080"
EMULATOR = "http://localhost:9099"
API_KEY = "demo-api-key"
COUNT = 10_000
SAMPLES = 50

FIRST = ["Ana", "Bor", "Cvetka", "Saša", "Žiga", "Špela", "Matej", "Nina", "Luka", "Đurđa", "Tina", "Urban", "Maja", "Rok", "Eva"]
LAST = ["Novak", "Horvat", "Kovačič", "Krajnc", "Zupančič", "Potočnik", "Kos", "Vidmar", "Golob", "Turk", "Božič", "Kralj", "Zupan"]
COMPANIES = ["Krka", "Petrol", "Gorenje", "Mercator", "Lek", "Telekom", "Elektro", "Kolektor", "Hidria", "Pošta"]
CITIES = ["Ljubljana", "Maribor", "Celje", "Kranj", "Koper", "Novo mesto", "Velenje", "Ptuj"]
COUNTRIES = ["SI", "SI", "SI", "AT", "HR", "IT"]


def request(method, url, token=None, body=None, raw=False):
    data = None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    if body is not None:
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as res:
        payload = res.read()
        return payload if raw else json.loads(payload or b"null")


def norm(s):
    if s is None:
        return None
    n = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s)
    n = "".join(ch for ch in n if not unicodedata.category(ch).startswith("M"))
    n = n.replace("đ", "d").replace("Đ", "D").lower()
    return " ".join(n.split())


def search_text(first, last, email, phone, company, city):
    parts = [norm(first), norm(last), norm(first + " " + last), norm(email), norm(phone),
             "".join(ch for ch in phone if ch.isdigit() or ch == "+"), norm(company), norm(city)]
    return "".join("\x01" + p for p in parts if p)


def tsv(v):
    if v is None:
        return "\\N"
    return str(v).replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\t", "\\t").replace("\n", "\\n")


def psql(sql_and_data):
    subprocess.run(["docker", "compose", "exec", "-T", "db", "psql", "-q", "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1", "-U", "contacts", "-d", "contacts"],
                   input=sql_and_data.encode(), check=True)


def main():
    email = f"nfr07.{int(time.time())}@example.si"
    signup = request("POST", f"{EMULATOR}/identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:signUp?key={API_KEY}",
                     body={"email": email, "password": "geslo-123456", "returnSecureToken": True})
    token = signup["idToken"]
    me = request("GET", f"{BASE}/api/me", token)
    ws = request("POST", f"{BASE}/api/workspaces", token, {"name": "NFR-07 10000 kontaktov"})
    wid = ws["id"]
    print(f"Workspace {wid}; seeding {COUNT} Contacts ...")

    rnd = random.Random(7)
    tags = {f"oznaka{i}": str(uuid.uuid4()) for i in range(10)}
    contacts, attrs, ctags, revs = [], [], [], []
    for i in range(COUNT):
        cid = str(uuid.uuid4())
        first, last = rnd.choice(FIRST), rnd.choice(LAST) + ("" if i % 7 else f"-{i}")
        email_c = f"{norm(first)}.{norm(last).replace(' ', '')}.{i}@example.si"
        phone = f"+386 41 {i:06d}"
        company, city, country = rnd.choice(COMPANIES), rnd.choice(CITIES), rnd.choice(COUNTRIES)
        contact_tags = rnd.sample(list(tags), 2)
        attributes = [("kompetenca", rnd.choice(["web", "dizajn", "prodaja"])), ("leto", str(2000 + i % 25))]
        contacts.append([cid, wid, 1, "f", first, last, email_c, phone, company, city, country,
                         search_text(first, last, email_c, phone, company, city), email_c.lower(),
                         "+" + "".join(ch for ch in phone if ch.isdigit()), f"{norm(first)} {norm(last)}",
                         norm(last), norm(first), norm(company)])
        for p, (k, v) in enumerate(attributes):
            attrs.append([cid, p, k, k.lower(), v])
        for p, t in enumerate(contact_tags):
            ctags.append([cid, tags[t], p])
        state = {"firstName": first, "lastName": last, "email": email_c, "phone": phone, "company": company,
                 "jobTitle": None, "street": None, "postalCode": None, "city": city, "country": country, "note": None,
                 "attributes": [{"key": k, "value": v} for k, v in attributes], "tags": contact_tags,
                 "deleted": False, "mergedInto": None}
        revs.append([cid, wid, 1, "CREATE", me["id"], json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False)])

    def copy(table, cols, rows):
        return f"COPY {table} ({cols}) FROM STDIN;\n" + "".join("\t".join(tsv(v) for v in r) + "\n" for r in rows) + "\\.\n"

    script = "BEGIN;\n"
    script += copy("tags", "id, workspace_id, name, name_lower", [[tid, wid, name, name] for name, tid in tags.items()])
    script += copy("contacts", "id, workspace_id, version, deleted, first_name, last_name, email, phone, company, city, country,"
                   " search_text, email_norm, phone_norm, name_norm, sort_last, sort_first, sort_company", contacts)
    script += copy("contact_attributes", "contact_id, position, key, key_lower, value", attrs)
    script += copy("contact_tags", "contact_id, tag_id, position", ctags)
    script += copy("revisions", "contact_id, workspace_id, number, type, author_id, state", revs)
    script += "COMMIT;\nANALYZE contacts; ANALYZE contact_tags; ANALYZE contact_attributes;\n"
    psql(script)

    base = f"{BASE}/api/workspaces/{wid}/contacts"
    scenarios = {
        "list (first page)": "?size=20",
        "list (page 200, sort by company)": "?size=20&page=200&sort=company",
        "search 'kovacic'": "?q=kovacic",
        "search 'sasa novak'": "?q=sasa%20novak",
        "filter tags (all) + country + search": "?tag=oznaka1&tag=oznaka2&country=SI&q=ana",
        "filter attribute + company": "?attr=kompetenca%3Dweb&company=Krka",
    }
    ok = True
    total = request("GET", base + "?size=1", token)["total"]
    print(f"Contacts in Workspace: {total}")
    for name, query in scenarios.items():
        times = []
        for _ in range(SAMPLES // 2 if len(scenarios) * SAMPLES > 280 else SAMPLES):
            t = time.perf_counter()
            request("GET", base + query, token)
            times.append((time.perf_counter() - t) * 1000)
        times.sort()
        p95 = times[max(0, int(round(0.95 * len(times))) - 1)]
        verdict = "OK" if p95 <= 500 else "TOO SLOW"
        ok &= p95 <= 500
        print(f"  {name:42s} n={len(times):3d}  median={statistics.median(times):7.1f} ms  p95={p95:7.1f} ms  {verdict}")

    t = time.perf_counter()
    xlsx = request("POST", f"{BASE}/api/workspaces/{wid}/export", token, {"filter": {}}, raw=True)
    seconds = time.perf_counter() - t
    ok &= seconds <= 10
    print(f"  Export of all {total} Contacts: {seconds:.2f} s, {len(xlsx) / 1024:.0f} KiB  {'OK' if seconds <= 10 else 'TOO SLOW'}")
    print("NFR-07 met" if ok else "NFR-07 NOT met")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
EOF

## User

Base directory for this skill: /home/tjan-kazar/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/code-review

Two-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:

- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?
- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?

Both axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.

The issue tracker should have been provided to you. If not, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.

## Process

### 1. Pin the fixed point

Whatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.

Capture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.

Before going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.

### 2. Identify the spec source

Look for the originating spec, in this order:

1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in the tracker doc.
2. A path the user passed as an argument.
3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.
4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report "no spec available".

### 3. Identify the standards sources

Search the repo for every file that documents how code should be written. When `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md` exists, it must be on the list.

On top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:

- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.
- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic ("possible Feature Envy"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.

Each smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:

- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.
- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.
- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.
- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.
- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.
- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.
- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.
- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.
- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.
- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.
- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.
- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.

### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel

Issue both sub-agent calls together, in the foreground, and aggregate the reports they return.

**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:

- The full diff command and commit list.
- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).
- The brief: "Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words."

**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:

- The diff command and commit list.
- The path or fetched contents of the spec.
- The brief: "Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words."

If the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.

### 5. Aggregate

Present the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).

End with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.

## Why two axes

A change can pass one axis and fail the other:

- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**
- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**

Reporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.

# ADR-0001: Workspaces in one shared schema, isolated by one access layer

Status: accepted (supersedes the earlier single-tenant draft, per spec #1)

Each project or company is a Workspace in one deployment. All Workspace-owned rows (Contacts, Attributes, Tags, Revisions, memberships, invitations) live in one shared PostgreSQL schema and carry the Workspace id.

Isolation lives in one Workspace-scoped access layer. `WorkspaceAccess` is the only code that turns a Workspace id and the caller into a `WorkspaceScope`, and it does so only after reading the caller's membership from PostgreSQL. Every store of Workspace-owned data takes a `WorkspaceScope` as its first parameter and filters by its Workspace id. A non-Member gets the same 404 as for a Workspace that does not exist. An ArchUnit rule (`ArchitectureTest`) enforces that only the store package touches JDBC, that every store method takes a `WorkspaceScope`, and that only `WorkspaceAccess` creates one.

Rejected: row-level security and schema per Workspace. They are stronger, but they make migrations, connection handling and tests heavier than this simple product needs.

  private static UUID find(Map<UUID, UUID> parent, UUID x) {
    parent.putIfAbsent(x, x);
    UUID p = parent.get(x);
    if (p.equals(x)) return x;
    UUID root = find(parent, p);
    parent.put(x, root);
    return root;
  }

  private static void union(Map<UUID, UUID> parent, UUID a, UUID b) {
    UUID ra = find(parent, a);
    UUID rb = find(parent, b);
    if (!ra.equals(rb)) parent.put(rb, ra);
  }

## Problem Statement

People who work with many contacts on a project or in a company keep them in spreadsheets, mailboxes or heavyweight CRM systems. Spreadsheets get copied around, nobody knows who changed what, the same person appears three times with slightly different data, and there is no way to give a colleague access to one project's contacts without giving them everything. CRM systems solve this but are too complex for a team that only wants to keep, find, label and hand on contacts.

## Solution

A multi-tenant contact management web application whose advantage over CRM systems is simplicity. A User signs in (Firebase Authentication: email and password, or Google) and creates a **Workspace** for each project or company; only its **Members** see it, each with a **Role** (Owner, Editor, Viewer). A Workspace holds **Contacts** with fixed **Predefined fields**, free key-value **Attributes** and free **Tags** used as categories. Every change writes an immutable **Revision**, so the full history is visible and any earlier state can be **Restored**. The application finds **Duplicate sets**, warns while saving, lets an Editor **Merge** them, and **Exports** the selected or filtered Contacts to Excel. The whole system is reached through one secured REST API; the user interface is Slovenian.

The complete, fixed requirements are the project inputs in the repository: user stories US-001 to US-013, business rules BR-01 to BR-19, 87 acceptance criteria, end-to-end scenarios E2E-01 to E2E-07, the fixed API contract, architecture constraints AR-01 to AR-10, security requirements SR-01 to SR-11 (OWASP ASVS 5.0 Level 2), non-functional requirements NFR-01 to NFR-07, the glossary and ADR-0001. This spec summarises them; where they differ, the inputs win.

# API contract

All endpoints live under `/api`, take and return JSON (except the Export workbook), and need `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>` (except `/api/health*`).

## Ports (Docker Compose)

| Service | Host port | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| frontend (nginx) | 8080 | serves the UI, forwards `/api` to the backend |
| backend | 8081 | Spring Boot; also reachable directly for API tests |
| auth (Firebase Auth Emulator) | 9099 | used by default; project id `demo-contacts` |
| db (PostgreSQL 16) | not published | volume `db-data` |

## Errors

Every error body is a list of field errors:

```json
{ "errors": [ { "field": "email", "message": "must be a valid email" } ] }
```

`field` is `null` for errors that belong to no field. Status codes:

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|

... (92 lines omitted) ...

```json
{
  "survivorId": "uuid",
  "contacts": [ { "id": "uuid", "version": 2 }, { "id": "uuid", "version": 5 } ],
  "fieldSources": { "email": "uuid-of-source" },
  "attributeSources": { "kompetenca": "uuid-of-source" }
}
```

2–10 distinct active Contacts; the Survivor and every source must be among them (400 otherwise). For a field without a chosen source the Survivor's value is kept, or the first non-empty value in list order when the Survivor has none. Attributes are combined by key (ignoring case); the Survivor's value wins unless `attributeSources` names another Contact. Tags are combined. The others become Deleted contacts with `mergedInto` = Survivor and a `MERGED_AWAY` Revision; the Survivor gets a `MERGE` Revision. Any outdated version → 409 and nothing changes. Response 200: the Survivor.

## Export

`POST /api/workspaces/{wid}/export` (Member) with exactly one of:

- `{ "contactIds": ["uuid", ...] }`: those Contacts, in list default order (last name, first name); a Deleted, foreign or unknown id → 400 `contactIds`;
- `{ "filter": { q, tag, tagMode, attr, country, company, sort, dir } }`: every active Contact matching, in the filter's order.

Both or neither → 400. More than 10,000 Contacts → 400. Response 200 `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet`, `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<ascii-name>-<yyyy-MM-dd>.xlsx"; filename*=UTF-8''<name>-<yyyy-MM-dd>.xlsx` (spaces become `-`; the name keeps only letters, digits, `-` and `_`; the plain form drops diacritics; the date is in Europe/Ljubljana).

Columns, in order: `Ime`, `Priimek`, `E-pošta`, `Telefon`, `Podjetje`, `Delovno mesto`, `Ulica`, `Poštna številka`, `Kraj`, `Država`, `Opomba`, `Oznake` (Tags joined by `, `), then one column per Attribute key (lower case, sorted). Every cell is a text cell; values are never formulas.

## Health

`GET /api/health` (liveness) and `GET /api/health/ready` (readiness, checks the database), no token needed.

BEGIN

END;

  static Map<String, UUID> sources(Object raw, String field, Set<UUID> listed) {
    Map<String, UUID> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    if (raw == null) return out;
    if (!(raw instanceof Map<?, ?> m)) throw ApiException.badRequest(field, "must be an object");
    for (Map.Entry<?, ?> e : m.entrySet()) {
      String key = String.valueOf(e.getKey());
      UUID id = uuid(e.getValue(), field + "." + key);
      if (!listed.contains(id)) throw ApiException.badRequest(field + "." + key, "source must be listed");
      out.put(key, id);
    }
    return out;
  }

  static UUID uuid(Object raw, String field) {
    if (raw instanceof String s) {
      try {
        return UUID.fromString(s);
      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
        // fall through
      }
    }
    throw ApiException.badRequest(field, "required");
  }
}

package si.contacts.web;

import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/** A pragmatic email check: one @, a dotted domain, no whitespace, at most 254 characters. */
public final class Emails {
  private static final Pattern EMAIL =
      Pattern.compile("^[^@\\s\"(),:;<>\\[\\\\\\]]+@[^@\\s\"(),:;<>\\[\\\\\\]]+\\.[^@\\s\"(),:;<>\\[\\\\\\].]{2,}$");
  public static final int MAX = 254;

  private Emails() {}

  public static boolean valid(String email) {
    return email != null && email.length() <= MAX && EMAIL.matcher(email).matches() && !email.contains("..");
  }
}

package si.contacts.contact;

import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;

import java.util.UUID;

/** A Contact as stored now; its version is the number of its latest Revision. */
public record Contact(UUID id, int version, ContactState state, OffsetDateTime createdAt, OffsetDateTime updatedAt) {

  public Map<String, Object> toJson() {
    Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    m.put("id", id);
    m.put("version", version);
    m.put("deleted", state.deleted());
    m.put("mergedInto", state.mergedInto());
    m.putAll(state.fields());
    m.put("attributes", state.attributes().stream().map(a -> Map.of("key", a.key(), "value", a.value())).toList());
    m.put("tags", state.tags());
    m.put("createdAt", createdAt);
    m.put("updatedAt", updatedAt);
    return m;
  }
}

## NFR-02: data survives container recreation

`scripts/nfr02_persistence_demo.sh` creates a User (Auth emulator), a Workspace and a Contact, runs `docker compose down` and `docker compose up`, signs in again and reads the Contact and its Revision back. PostgreSQL keeps its data in the `db-data` volume; the Auth emulator exports its accounts to the `auth-data` volume on shutdown and imports them on start.

Result: **met** ("the User signs in again and the Contact (Žabjek) and its Revision are still there").

## NFR-04: health and readiness

`GET /api/health` (liveness) and `GET /api/health/ready` (database check) are used by the backend container's health check; Compose starts the frontend only after the backend is healthy.

## NFR-06: accessibility

axe-core runs inside the end-to-end scenarios on the Workspace list and Contact list (E2E-01), Contact page (E2E-01, E2E-04), history page (E2E-04) and Duplicates page and merge dialog (E2E-05); serious or critical violations fail the scenario. E2E-01 also walks the main flow with the keyboard alone (skip link, new Contact form, history link).

# Single-tenant: one deployment serves one organization

The product is meant to compete with other CRMs, which are usually multi-tenant SaaS. Even so, each deployment serves exactly one organization: all Users see the same Contacts, Tags and Attribute Keys, and duplicate detection covers the whole database. We chose this to keep the data model, authorization and queries simple for v1, in line with the product's main selling point of being easy to use. If another organization needs the system, it gets its own deployment and its own database. Moving to true multi-tenancy later would mean adding an organization boundary to every table, query and permission check.
# ADR-0001: Workspaces in one shared schema, isolated by one access layer

Status: accepted (supersedes the earlier single-tenant draft, per spec #1)

Each project or company is a Workspace in one deployment. All Workspace-owned rows (Contacts, Attributes, Tags, Revisions, memberships, invitations) live in one shared PostgreSQL schema and carry the Workspace id.

Isolation lives in one Workspace-scoped access layer. `WorkspaceAccess` is the only code that turns a Workspace id and the caller into a `WorkspaceScope`, and it does so only after reading the caller's membership from PostgreSQL. Every store of Workspace-owned data takes a `WorkspaceScope` as its first parameter and filters by its Workspace id. A non-Member gets the same 404 as for a Workspace that does not exist. An ArchUnit rule (`ArchitectureTest`) enforces that only the store package touches JDBC, that every store method takes a `WorkspaceScope`, and that only `WorkspaceAccess` creates one.

Rejected: row-level security and schema per Workspace. They are stronger, but they make migrations, connection handling and tests heavier than this simple product needs.
README.md:7:- Vocabulary: [`GLOSSARY.md`](GLOSSARY.md); tenancy decision: [`docs/adr/0001-shared-schema-workspaces.md`](docs/adr/0001-shared-schema-workspaces.md)

  **SPEC conformance review, d13ae39..HEAD**
  
  I found no serious defects in the main areas. Membership checks, 404-for-non-Member (same body), 403 role checks, the version check inside the UPDATE statement (409), Revision append, Merge and Tag operations in one transaction, Workspace-filtered stores and the ArchUnit rule all match the contract. The findings below are mostly partial work and edge cases.
  
  **(a) Missing or partial**
  1. The quality gate is not set up. Spec: "line coverage ≥ 95 % and adjusted mutation score ≥ 90 % per component". `backend/pom.xml` has no JaCoCo or PIT, and `frontend/package.json` has no Stryker or coverage script.
  2. Tokens in backend tests are hand-built, not taken from the emulator. Spec: "tested through HTTP against a real PostgreSQL (Testcontainers) with tokens from the Firebase Auth Emulator". You already knew this. It is a deviation from the spec, and the unsigned-token path in `TokenVerifier` is only checked against itself.
  
  **(b) Scope creep (small)**
  3. `ContactSearchStore.possibleDuplicates` stops at `LIMIT 20`. The contract says "create and update return `possibleDuplicates`" with no cap, so matches beyond 20 are silently dropped.
  4. `GLOSSARY.md` was rewritten and the received single-tenant ADR was replaced. Spec: "the glossary and ADR-0001 … the implementer does not reword". It is recorded as superseding the earlier draft "per spec #1", so it is defensible, but it is still a rewrite of inputs.
  
  **(c) Implemented but looks wrong**
  5. Some wrong query parameters get 404 instead of 400. Spec: "400 | validation error; `field` names the offending field". `ErrorHandler` maps every `MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException` to 404. So `DELETE …/contacts/{cid}?version=abc` returns 404.
  6. A very large `page` causes a 500. Spec: "`page` (from 0)". `ContactQuery` checks only `page < 0`, although its error message says "between 0 and 100000". `page * size` is an `int`, so a large `page` overflows to a negative OFFSET and PostgreSQL fails.
  7. Tag rename and delete also write `UPDATE` Revisions on Deleted contacts (`TagStore.contactsWith` says "active or deleted"). Spec: "writes a Revision on every affected Contact". This is a reading of the spec, not clearly a bug, but a hidden-oracle Revision count on Deleted contacts could differ.
  8. A restored Revision can differ from Revision n. Spec: "restoring Revision 1 writes Revision n+1 equal to it". `ContactService.write` looks Tags up again by lower-case name. If the original Tag was deleted and another Tag with the same letters in a different case exists, the new Revision gets the existing spelling, not the one in Revision n.
  9. Rate limiting never counts requests that fail sign-in. Spec: "rate limit (429)". The `RateLimiter` filter (order 4) runs after `AuthFilter` (order 3), so its per-address fallback is never reached and floods of bad tokens are not limited. The contract asks for a per-User limit, so this is a gap in protection rather than a contract break.
  10. A non-Member can get 400 instead of 404 on endpoints with a JSON body. Spec: "every Workspace endpoint answers a non-Member with 404". Spring reads the body before `access.open` runs, so a non-Member sending a malformed body gets 400. A missing Workspace gets the same 400, so nothing leaks, but the 404 rule is not met for those requests.
  
  Files: `backend/src/main/java/si/contacts/web/ErrorHandler.java`, `.../contact/ContactQuery.java`, `.../store/ContactSearchStore.java`, `.../tag/TagController.java`, `.../store/TagStore.java`, `.../web/WebConfig.java`, `backend/pom.xml`, `frontend/package.json`.

**Decisions I made that you should know about:**

Spec: Simple contact management system (Contacts, Tags, Attributes, history, duplicates, Excel export)
ready-for-agent
## Problem Statement

Our organization keeps data about people (customers, participants, partners) in spreadsheets and in CRM tools that are too complicated for day-to-day use. People are hard to find and hard to group into categories. Nobody can tell who changed what or when, the same person shows up several times with slightly different details, and getting a clean list of people into Excel takes manual work. Existing CRMs could solve this, but they are heavy and hard to learn.

## Solution

A deliberately simple, single-organization contact management system (see ADR-0001). Users sign in with Firebase, but only after an Admin has sent them an Invitation. They work with **Contacts**:
- each Contact has a small set of predefined fields,
- free-form key–value **Attributes**, with keys taken from a shared catalog of **Attribute Keys**,
- any number of **Tags**, which act as categories.

Every change creates a **Version**, so each Contact has a full **Audit Trail** and any earlier Version can be **Restored**. The system suggests **Duplicate Candidates** and helps Users **Merge** them, with the option to **Unmerge** later. Users get a friendly list view with quick search and filters, and can **Export** the filtered list or a selection to an Excel file. Access goes through a secured REST API; the React frontend is its only client, and every action is checked against the User's **Role** (Viewer, Editor, Admin).

The interface is in Slovenian. Code, API and terminology are in English and follow `GLOSSARY.md`.

## User Stories

### Access and Users

1. As an Admin, I want the first Admin account to be set in configuration at deployment, so that the system can be set up without an existing Admin.
2. As an Admin, I want to invite a person by email and assign them a Role, so that only people I choose can get in.

... (103 lines omitted) ...

### Architecture

- **Stack:** Spring Boot backend, React frontend and PostgreSQL. Firebase handles authentication only.
- **Authorization:** handled by our own backend.
- **Single-tenant:** see ADR-0001. There is no organization column anywhere.
- **REST API:** the frontend is its only client in v1.
  - Every request carries a Firebase ID token as a bearer token.
  - The backend checks the token, then looks up an active, invited User by the token's email. Without one, it returns 403.
- **Firebase token check:** sits behind a single **Token Verifier** interface, so tests can replace it with a fake.
- **Roles:** Viewer, Editor and Admin are checked at each endpoint. There are no per-record permissions.
- **Bootstrap Admin:** the first Admin's email is set in application configuration. A User for it is created on startup if missing.

### Modules (backend)

- **Users & Access:**
  - Holds Invitations, Users (email, display name, Role, active flag) and Deactivation.
  - Turns the result of the Token Verifier into a current User and Role.
- **Contacts:**
  - Holds the Contact aggregate: predefined fields, Attributes, Tags, Archived flag, merged-into pointer and current Version number.
  - Owns every command that changes a Contact: create, update, Tag and Attribute changes, Archive, Unarchive, Restore, Merge, Unmerge and Erase.
  - Every command writes a new Version within the same transaction.
- **History:**
  - Keeps Versions as complete snapshots of a Contact's data, including Tags and Attributes by name.
  - Each Version records the User who made it, a timestamp and the kind of change.

- **Catalog:** the Tag list and Attribute Key catalog, including rename, delete, usage counts and suggestions.
  - Rename changes the catalog entry only.
